series.description: 生活、職場與主題口說練習。第 7 篇起含四部分教學：心得、簡短回應、附和補充、句型抽換（每篇 15 句）。可連續 TTS 跟讀英文；有 MP3 時可整段播放。
依電影場景例句跟讀：賽車術語、車隊對話與賽道壓力用語。單句可用 TTS；放入 MP3 後可整段跟讀。

articles.summaryZh: 從賴床、通勤、午間到收工入睡——日常節奏口語。

segments.en: I'll hit snooze just one more time.
segments.zh: 我再貪睡一下就好。

segments.en: I feel like staying in bed forever today.
segments.zh: 我今天好想賴在床上一輩子。

segments.en: Looks like it's pouring rain outside.
segments.zh: 外頭看起來在下大雨。

segments.en: I don't know if I can catch the 8:30 bus.
segments.zh: 我不知道還趕不趕得上八點半那班公車。

segments.en: I'm gonna grab an iced latte on my way to work.
segments.zh: 我上班路上會去買杯冰拿鐵。

segments.en: Let me quickly scan through my unread emails first.
segments.zh: 我先快速掃過未讀郵件。

segments.en: I wanna knock out this report before lunchtime.
segments.zh: 我想在午飯前把這份報告搞定。

segments.en: I have to wrap up this phone call with the client.
segments.zh: 我得先結束跟客戶的這通電話。

segments.en: Can I get a chicken salad to go, please?
segments.zh: 麻煩給我一份雞肉沙拉外帶，謝謝。

segments.en: Do you wanna take a quick walk to fight the food coma?
segments.zh: 要不要走走消食，趕走飯後昏睡？

segments.en: Could you double-check these numbers for me real quick?
segments.zh: 可以幫我再快速核對一下這些數字嗎？

segments.en: What do you say we pack up and call it a day?
segments.zh: 我們收拾一下收工，好不好？

segments.en: How do you usually unwind after such a stressful day?
segments.zh: 這麼高壓的一天後，你通常怎麼放鬆？

segments.en: I've been binge-watching this new show all evening.
segments.zh: 我整晚都在狂追這部新劇。

segments.en: I keep dozing off, so it's time for bed.
segments.zh: 我一直打瞌睡，該上床睡了。

articles.summaryZh: 專案目標、分工、延期與收尾——職場推進常用句。

segments.en: Let me walk you through the goals of this new project.
segments.zh: 我來帶你過一遍這個新專案的目標。

segments.en: I'll take the lead on drafting the project scope.
segments.zh: 專案範圍草案我來主導。

segments.en: Do you wanna handle the vendor communication part?
segments.zh: 廠商溝通這塊你要不要負責？

segments.en: Make sure you set clear deadlines for each milestone.
segments.zh: 記得替每個里程碑訂清楚的截止日期。

segments.en: I have to double-check our available budget before we spend.
segments.zh: 花錢前我得再確認可用預算。

segments.en: I wanna keep everyone in the loop as we build this.
segments.zh: 推進過程中我想讓大家都掌握進度。

segments.en: Could you send over the technical specs by noon?
segments.zh: 中午前可以把技術規格寄過來嗎？

segments.en: Looks like we just hit a bottleneck with the database.
segments.zh: 看起來我們在資料庫這邊卡關了。

segments.en: I don't know why this server keeps throwing errors.
segments.zh: 我不懂為什麼這台伺服器一直報錯。

segments.en: Why don't we test an alternative workaround first?
segments.zh: 不如我們先試試替代的變通方案？

segments.en: How do you feel about shifting the deadline back by two days?
segments.zh: 你覺得把截止日期延後兩天怎麼樣？

segments.en: I feel like that would give us enough breathing room.
segments.zh: 我覺得那樣會讓我們有足夠喘息空間。

segments.en: Are you sure the revised mockups are ready for presentation?
segments.zh: 修訂後的稿真的準備好簡報了嗎？

segments.en: What do you think management will say about these numbers?
segments.zh: 你覺得管理層會怎麼看這些數字？

segments.en: Can I get your final approval on this slide deck?
segments.zh: 這份簡報可以請你做最終核准嗎？

segments.en: I'm gonna push the code to production tonight.
segments.zh: 我今晚會把程式推上正式環境。

segments.en: I keep refreshing the analytics dashboard to check user feedback.
segments.zh: 我一直在重新整理分析儀表板看使用者回饋。

segments.en: I've been compiling all the bugs that users reported.
segments.zh: 我一直在彙整使用者回報的所有錯誤。

segments.en: How about running a quick retrospective on Friday afternoon?
segments.zh: 週五下午做個快速檢討會如何？

segments.en: It's time to archive the files and celebrate our win.
segments.zh: 是時候封存檔案、慶祝這次勝利了。

articles.summaryZh: 煎牛排與品嚐回饋——廚房場景口語與感官描述。

segments.en: I wanna try making authentic garlic butter steak tonight.
segments.zh: 今晚我想試試做道地的蒜香奶油牛排。

segments.en: Can I get two thick-cut ribeye steaks from the butcher?
segments.zh: 可以跟肉販買兩塊厚切肋眼牛排嗎？

segments.en: Don't forget to pat the beef completely dry with paper towels.
segments.zh: 別忘了用紙巾把牛肉徹底拍乾。

segments.en: Make sure you season both sides generously with coarse sea salt.
segments.zh: 記得兩面都要慷慨地撒上粗海鹽。

segments.en: I'll chop up some fresh rosemary and smash a few garlic cloves.
segments.zh: 我會剁一點新鮮迷迭香，再拍碎幾瓣蒜。

segments.en: I have to get this cast-iron skillet ripping hot first.
segments.zh: 我得先把這口鑄鐵鍋燒到超熱。

segments.en: All you need to do is sear the meat for two minutes without touching it.
segments.zh: 你只要把肉煎兩分鐘、中間別去動它。

segments.en: Looks like we've got a gorgeous golden-brown crust forming.
segments.zh: 看起來漂亮的金棕色外皮正在成形。

segments.en: Let me toss in a generous slab of butter for basting.
segments.zh: 我加一大塊奶油進去做澆淋。

segments.en: I'm gonna let the steak rest for five minutes before slicing.
segments.zh: 切片前我會讓牛排靜置五分鐘。

segments.en: It's time to dig in while everything is piping hot!
segments.zh: 趁一切滾燙熱騰騰，開動吧！

segments.en: There's no way home cooking can smell this incredible.
segments.zh: 家常料理怎麼可能香成這樣。

segments.en: Do you wanna take the first slice and try it?
segments.zh: 要不要先切第一片試試看？

segments.en: How do you like the doneness of this cut?
segments.zh: 你覺得這塊的熟度怎麼樣？

segments.en: It tastes like something served in a high-end steakhouse.
segments.zh: 吃起來像高級牛排館端出來的。

segments.en: You should definitely try it with this creamy peppercorn sauce.
segments.zh: 你一定要配這個奶油胡椒醬試試。

segments.en: I don't know how you got the meat so unbelievably tender.
segments.zh: 我不懂你怎麼把肉弄得這麼不可思議地嫩。

segments.en: Is it just me, or is the rosemary aroma coming through so cleanly?
segments.zh: 是只有我這樣覺得，還是迷迭香香氣真的很乾淨清楚？

segments.en: I feel like the garlic butter creates such a velvety mouthfeel.
segments.zh: 我覺得蒜香奶油帶來一種絲滑的口感。

segments.en: What do you think about pairing this with that dry red wine?
segments.zh: 你覺得搭配那瓶乾紅怎麼樣？

segments.en: How about a squeeze of lemon to cut through the richness?
segments.zh: 擠點檸檬來解膩如何？

segments.en: Why don't we mop up the leftover pan juices with that sourdough bread?
segments.zh: 不如用那塊酸種麵包把鍋汁沾光？

segments.en: Are you sure this is your first time nailing a medium-rare like this?
segments.zh: 你確定這是你第一次把五分熟抓得這麼準？

segments.en: I can't get over how crispy the edges are while the inside stays juicy.
segments.zh: 外緣這麼脆、裡面又多汁，我真的好驚豔。

segments.en: I've been craving a meal like this for the longest time.
segments.zh: 我渴望這樣一餐好久了。

segments.en: I keep reaching for more of these roasted potatoes on the side.
segments.zh: 我一直伸手去夾旁邊的烤馬鈴薯。

segments.en: If you ask me, this entire dinner is an absolute ten out of ten.
segments.zh: 要問我的話，這頓晚餐絕對一百分。

segments.en: Could you share your secret marinade recipe with me?
segments.zh: 可以把你的祕密醃料配方分享給我嗎？

segments.en: I'm so glad we decided to cook at home instead of eating out.
segments.zh: 好慶幸我們決定在家煮，而不是外食。

segments.en: Next time, let's make a bigger batch so we can have leftovers!
segments.zh: 下次我們做多一點，好留剩菜！

articles.summaryZh: 訂票、轉機、在地探索與旅途轉折——旅行全程口語。

segments.en: I wanna book the early flight to avoid morning turbulence.
segments.zh: 我想訂早班機，避開早上的亂流。

segments.en: Let me double-check all passport expiration dates first.
segments.zh: 我先再確認所有護照效期。

segments.en: Make sure you pack an international power adapter in your carry-on.
segments.zh: 記得在隨身行李放一個國際轉接頭。

segments.en: Don't forget to notify the credit card company about overseas transactions.
segments.zh: 別忘了通知信用卡公司有海外消費。

segments.en: I'll take care of the airport transfer reservation.
segments.zh: 機場接送預約交給我。

segments.en: Can I get a window seat closer to the front, please?
segments.zh: 可以給我靠前一點的靠窗座位嗎？

segments.en: Looks like our connecting flight has been delayed by two hours.
segments.zh: 看起來我們的轉機班機延誤了兩小時。

segments.en: I don't know if our checked luggage will make the tight transfer.
segments.zh: 不知道託運行李趕不趕得上這趟緊湊轉機。

segments.en: Could you check with the gate agent about hotel vouchers?
segments.zh: 可以跟閘口地勤問一下飯店住宿券嗎？

segments.en: I'm gonna grab a bottle of water before the stores close.
segments.zh: 商店打烊前我先去買瓶水。

segments.en: Do you wanna split a cab to the hotel instead of taking the train?
segments.zh: 要不要分攤計程車去飯店，別搭火車？

segments.en: What do you think about grabbing a bite at that 24-hour diner?
segments.zh: 去那間二十四小時小餐館吃一口，你覺得呢？

segments.en: How do you pronounce the name of this local street food?
segments.zh: 這個在地小吃的名字怎麼念？

segments.en: I feel like a good night's rest will cure this jet lag completely.
segments.zh: 我覺得好好睡一晚就能徹底治好時差。

segments.en: I keep checking my watch because my internal clock is totally off.
segments.zh: 我一直看錶，因為生理時鐘完全亂掉了。

segments.en: Why don't we hire a local guide for the historic quarter tomorrow?
segments.zh: 明天何不請個在地導遊逛歷史街區？

segments.en: How about renting electric scooters to explore the coastline?
segments.zh: 租電動滑板車去海岸線探險如何？

segments.en: Are you sure the temple is still open to visitors this late?
segments.zh: 你確定寺廟這麼晚還開放參觀嗎？

segments.en: It's time to exchange some local currency for the street stalls.
segments.zh: 該換點當地貨幣好逛街頭攤販了。

segments.en: I've been dying to try this Michelin-recommended pastry shop.
segments.zh: 我超想去這家米其林推薦的糕點店。

segments.en: All you need to do is scan this QR code to download the subway map.
segments.zh: 你只要掃這個 QR code 下載地鐵圖就行。

segments.en: There's no way we can hit all three museums in a single afternoon.
segments.zh: 一個下午不可能逛完三間博物館。

segments.en: You should definitely wear comfortable walking shoes on this cobblestone road.
segments.zh: 走這條石板路一定要穿舒服的走路鞋。

segments.en: Is it just me, or is the temperature dropping really fast tonight?
segments.zh: 是只有我覺得，還是今晚氣溫降得好快？

segments.en: It tastes like lemongrass and coconut milk blended together.
segments.zh: 吃起來像香茅和椰奶混在一起。

segments.en: I can't get over how well-preserved these ancient fortress walls are.
segments.zh: 這些古城牆保存得這麼好，我真的好驚豔。

segments.en: If you ask me, the view from the rooftop beats the crowded observatory.
segments.zh: 要問我的話，屋頂景觀比擁擠的觀景台好多了。

segments.en: I'm so glad we packed rain ponchos just in case.
segments.zh: 好慶幸我們以防萬一帶了雨衣。

segments.en: To be honest, the famous tourist trap wasn't worth the hype at all.
segments.zh: 老實說，那個有名的觀光陷阱完全不值得炒作。

segments.en: No wonder all the locals lined up outside this tiny alley bakery.
segments.zh: 難怪當地人都在這間小巷麵包店外排隊。

segments.en: I'm afraid that the ferry service might be suspended due to rough seas.
segments.zh: 恐怕渡輪會因為海況不佳而停駛。

segments.en: Chances are we can catch the sunset if we take the bypass route now.
segments.zh: 如果現在走便道，很有機會趕上日落。

segments.en: Assuming that the traffic clears up, we'll reach the station by five.
segments.zh: 假設交通疏通，我們五點前可以到車站。

segments.en: Even if it starts drizzling, the market still has an indoor pavilion.
segments.zh: 就算下起毛毛雨，市場也還有室內亭區。

segments.en: What if we take the scenic mountain train back instead of flying?
segments.zh: 萬一我們改搭景觀山列車回去、不搭飛機呢？

segments.en: It turns out that the landmark was closed for renovation on Tuesdays.
segments.zh: 原來這個地標星期二會因整修關閉。

segments.en: I couldn't help but take hundreds of photos of that incredible sunset.
segments.zh: 那個驚人的日落，我忍不住拍了上百張。

segments.en: I'm looking forward to soaking in the hotel hot tub after all this hiking.
segments.zh: 走了這麼多路，我很期待泡飯店的熱水浴缸。

segments.en: Next time, we should definitely spend at least three nights in this quaint town.
segments.zh: 下次我們一定要在這個古雅小鎮至少住三晚。

segments.en: Looking back on it, that missed train turned out to be our best adventure.
segments.zh: 回想起來，錯過那班火車反而是我們最棒的冒險。

articles.summaryZh: 從路線圖、彩排到上線檢討——發佈會全週期職場口語。

segments.en: Let me outline the strategic roadmap for this Q4 product launch.
segments.zh: 我來概述這次第四季產品發布的策略路線圖。

segments.en: First off, we must establish clear performance indicators for the rollout.
segments.zh: 首先，我們必須為上線訂出清楚的績效指標。

segments.en: Make sure you finalize the press release before forwarding it to legal.
segments.zh: 轉給法務前，請先把新聞稿定稿。

segments.en: Don't forget to loop in the customer support team for crisis training.
segments.zh: 別忘了把客服團隊拉進來做危機訓練。

segments.en: I'll oversee the coordination between engineering and marketing.
segments.zh: 工程與行銷之間的協調我來督導。

segments.en: I wanna clarify the user onboarding flow during the live demo.
segments.zh: 現場示範時我想把使用者導覽流程講清楚。

segments.en: Could you pull the latest analytics on user sign-ups from beta?
segments.zh: 可以拉一下測試版最新的註冊分析嗎？

segments.en: I have to stress the importance of server stability under high traffic.
segments.zh: 我必須強調高流量下伺服器穩定的重要性。

segments.en: Can I get a status report on the API gateway integration by noon?
segments.zh: 中午前可以給我 API 閘道整合的進度報告嗎？

segments.en: Looks like the design department revised the brand assets again.
segments.zh: 看來設計部門又改了品牌素材。

segments.en: I don't know whether the current bandwidth can handle ten thousand users.
segments.zh: 我不確定目前頻寬能不能撐一萬名使用者。

segments.en: Why don't we set up a backup server cluster to prevent sudden crashes?
segments.zh: 何不建置備援伺服器叢集，預防突然當機？

segments.en: Do you wanna rehearse the keynote slides on the main stage tomorrow?
segments.zh: 明天要不要在主舞台彩排主題簡報？

segments.en: What do you say about inviting tech journalists for an exclusive early look?
segments.zh: 邀請科技記者搶先獨家體驗，你覺得呢？

segments.en: How do you plan to handle negative press if the feature receives backlash?
segments.zh: 如果功能引發反彈，你打算怎麼處理負面報導？

segments.en: I feel like the pricing tier might be slightly confusing to casual users.
segments.zh: 我覺得收費方案對一般使用者可能有點難懂。

segments.en: Are you sure all data privacy compliance standards have been satisfied?
segments.zh: 你確定所有資料隱私合規標準都達標了嗎？

segments.en: How about streamlining the registration process to just two simple clicks?
segments.zh: 把註冊流程精簡成兩次點擊如何？

segments.en: All you need to do is approve the budget reallocation for targeted paid ads.
segments.zh: 你只要核准定向付費廣告的預算重分配就行。

segments.en: There's no way we can delay the release date with media invites already out.
segments.zh: 媒體邀請都已發出，發布日不可能再延。

segments.en: You should definitely dry-run the payment gateway with international cards.
segments.zh: 你一定要用國際卡對支付閘道做一次彩排測試。

segments.en: Is it just me, or does this dashboard look slightly cluttered on mobile?
segments.zh: 是只有我覺得，還是這個儀表板在手機上看有點雜？

segments.en: I can't get over how responsive the interface feels after the optimization.
segments.zh: 優化後介面這麼跟手，我真的好驚豔。

segments.en: If you ask me, this killer feature alone will disrupt the entire market.
segments.zh: 要問我的話，光這個殺手鐧功能就會顛覆整個市場。

segments.en: I'm gonna trigger the deployment script as soon as you give the word.
segments.zh: 你一點頭，我就會啟動部署腳本。

segments.en: It's time to open the registration portal to the public waiting list.
segments.zh: 是時候對公開候補名單開放註冊入口了。

segments.en: I keep watching the error logs to make sure nothing unexpected spikes.
segments.zh: 我一直盯著錯誤日誌，確保沒有異常暴衝。

segments.en: I've been tracking the real-time conversion rates every ten minutes.
segments.zh: 我每十分鐘都在追即時轉換率。

segments.en: To be honest, the initial server load was heavier than we anticipated.
segments.zh: 老實說，初期伺服器負載比我們預期更重。

segments.en: No wonder our social media mentions skyrocketed after the live stream.
segments.zh: 難怪直播後社群提及量暴衝。

segments.en: I'm afraid that the free tier users are hitting the system capacity limit.
segments.zh: 恐怕免費用戶正在撞上系統容量上限。

segments.en: Chances are enterprise clients will ask for customized API solutions.
segments.zh: 企業客戶很有可能要求客製化 API 方案。

segments.en: Assuming that the current retention rate holds, we will hit our target.
segments.zh: 假設目前留存率維持得住，我們會達標。

segments.en: Even if competitors copy the concept, our ecosystem lock-in is stronger.
segments.zh: 就算對手抄概念，我們的生態系黏著度更強。

segments.en: What if we offer a launch discount to convert trial users to yearly plans?
segments.zh: 若提供上市優惠，把試用者轉成年繳方案呢？

segments.en: It turns out that the micro-influencer campaign generated the best ROI.
segments.zh: 原來微型網紅活動帶來了最佳投資報酬率。

segments.en: I'm so glad the dev team patched that critical security leak overnight.
segments.zh: 好慶幸開發團隊連夜修了那個關鍵資安漏洞。

segments.en: Correct me if I'm wrong, but didn't we promise dark mode by next week?
segments.zh: 若我說錯請糾正，但我們不是承諾下週有深色模式嗎？

segments.en: I see your point, but scaling back features now would hurt our credibility.
segments.zh: 我懂你的意思，但現在砍功能會傷害可信度。

segments.en: As far as I know, the board members are thrilled with the first-day results.
segments.zh: 就我所知，董事會對首日成果相當興奮。

segments.en: As long as you keep the uptime above ninety-nine percent, clients stay happy.
segments.zh: 只要你把可用率維持在百分之九十九以上，客戶就會開心。

segments.en: Unless we optimize the database queries, operational costs will balloon.
segments.zh: 除非我們優化資料庫查詢，否則營運成本會膨脹。

segments.en: Just to make sure, did everyone update their documentation on GitHub?
segments.zh: 只是再確認一下，大家都在 GitHub 更新文件了嗎？

segments.en: Speaking of which, has the marketing team scheduled the follow-up emails?
segments.zh: 說到這，行銷團隊排好後續郵件了嗎？

segments.en: At this rate, we are projected to double our daily active users by Friday.
segments.zh: 照這個速度，預估週五前日活躍用戶會翻倍。

segments.en: There is no doubt that this rollout set a new benchmark for the company.
segments.zh: 毫無疑問，這次上線為公司立下新標竿。

segments.en: The bottom line is user retention matters far more than vanity metrics.
segments.zh: 重點是：使用者留存遠比虛榮指標重要。

segments.en: In retrospect, conducting those two extra dry runs saved us from disaster.
segments.zh: 事後看來，多做那兩次彩排讓我們免於災難。

segments.en: It goes without saying that the entire team deserves a huge bonus for this.
segments.zh: 不用說，整個團隊都該為這次拿豐厚獎金。

segments.en: Next time, we should automate the regression testing pipeline even earlier.
segments.zh: 下次我們該更早把回歸測試管線自動化。

articles.summaryZh: 拆除、水電、智慧設備到入住——居家改造現場口語。

segments.en: I feel like this 40-year-old townhouse has incredible potential.
segments.zh: 我覺得這棟四十年連棟透天潛力驚人。

segments.en: First off, we need a structural engineer to inspect the load-bearing walls.
segments.zh: 首先，我們需要結構工程師檢查承重牆。

segments.en: Make sure you obtain all the necessary renovation permits from city hall.
segments.zh: 記得向市政廳取得所有必要的翻修許可。

segments.en: Don't forget to turn off the main water and gas valves before demolition.
segments.zh: 拆除前別忘了關閉總水閥與瓦斯閥。

segments.en: I'll negotiate the scope and terms with the general contractor.
segments.zh: 工程範圍與條款我會跟總承包商談。

segments.en: I wanna knock down this dividing partition to create an open kitchen.
segments.zh: 我想打掉這道隔間牆，做成開放式廚房。

segments.en: Let me review the electrical blueprint for all the smart switches.
segments.zh: 我來檢視所有智慧開關的電氣藍圖。

segments.en: Could you ensure every socket in the kitchen has proper grounding?
segments.zh: 可以確認廚房每個插座都有妥善接地嗎？

segments.en: I have to stick to our budget limits, or we'll run out of cash.
segments.zh: 我得守住預算上限，否則會手頭吃緊。

segments.en: Can I get an itemized estimate for replacing the corroded galvanized pipes?
segments.zh: 更換腐蝕鍍鋅管可以給我明細報價嗎？

segments.en: Looks like the roof has a chronic seepage problem around the corners.
segments.zh: 看起來屋頂角落有長期滲水問題。

segments.en: I don't know if these vintage floor tiles can be salvaged intact.
segments.zh: 不知道這些復古地磚能不能完整搶救下來。

segments.en: Why don't we run neutral wires into every gang box for smart relays?
segments.zh: 何不把中性線拉進每個接線盒，方便智慧繼電器？

segments.en: Do you wanna install a centralized water filtration unit in the basement?
segments.zh: 要不要在地下室裝中央淨水設備？

segments.en: What do you think of using soundproof double-glazed windows facing the avenue?
segments.zh: 臨大街那側用隔音雙層玻璃窗，你覺得呢？

segments.en: How do you want to configure the automated lighting scenes in the living room?
segments.zh: 客廳自動化燈光情境你想怎麼設定？

segments.en: Are you sure the current circuit breaker can handle a high-power induction cooktop?
segments.zh: 你確定現有斷路器撐得住高功率IH爐嗎？

segments.en: How about concealing all the ethernet cabling inside the skirting boards?
segments.zh: 把所有網路線藏進踢腳板裡如何？

segments.en: All you need to do is pick out the paint swatch for the master bedroom.
segments.zh: 你只要挑好主臥的油漆色卡就行。

segments.en: There's no way we can live on site while they are jackhammering the floors.
segments.zh: 他們用破碎機打地板時，我們不可能住現場。

segments.en: You should definitely pressure-test the new plumbing before closing up the drywall.
segments.zh: 封石膏板前一定要對新水管做壓力測試。

segments.en: Is it just me, or does this custom cabinetry seem two inches too shallow?
segments.zh: 是只有我覺得，還是這組訂製櫃體淺了兩吋？

segments.en: I can't get over how much brighter the interior feels with skylights installed.
segments.zh: 裝了天窗後室內亮這麼多，我真的好驚豔。

segments.en: If you ask me, matte black hardware looks way classier than polished chrome.
segments.zh: 要問我的話，霧黑五金比拋光鉻雅緻多了。

segments.en: I'm gonna set up the Zigbee smart hub right in the middle of the hallway.
segments.zh: 我會把 Zigbee 智慧中樞裝在走廊正中央。

segments.en: It's time to pair all the motorized shades with the voice assistant.
segments.zh: 是時候把所有電動窗簾跟語音助理配對了。

segments.en: I keep finding fine drywall dust settling on newly delivered furniture.
segments.zh: 我一直發現石膏粉塵落在剛送來的家具上。

segments.en: I've been vacuuming the air filters every single day during sanding.
segments.zh: 打磨期間我每天都在吸空氣濾網。

segments.en: To be honest, the marble countertop price quote gave me sticker shock.
segments.zh: 老實說，大理石檯面報價讓我價格休克。

segments.en: No wonder the renovation took two weeks longer than originally scheduled.
segments.zh: 難怪翻修比原訂時程多花了兩週。

segments.en: I'm afraid that the tiles in the guest bath weren't leveled properly.
segments.zh: 恐怕客房浴室的磁磚沒有整平好。

segments.en: Chances are the contractor will have to rip out those three uneven slabs.
segments.zh: 承包商很有可能得拆掉那三片不平的板。

segments.en: Assuming that the silicone sealant dries by tomorrow, we can test the shower.
segments.zh: 假設矽利康明天乾了，我們就能測淋浴。

segments.en: Even if the power cuts out, the smart lock has an emergency USB-C terminal.
segments.zh: 就算停電，智慧鎖也有緊急 USB-C 接孔。

segments.en: What if we automate the exhaust fans to turn on when humidity exceeds 70%?
segments.zh: 若濕度超過百分之七十就自動開抽風機呢？

segments.en: It turns out that the original subfloor was completely infested with dry rot.
segments.zh: 原來原本的底層地板整個被乾腐菌侵蝕。

segments.en: I'm so glad we replaced all the aging wiring with flame-retardant cables.
segments.zh: 好慶幸我們把老化線路全換成耐燃電纜。

segments.en: Correct me if I'm wrong, but didn't we agree that dimmers were included in the price?
segments.zh: 若我說錯請糾正，但我們不是說好調光器含在報價裡嗎？

segments.en: I see your point, but safety always trumps aesthetics when it comes to electricity.
segments.zh: 我懂你的意思，但談到電力，安全永遠優先於美觀。

segments.en: As far as I know, the warranty covers any roof leaks for the next five years.
segments.zh: 就我所知，保固涵蓋未來五年任何屋頂漏水。

segments.en: As long as you maintain the HVAC filters quarterly, the efficiency stays peak.
segments.zh: 只要你每季保養空調濾網，效率就能維持巔峰。

segments.en: Unless we seal the grout, stains will permanently ruin the kitchen backsplash.
segments.zh: 除非我們封好填縫劑，否則汙漬會永久毀了廚房背牆。

segments.en: Just to make sure, did the carpenter leave access panels for the air conditioning?
segments.zh: 只是再確認，木工有留空調維修口嗎？

segments.en: Speaking of which, the customized solid wood dining table arrives on Thursday.
segments.zh: 說到這，訂製實木餐桌星期四會到。

segments.en: At this rate, we will finally be able to sleep in our own bed by the weekend.
segments.zh: 照這個速度，週末我們終於能睡自己的床了。

segments.en: There is no doubt that surviving a major renovation tests any relationship.
segments.zh: 毫無疑問，熬過大翻修是對任何關係的考驗。

segments.en: The bottom line is the structural integrity of the home has been completely restored.
segments.zh: 重點是：房子的結構完整性已徹底恢復。

segments.en: In retrospect, choosing waterproof vinyl planks over real hardwood was brilliant.
segments.zh: 事後看來，選防水塑膠地板而非實木地板太明智了。

segments.en: It goes without saying that hosting the housewarming party is going to be a blast.
segments.zh: 不用說，辦喬遷派對一定會超好玩。

segments.en: It's about time we peeled off the protective plastic films and enjoyed the space.
segments.zh: 是時候撕掉保護膠膜、好好享受這個空間了。

segments.en: The thing is, smart home automation is only as good as your home network.
segments.zh: 重點是：智慧家居再強，也取決於你家的網路。

segments.en: I'd rather invest upfront in commercial-grade routers than suffer spotty Wi-Fi.
segments.zh: 我寧願一開始投資商用級路由器，也不要忍受不穩的 Wi-Fi。

segments.en: Believe it or not, the automated routines already cut down our utility bills.
segments.zh: 信不信由你，自動化情境已經降低我們的公用事業費。

segments.en: There's no point in buying fancy gadgets if they can't integrate into one app.
segments.zh: 若不能整合進同一個 App，買炫砲裝置就沒意義。

segments.en: Except for the fact that the doorbell camera is overly sensitive, everything works great.
segments.zh: 除了門鈴攝影機過度敏感之外，一切都很順利。

segments.en: For the time being, let's leave the guest room empty until we decide on the furniture.
segments.zh: 暫時先讓客房空著，等我們決定家具再說。

segments.en: In the meantime, we can set up the entertainment center and mount the TV.
segments.zh: 同時我們可以架娛樂中心、把電視掛上牆。

segments.en: Hardly had we unpacked the last moving box when the neighbors knocked with cookies.
segments.zh: 我們幾乎還沒拆完最後一個紙箱，鄰居就帶著餅乾來敲門。

segments.en: No matter how exhausting the messy demolition phase was, the outcome is stunning.
segments.zh: 無論凌亂的拆除階段多累人，成果都令人驚豔。

segments.en: Next time, whenever we tackle a home project, we'll know exactly how to manage it.
segments.zh: 下次再做居家專案，我們就會完全知道怎麼管理。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 1–10：gearbox、shift、thread the needle、indication、stint、dirtbag、attaboy、audition、condone、long-lost。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: During the gruelling midnight shift at Daytona, Sonny anxiously radioed the pit crew to check if the overheating gearbox would survive another aggressive high-speed stint.
segments.zh: 在代托納艱苦的午夜輪班中，桑尼焦慮地透過無線電詢問維修人員，過熱的變速箱是否還能撐過另一輪激進的高速駕駛。

segments.en: Despite knowing that the fragile gearbox was holding up by a mere thread, Sonny refused to ease off and continued to shift down violently into the corners.
segments.zh: 儘管知道脆弱的變速箱隨時可能報廢，桑尼依然拒絕減速，並持續在進彎時猛烈降檔。

segments.en: Taking over the cockpit for the graveyard shift, the veteran driver knew that surviving the cold track conditions overnight was their only hope of staying in the race.
segments.zh: 接過深夜輪班的駕駛座後，這位老將深知熬過夜間冰冷的賽道狀況是他們留在比賽中的唯一希望。

segments.en: When Sonny strapped himself in for the final shift, the team principal reminded him that holding position until sunrise would keep their podium dreams alive.
segments.zh: 當桑尼繫好安全帶準備進行最後一輪排班時，車隊領隊提醒他只要保持名次撐到日出，他們的頒獎台夢想就能延續。

segments.en: Right out of the gate, Sonny managed to thread the needle between two colliding rivals into turn three, miraculously vaulting from seventh up to fourth place.
segments.zh: 桑尼一開場就穿針引線般穿過三號彎兩輛即將碰撞的對手車輛，奇蹟般地從第七位飆升至第四位。

segments.en: It takes supreme confidence and nerves of steel to thread the needle through dirty air when your brakes are already beginning to fade.
segments.zh: 當煞車已經開始衰退時，想要在後車擾流中穿針引線般超車，需要超凡的自信與鋼鐵般的意志。

segments.en: If Sonny's lightning-fast opening laps were any indication, the veteran racer had no intention of nursing the car gently through the night.
segments.zh: 如果桑尼開局幾圈如閃電般的速度有任何預示作用，那便是這位老將根本沒打算在夜間小心翼翼地保護賽車。

segments.en: The rising telemetry temperature gave every indication that the front left brake disc was about to shatter under immense friction.
segments.zh: 攀升的遙測溫度充分顯示出左前煞車碟盤即將在巨大的摩擦力下碎裂。

segments.en: After completing an epic third stint that hauled the struggling Porsche into first place, Sonny climbed out of the cockpit completely exhausted.
segments.zh: 在完成了精彩絕倫的第三輪駕駛、將苦苦掙扎的保時捷送上第一名之後，桑尼筋疲力盡地爬出了駕駛艙。

segments.en: Ruben argued that if Sonny could replicate just half of that legendary endurance stint, Apex GP would finally score its first championship points.
segments.zh: 魯本堅稱，只要桑尼能發揮出那場傳奇耐力駕駛的一半實力，彎心車隊就能終於拿下隊史首個錦標賽積分。

segments.en: Furious that he had been aggressively forced onto the grass, the rival driver marched into the pit lane screaming that Sonny was an unhinged dirtbag.
segments.zh: 因被強行逼上草地而狂怒的對手車手衝進維修區，破口大罵桑尼是個瘋狂的混蛋。

segments.en: "Don't waste your energy on that loudmouth dirtbag," Molly urged as she held Sonny back from a post-race physical confrontation.
segments.zh: 「別把力氣浪費在那個大嘴巴混蛋身上，」莫莉拉住桑尼，阻止賽後的肢體衝突。

segments.en: Slapping the exhausted driver firmly on the shoulder, Chip yelled an enthusiastic "attaboy" after Sonny delivered an unexpected victory at Daytona.
segments.zh: 在桑尼於代托納拿下意外的勝利後，奇普用力拍了拍這位筋疲力盡車手的肩膀，熱情地喊了一聲「好樣的」。

segments.en: A hollow "attaboy" from the management meant absolutely nothing to Joshua, who only cared about keeping his coveted seat for next season.
segments.zh: 管理層一句空洞的「幹得好」對約書亞來說毫無意義，他唯一在乎的是保住下賽季夢寐以求的車手席位。

segments.en: Kaspar was openly furious that the team was squandering their only official testing day to hold an unofficial audition for an aging racer.
segments.zh: 卡什帕非常憤怒，因為車隊竟然浪費了唯一一次官方試車日，來替一位年邁的車手進行非正式面試測試。

segments.en: Sonny smirked and told the garage that they were not auditioning him, but rather he was auditioning their car to see if it was worth his time.
segments.zh: 桑尼冷笑著告訴車庫所有人，不是車隊在面試他，而是他在測試這輛車看它值不值得他投入時間。

segments.en: As the team principal, Kaspar made it crystal clear that he could not condone risking millions of dollars on a driver who hadn't touched an F1 cockpit in thirty years.
segments.zh: 身為車隊領隊，卡什帕明確表示他絕不能贊同把數百萬美元的賭注押在一個三十年沒碰過 F1 駕駛艙的車手身上。

segments.en: Ruben refused to condone the internal sabotage orchestrated by Peter Banning, promising to fight the board to his dying breath.
segments.zh: 魯本拒絕縱容彼得·班寧策劃的內部破壞行為，並誓言要與董事會抗爭到最後一口氣。

segments.en: Nobody in the Silverstone paddock expected Ruben to walk through the garage gates accompanied by his long-lost teammate from the nineties.
segments.zh: 銀石賽道圍場裡沒人料到魯本走進車庫大門時，身邊跟著的竟是他九十年代失聯已久的老隊友。

segments.en: Reconnecting with a long-lost friend in a dilapidated laundromat turned out to be the catalyst that dragged Sonny back into world-class motorsport.
segments.zh: 在一間破舊的投幣洗衣店裡與失聯已久的老友重逢，成了將桑尼重新拉回世界頂級賽車運動的契機。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 11–20：side pod、differential、DRS、quid、stack it、gremlin、understeer、oversteer、sensor、verdict。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Kate inspected the redesigned side pod, explaining that the sculpted contours would direct airflow more efficiently toward the rear diffuser.
segments.zh: 凱特仔細檢查了重新設計的側箱，並解釋說其雕塑般的輪廓能將氣流更有效率地導向後擴散器。

segments.en: When glancing over the upgraded chassis, Sonny immediately spotted the altered side pods and asked if the floor aerodynamics had undergone similar modifications.
segments.zh: 當掃視升級後的底盤時，桑尼一眼就看出了改動過的側箱，並詢問底板空氣動力學是否也經歷了類似的修改。

segments.en: Fiddling with the steering wheel dials, Sonny adjusted the electronic differential settings from one to four to stabilize the rear axle through Copse corner.
segments.zh: 桑尼擺弄著方向盤上的旋鈕，將電子差速器設定從一調到四，以便在通過科普斯彎時穩定後軸。

segments.en: If the differential locks up prematurely under heavy braking, the car will inevitably snap into an uncontrollable high-speed spin.
segments.zh: 如果差速器在重踩煞車時過早鎖死，賽車將不可避免地陷入失控的高速打轉。

segments.en: Once the telemetry confirmed that Sonny was within 0.9 seconds of Perez, he slammed the DRS button to flatten the rear wing flap along the straight.
segments.zh: 當遙測數據確認桑尼落後佩雷茲在 0.9 秒以內時，他果斷按下減阻系統（DRS）按鈕，在直道上放平後尾翼襟翼。

segments.en: Even with DRS deployed and the battery draining in maximum attack mode, the underpowered engine struggled to overtake the charging Red Bull.
segments.zh: 即便開啟了 DRS 且電池處於最大進攻輸出模式，這具動力不足的引擎依然難以超越狂飆的紅牛賽車。

segments.en: Laughing cynically at the elderly substitute driver, a mechanic offered twenty quid to anyone willing to bet that Sonny would crash on his out-lap.
segments.zh: 一名技師譏諷地嘲笑著這位年長替補，開盤出二十英鎊打賭桑尼在出場圈就會撞車。

segments.en: Sonny boldly accepted the journalist's ten-quid wager, countering with ten thousand dollars that Apex GP would score points at Monza.
segments.zh: 桑尼豪爽地接受了記者十英鎊的賭注，並以一萬美元反向打賭彎心車隊必能在蒙札站拿到積分。

segments.en: The skeptical engineers whispered among themselves, convinced that Sonny was going to stack it into the barriers before completing three consecutive flying laps.
segments.zh: 心存疑慮的工程師們私下竊竊私語，堅信桑尼在跑完連續三個計時圈之前就會把車撞毀在防護牆上。

segments.en: If Joshua pushed too hard on worn slick tires over damp kerbs, he was bound to stack it and ruin their fragile championship hopes.
segments.zh: 如果約書亞在潮濕的路肩上過度壓榨磨損的光頭胎，他注定會嚴重撞車並粉碎他們脆弱的爭冠希望。

segments.en: Kate worked late into the night alongside the mechanics, determined to banish the mechanical gremlins causing intermittent power loss during sector two.
segments.zh: 凱特與技師們並肩工作至深夜，決心徹底消除在第二計時段導致間歇性動力流失的莫名機械故障。

segments.en: "Bring the car into the garage so we can hunt down those electrical gremlins," the race engineer instructed via the crackling team radio.
segments.zh: 「把車開回維修車庫，好讓我們找出那些電路系統的隱形毛病，」比賽工程師透過發出雜音的車隊無線電指示道。

segments.en: Joshua complained bitterly that the front tires refused to bite, causing severe understeer that forced him wide on every slow-speed hairpin entry.
segments.zh: 約書亞痛苦地抱怨前輪根本抓不住地面，嚴重的轉向不足迫使他在每個低速髮卡彎的入彎處跑大走線。

segments.en: To cure the persistent understeer without sacrificing top speed, the aerodynamicists subtly increased the angle of attack on the front wing flaps.
segments.zh: 為了在不犧牲極速的情況下解決持續存在的轉向不足，空氣動力學家微妙地增大了前翼襟翼的迎角。

segments.en: Sonny preferred a car with a sensitive rear end, demonstrating that controlled snap oversteer allowed him to rotate the chassis much faster in high-speed sweeps.
segments.zh: 桑尼偏愛車尾敏銳的賽車，並證明利用受控的突發性轉向過度能讓他在高速連續彎中更快完成底盤轉向。

segments.en: When the rookie applied full throttle across the exit kerb, sudden oversteer broke the traction and sent the car spinning into the gravel trap.
segments.zh: 當這名新秀在出彎路肩上全力灌下油門時，突如其來的轉向過度打破了抓地力，使賽車打轉衝進了碎石緩衝區。

segments.en: Joshua vented his frustration at the engineering debrief, shouting that having ten thousand sensors on the chassis was useless if nobody could explain why the car felt undriveable.
segments.zh: 約書亞在工程檢討會上宣洩挫折感，怒吼道如果沒人能解釋為什麼車子難以駕馭，底盤裝了一萬個感應器根本毫無用處。

segments.en: Telemetry streamed from hundreds of thermal sensors revealed that Sonny's unorthodox driving style was generating excessive heat across the rear brakes.
segments.zh: 來自數百個溫度感應器的即時遙測數據顯示，桑尼特立獨行的駕駛風格正導致後煞車產生過高溫度。

segments.en: After examining the wreckage and tracking data from Silverstone, the stewards delivered a swift verdict assigning equal blame to both Apex drivers for the collision.
segments.zh: 在審視了銀石賽道的殘骸與行車軌跡數據後，賽會幹事迅速作出裁決，認定彎心車隊兩位車手對此次碰撞負有均等責任。

segments.en: Everyone in the hospitality suite waited anxiously for Kate's technical verdict regarding whether the newly designed combat floor complied with FIA regulations.
segments.zh: 車隊招待所裡的每個人都焦急地等待著凱特的技術裁決，看新設計的戰鬥底板是否符合國際汽聯（FIA）的規範。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 21–30：jungle gym、overrated、third banana、clean house、phenomenal、maturity、rear jack、snappy、unpredictable、self-imposed。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Standing before the exposed carbon fiber monocoque, the cynical guest mocked the multi-million-dollar machine by calling it an over-engineered jungle gym.
segments.zh: 站在裸露的碳纖維單體座艙前，那位持懷疑態度的賓客嘲弄這輛價值數百萬美元的機器，稱其為過度設計的兒童攀登架。

segments.en: Crawling out of the tight cockpit cage felt like escaping an intricate jungle gym designed exclusively for masochistic athletes.
segments.zh: 從狹窄的防滾架座艙裡爬出來，感覺就像逃離一座專為受虐狂運動員設計的複雜攀登架。

segments.en: Joshua still harbored deep resentment toward Luca Cortez for previously telling motorsport journalists that Pearce was vastly overrated and pampered.
segments.zh: 約書亞對盧卡·科爾特斯依然心存芥蒂，因為後者曾對賽車記者聲稱皮爾斯是個被嚴重高估且被過度寵溺的新人。

segments.en: Determined to silence critics who claimed he was overrated, Joshua pushed the car past its mechanical limits to prove his raw speed on track.
segments.zh: 約書亞決心讓那些說他被高估的批評者閉嘴，他將賽車推向機械極限，以在賽道上證明自己的絕對速度。

segments.en: Joshua scoffed at the prospect of welcoming Luca, dismissing him as nothing more than an arrogant third banana who had spent his career bench-warming at Red Bull.
segments.zh: 約書亞對接納盧卡的提議嗤之以鼻，斥責他不過是個在紅牛車隊坐穿冷板凳的傲慢三號替補。

segments.en: Sonny warned the garage that he would never accept playing second fiddle, let alone acting as a third banana to an untested rookie with an attitude problem.
segments.zh: 桑尼警告車庫團隊，他絕不接受屈居次席，更不用說去給一個態度有問題的未經考驗的新秀當跑龍套的三號替補。

segments.en: Rumors circulated rapidly through the paddock that an aggressive new ownership group was poised to force a takeover and completely clean house at Apex GP.
segments.zh: 圍場內迅速流傳傳言，稱一個強勢的新財團正準備強制收購並對彎心車隊進行徹底的人事大換血。

segments.en: Knowing that corporate raiders would clean house the second the team failed to score points, Ruben felt immense pressure on his shoulders.
segments.zh: 深知只要車隊拿不到積分企業收購者就會在第一時間全面換血，魯本感受到了肩頭無比沉重的壓力。

segments.en: Ruben repeatedly defended Joshua to the skeptical board, insisting that the kid possessed phenomenal natural talent that only required seasoned mentorship to flourish.
segments.zh: 魯本一再向心存疑慮的董事會捍衛約書亞，堅稱這孩子具備驚人的天賦，僅僅需要富有經驗的引導便能綻放光芒。

segments.en: Sonny demonstrated phenomenal car control when dodging an errant tire at over two hundred miles per hour without lifting off the throttle.
segments.zh: 桑尼展現了驚人的控車能力，在時速超過兩百英里且未鬆開油門的情況下，成功避開了一顆脫落亂竄的輪胎。

segments.en: What Joshua possessed in raw blistering speed, he sorely lacked in emotional maturity, often blaming his team whenever track battles went awry.
segments.zh: 約書亞擁有令人炫目的絕對速度，但他極度缺乏情緒成熟度，每當賽道纏鬥陷入不利便經常歸咎於團隊。

segments.en: The final laps in Abu Dhabi proved that Joshua had finally achieved racing maturity, prioritizing the team's historic victory over his personal glory.
segments.zh: 阿布達比最後幾圈證明約書亞終於達到了賽車手的成熟度，將車隊歷史性的勝利置於個人榮耀之上。

segments.en: Kaspar took tremendous pride in having won multiple world championships as a humble rear jack man before rising through the ranks to lead a team.
segments.zh: 卡什帕對自己從一名不起眼的後千斤頂操作員一步步晉升至領導整支車隊並贏得多座世界冠軍深感自豪。

segments.en: When the pit stop collapsed into chaos, the panicked rear jack operator struggled to lift the chassis before the fresh rubber was bolted into place.
segments.zh: 當進站陷入混亂時，驚慌失措的後千斤頂操作員甚至在嶄新輪胎上緊之前就掙扎著想要抬起底盤。

segments.en: Sonny reported that the revised aerodynamic package made the chassis dangerously snappy whenever he transitioned through high-speed directional changes.
segments.zh: 桑尼回報說，修改後的空力套件使得底盤在高速連續變換方向時反應過度靈敏神經質，具有危險性。

segments.en: Exhausted from continuous mechanical failures, Kate’s patience wore thin, prompting a snappy confrontation with the complaining rookie driver.
segments.zh: 連續的機械故障讓凱特身心俱疲、耐心耗盡，進而與抱怨連連的新秀車手爆發了火藥味十足的爭執。

segments.en: Driving an unpredictable car in heavy rain with zero rear downforce is equivalent to playing Russian roulette at two hundred miles an hour.
segments.zh: 在毫無後下壓力的大雨中駕駛一輛動態飄忽不定的賽車，無異於在時速兩百英里下玩俄羅斯輪盤。

segments.en: Sonny's unpredictable race craft kept his competitors guessing constantly, never knowing whether he would dive down the inside or force a mistake around the outside.
segments.zh: 桑尼難以捉摸的比賽招式讓競爭對手隨時神經緊繃，永遠猜不透他會從內線俯衝超車，還是從外線施壓迫使對手犯錯。

segments.en: Sonny faced enormous humiliation if he failed to beat his self-imposed target of lapping within one second of Joshua's benchmark time during the test.
segments.zh: 如果桑尼在測試中未能達成自行設定的目標——跑進約書亞基準成績的一秒之內——他將面臨極大的羞辱。

segments.en: Despite battling intense physical agony from his self-imposed diet and fitness regime, Sonny refused to show any sign of physical vulnerability.
segments.zh: 儘管飽受自行設定的嚴苛飲食與體能訓練帶來的肉體折磨，桑尼仍拒絕流露出任何體力脆弱的跡象。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 31–40：hundredth、engagement、facety、reckless、phenomenon、abrupt、halt、horrific、diverse、dampen。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: In a sport where victory is measured by a fraction of a heartbeat, Sonny beat his audition cut-off time by a breathtaking five hundredths of a second.
segments.zh: 在這項以心跳瞬間來衡量勝負的運動中，桑尼以令人屏息的百分之五秒優勢壓線通過了他的測試門檻。

segments.en: Kate knew that shaving just two hundredths off their corner exit speed would determine whether they qualified inside the top ten.
segments.zh: 凱特深知，哪怕僅僅在出彎速度上扣除百分之二秒，都將決定他們能否排進前十名起跑。

segments.en: Joshua’s media manager continuously lectured him about building digital engagement and securing commercial sponsors instead of burying his nose in engineering data.
segments.zh: 約書亞的社群經紀人不斷向他訓話，要求他提高網路社群互動率並吸引商業贊助商，而不是成天把頭埋在工程數據裡。

segments.en: The PR department was ecstatic when Sonny's rebellious comments went viral, driving unprecedented online engagement across all team platforms.
segments.zh: 當桑尼叛逆的言論在網路上瘋傳時，公關部門欣喜若狂，這在車隊所有平台上推動了前所未有的互動量。

segments.en: Joshua’s mother scolded him for acting facety toward team management, warning him that talent without humility would destroy his motorsport career.
segments.zh: 約書亞的母親責備他對車隊管理層放肆無禮，警告他如果空有才華而缺乏謙遜，將會毀掉他的賽車生涯。

segments.en: "Don't get facety with me just because you drove well today," she cautioned as Joshua playfully dismissed her safety concerns.
segments.zh: 「別以為今天開得好就能跟我沒大沒小，」當約書亞嬉皮笑臉地忽視她對安全的擔憂時，她嚴肅告誡道。

segments.en: The media branded Sonny as a reckless gambler who drove with a blatant disregard for his own safety and that of his fellow competitors.
segments.zh: 媒體將桑尼塑造成一個魯莽的賭徒，指責他賽車時公然蔑視自己與其他競爭對手的生命安全。

segments.en: What armchair critics labeled as reckless aggression was actually calculated tactical pressure designed to force rivals into costly driving errors.
segments.zh: 那些被鍵盤評論家標籤為魯莽激進的行為，實際上是經過精密計算的戰術施壓，旨在迫使對手犯下代價沉重的失誤。

segments.en: Decades ago, Sonny had entered the Grand Prix circus as an unstoppable phenomenon, poised to conquer world championships before disaster abruptly struck.
segments.zh: 數十年前，桑尼曾作為勢不可擋的曠世奇才闖入大獎賽舞台，在災難突如其來之前，他本已準備好征服世界冠軍。

segments.en: The surprising mid-season resurgence of Apex GP rapidly evolved into a global sporting phenomenon that captivated casual racing fans worldwide.
segments.zh: 彎心車隊在季中令人意外的強勢復甦，迅速演變成一場席捲全球的體育現象，深深吸引了全球無數非硬核賽車迷。

segments.en: A horrific fiery crash at Jerez brought Sonny's golden Grand Prix career to an abrupt and heartbreaking halt thirty years ago.
segments.zh: 三十年前赫雷斯賽道上一場慘烈的大火撞車事故，讓桑尼如日中天的大獎賽生涯戛然而止，令人心碎。

segments.en: The team’s celebratory mood suffered an abrupt collapse when the technical delegate unexpectedly arrived to seize their newly developed floor components.
segments.zh: 當技術代表無預警抵達並查封他們新研發的底板零件時，車隊的慶祝氛圍瞬間蕩然無存。

segments.en: Heavy rain and zero track visibility brought the intense battle to a grinding halt as marshals frantically waved red flags across the circuit.
segments.zh: 暴雨與零能見度的賽道狀況迫使激烈的纏鬥驟然停止，賽道工作人員在整座賽道上瘋狂揮舞著紅旗。

segments.en: Ruben knew that failure to settle the investor lawsuit would bring their championship participation to a permanent and disastrous halt.
segments.zh: 魯本深知，若無法解決投資人的訴訟糾紛，將會給他們參與錦標賽的前景劃下災難性的永久句點。

segments.en: Watching the archival footage of Sonny's horrific accident made the rookie realize the life-altering stakes involved in piloting modern high-downforce machinery.
segments.zh: 觀看桑尼當年那場慘烈事故的歷史錄像，讓這位新秀意識到了駕駛現代高下壓力賽車所必須承擔的生死代價。

segments.en: Joshua endured a horrific collision at Monza that left his car in flames and sent shockwaves of dread through the entire Apex pit garage.
segments.zh: 約書亞在蒙札遭遇了一場可怕的碰撞，賽車頓時化為火球，給整個彎心車隊維修車庫帶來了極度恐慌的震撼。

segments.en: Having raced across diverse championships ranging from grueling Baja desert tracks to the 24 Hours of Le Mans, Sonny brought unmatched versatility to the garage.
segments.zh: 在從艱苦的巴哈沙漠賽道到勒芒24小時耐力賽等形式多樣的錦標賽中歷練過，桑尼為車隊帶來了無與倫比的全方位實戰經驗。

segments.en: Kate drew engineering inspiration from diverse industries outside motorsport, incorporating aerospace titanium weaving directly into their chassis development.
segments.zh: 凱特從賽車運動以外的多元行業中汲取工程靈感，直接將航空航天級的鈦合金編織技術應用到底盤研發中。

segments.en: Not even a severe five-second grid penalty could dampen Sonny's rebellious spirits as he prepared to mount an aggressive charge from last place.
segments.zh: 即便被處以嚴厲的退後五位發車罰秒，也絲毫未能澆熄桑尼叛逆的鬥志，他已準備好從最後一名發起猛烈進攻。

segments.en: Ruben attempted to dampen media speculation regarding team sales by issuing a staunch statement affirming Cervantes Capital’s long-term commitment.
segments.zh: 魯本試圖透過發表堅定維護車隊的聲明，重申塞萬提斯資本的長期承諾，以此平息外界對車隊即將出售的猜測。

items.baseZh: 「別以為今天開得好就能跟我沒大沒小，」當約書亞嬉皮笑臉地忽視她對安全的擔憂時，她嚴肅告誡道。

items.baseZh: 媒體將桑尼塑造成一個魯莽的賭徒，指責他賽車時公然蔑視自己與其他競爭對手的生命安全。

items.baseEn: Decades ago, Sonny had entered the Grand Prix circus as an unstoppable phenomenon, poised.
items.baseZh: 數十年前，桑尼曾作為勢不可擋的曠世奇才闖入大獎賽舞台，在災難突如其來之前，他本已準備好征服世界冠軍。

items.baseZh: 彎心車隊在季中令人意外的強勢復甦，迅速演變成一場席捲全球的體育現象，深深吸引了全球無數非硬核賽車迷。

items.pattern: A horrific fiery crash at Jerez brought Sonny's golden Grand Prix career [SWAP].

items.baseZh: 三十年前赫雷斯賽道上一場慘烈的大火撞車事故，讓桑尼如日中天的大獎賽生涯戛然而止，令人心碎。

items.pattern: Heavy rain and zero track visibility brought the intense battle to [SWAP].

items.baseZh: 暴雨與零能見度的賽道狀況迫使激烈的纏鬥驟然停止，賽道工作人員在整座賽道上瘋狂揮舞著紅旗。

items.pattern: Ruben knew that failure to settle [SWAP] would bring their championship participation.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Ruben knew that failure to settle the investor lawsuit would bring their championship participation.
items.baseZh: 魯本深知，若無法解決投資人的訴訟糾紛，將會給他們參與錦標賽的前景劃下災難性的永久句點。

items.pattern: Watching the archival footage of Sonny's horrific accident made the rookie realize [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Watching the archival footage of Sonny's horrific accident made the rookie realize the life-altering.
items.baseZh: 觀看桑尼當年那場慘烈事故的歷史錄像，讓這位新秀意識到了駕駛現代高下壓力賽車所必須承擔的生死代價。

items.pattern: Having raced across diverse championships ranging from grueling Baja desert tracks to [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Having raced across diverse championships ranging from grueling Baja desert tracks to the 24.
items.baseZh: 在從艱苦的巴哈沙漠賽道到勒芒24小時耐力賽等形式多樣的錦標賽中歷練過，桑尼為車隊帶來了無與倫比的全方位實戰經驗。

items.pattern: Kate drew engineering inspiration from diverse industries [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Kate drew engineering inspiration from diverse industries outside motorsport.
items.baseZh: 凱特從賽車運動以外的多元行業中汲取工程靈感，直接將航空航天級的鈦合金編織技術應用到底盤研發中。

items.pattern: Not even [SWAP] grid penalty could dampen Sonny's rebellious spirits as he.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Not even a severe five-second grid penalty could dampen Sonny's rebellious spirits as he.
items.baseZh: 即便被處以嚴厲的退後五位發車罰秒，也絲毫未能澆熄桑尼叛逆的鬥志，他已準備好從最後一名發起猛烈進攻。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 41–50：speculation、majority shareholder、desperate measures、surreal、annul、bankrupt、grid、qualifying、pole、Hail Mary。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Intense paddock speculation mounted over whether Apex GP would be liquidated before the season concluded or bailed out by rival automotive giants.
segments.zh: 圍場內瘋狂猜測彎心車隊究竟會在賽季結束前被清算拍賣，還是會被競爭對手的汽車巨頭出資收購拯救。

segments.en: Fueling widespread speculation, the enigmatic American driver vanished from the track paddock immediately after crossing the finish line victorious.
segments.zh: 更引發各界廣泛猜測的是，這位神祕的美國車手在奪冠衝過終點線後，竟第一時間從賽場圍場消失得無影無蹤。

segments.en: As the majority shareholder of Cervantes Capital, Ruben bore the ultimate legal and personal financial liability for the team's disastrous performance.
segments.zh: 身為塞萬提斯資本的大股東，魯本對車隊災難性的戰績承擔著最終的法律責任與個人巨額財務風險。

segments.en: The majority shareholder threatened to force a fire sale of the racing assets unless the cars delivered a top-ten finish by Sunday afternoon.
segments.zh: 大股東威脅，除非賽車在週日下午前跑進前十名完賽，否則將強制低價拋售車隊所有的賽車資產。

segments.en: Faced with looming bankruptcy, Ruben resorted to desperate measures by pulling an unvetted veteran out of retirement to replace his departing star driver.
segments.zh: 面對迫在眉睫的破產危機，魯本採取非常手段，將一位未經審查的退休老將重新挖出江湖，以取代出走的當家明星車手。

segments.en: Desperate times call for desperate measures, which justified Kate's radical decision to overhaul the aerodynamic concept mere hours before qualifying.
segments.zh: 非常時期需用非常手段，這也證明了凱特在排位賽開始前數小時毅然大改空氣動力學概念的激進決定是正確的。

segments.en: Standing on the Silverstone grid three decades after his last Grand Prix felt entirely surreal to Sonny, who had spent years hustling in underground poker clubs.
segments.zh: 在揮別大獎賽三十年後再次站在銀石賽道起步格上，對長年在地下撲克俱樂部打滾的桑尼來說，感覺無比虛幻與不真實。

segments.en: The rookie found it completely surreal to share telemetry screens with a living legend whom his late father had idolized during the nineties.
segments.zh: 這位新秀覺得太不可思議了，自己竟然能與一位已故父親在九十年代奉為偶像的傳奇人物共享遙測數據螢幕。

segments.en: Sifting through Sonny's colorful past, the nosy tabloid reporter pointed out that he had one brief marriage annulled alongside surviving two bitter divorces.
segments.zh: 翻閱著桑尼精彩紛呈的過往情史，愛管閒事的八卦記者指出他曾有一段短暫婚姻被宣告無效，同時還挺過了兩次痛苦的離婚。

segments.en: The FIA refused to annul the race classification despite rival teams protesting the aggressive blocking tactics Sonny employed during the final safety car restart.
segments.zh: 儘管競爭對手強烈抗議桑尼在最後一次安全車重啟時採取的激進阻擋戰術，FIA 依然拒絕宣告比賽成績無效。

segments.en: Declaring himself personally bankrupt after a disastrous decade of high-stakes gambling, Sonny had learned to survive with nothing more than a battered road van.
segments.zh: 在經歷了高額賭博慘敗的十年並宣告個人破產後，桑尼學會了僅憑一輛破舊的箱型廂型車維持生計。

segments.en: If Ruben could not secure championship prize money before winter testing, Apex GP would inevitably collapse completely bankrupt.
segments.zh: 如果魯本無法在冬季測試前拿到錦標賽獎金，彎心車隊勢必將徹底宣告破產倒閉。

segments.en: As twenty-two roaring engines vibrated through the asphalt, the twenty drivers lined up across the grid waiting for the red lights to illuminate.
segments.zh: 當二十二具轟鳴的引擎震顫著柏油路面時，車手們在發車格上一字排開，屏息等待紅燈亮起。

segments.en: Sonny deliberately stalled on the formation lap so that he could warm his tires aggressively while returning to his assigned spot at the back of the grid.
segments.zh: 桑尼在暖胎圈故意起步延遲，以便在返回發車格後排指定位置的過程中狂暴暖胎。

segments.en: A disastrous qualifying session left both Apex GP cars stranded in the bottom tier, forcing the engineers to rethink their entire race strategy overnight.
segments.zh: 災難性的排位賽讓兩輛彎心賽車雙雙陷入末流淘汰區，迫使工程師連夜重新審視並推翻全部比賽策略。

segments.en: Sacrificing one-lap qualifying pace allowed the team to preserve fresh sets of soft tires for a ferocious late-race sprint attack.
segments.zh: 犧牲排位賽的單圈極限速度，讓車隊得以保留多套全新的軟胎，以備在正賽末段發起猛烈衝刺。

segments.en: Max Verstappen claimed pole position with an untouchable lap time, leaving the rest of the competitive field scrambling for second best.
segments.zh: 馬克斯·維斯塔潘以無懈可擊的單圈成績奪得杆位，讓其餘競爭車手只能爭搶第二名的位置。

segments.en: Starting miles away from pole position did not discourage Sonny, who knew that race day strategy and chaos mattered far more than Saturday qualifying glory.
segments.zh: 從距離杆位千里之外的末尾起跑並未打擊桑尼的鬥志，他深知正賽策略與混亂局勢遠比週六的排位賽榮耀重要得多。

segments.en: Signing a sixty-year-old retired racer with a shattered spine was Ruben’s desperate Hail Mary pass to keep his beloved racing venture from extinction.
segments.zh: 簽下一位脊椎受過重創的六十歲退役老將，是魯本為了挽救心愛的賽車事業免於覆滅而投下的最後孤注一擲。

segments.en: Peter Banning sneered at the tactical gamble, mockingly asking Ruben if relying on a religious Hail Mary was his official commercial business model.
segments.zh: 彼得·班寧對這項戰術賭博嗤之以鼻，嘲諷地詢問魯本指望宗教式的孤注一擲難道就是他的官方商業模式嗎。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 51–60：inferno、binge、formation lap、cheeky、carve、dirty air、grip、reversed、pandemonium、eat concrete。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: The board derisively nicknamed the financially bleeding operation "Ruben's Inferno," pointing out that millions were being incinerated without yielding a single championship point.
segments.zh: 董事會嘲弄地將這項資金大量失血的營運稱為「魯本的人間煉獄」，指出數百萬資金被無情燒光卻換不回任何一個積分。

segments.en: Surviving the Spanish Grand Prix inferno decades ago had scarred Sonny mentally, leaving him haunted by the acrid smell of burning high-octane fuel.
segments.zh: 數十年前在西班牙大獎賽那場烈火地獄中倖存下來給桑尼留下了嚴重的精神創傷，讓他始終擺脫不了高辛烷值燃油燃燒的刺鼻氣味。

segments.en: The smug corporate investor boasted that he understood the intricacies of Formula 1 simply because he had managed to binge an entire season of Drive to Survive.
segments.zh: 那位自鳴得意的企業投資人誇口說他完全理解 F1 的複雜門道，僅僅因為他抽空一口氣刷完了一整季的《疾速爭勝》。

segments.en: Instead of studying tire degradation data, Joshua would stay up late to binge social media comments dissecting his rivalry with experienced drivers.
segments.zh: 約書亞沒有去鑽研輪胎磨損數據，反而熬夜狂刷社群評論，細看外界剖析他與老將車手競爭的言論。

segments.en: Sonny deliberately lagged behind the safety convoy during the formation lap, enabling him to violently weave across the asphalt and elevate his tire pressures.
segments.zh: 桑尼在暖胎圈期間故意落後於安全車隊列，這使他能在柏油路上激烈蛇行暖胎並提高胎壓。

segments.en: A failure to disengage launch control before the conclusion of the formation lap almost forced Sonny to forfeit his grid position entirely.
segments.zh: 在編隊暖胎圈結束前未能成功解除起跑控制模式，差點迫使桑尼完全喪失原有的發車格位置。

segments.en: Joshua shook his head in grudging amusement, muttering that Sonny's calculated formation lap delay was a cheeky stunt designed to exploit the tire heating rules.
segments.zh: 約書亞苦笑著搖搖頭，嘟囔著說桑尼故意拖延暖胎圈完全是個大膽厚臉皮的把戲，旨在鑽輪胎升溫規則的漏洞。

segments.en: Making a cheeky dive down the pit lane entry to snatch track position infuriated rival team managers who immediately demanded stewards investigate.
segments.zh: 在維修區入口處以厚臉皮的俯衝搶佔賽道身位，激怒了對手車隊經理，後者立即要求幹事介入調查。

segments.en: Exploiting the immediate grip of his warm compound tires, Sonny managed to carve his way through the congested tail-end pack within the opening lap.
segments.zh: 桑尼利用熱胎膠料帶來的即時抓地力，在開局第一圈就勢如破竹地切入擁擠的車尾陣營殺出重圍。

segments.en: The upgraded front wing allowed the black-and-gold machine to carve cleanly through high-speed turns without washing out into the turbulence.
segments.zh: 升級後的前翼讓這輛黑金賽車得以乾淨俐落地切過高速彎角，而不至於在擾動亂流中外拋失控。

segments.en: Tucking behind the charging Red Bull, Sonny radioed that the car was bucking uncontrollably due to the suffocating dirty air shedding from its massive rear diffuser.
segments.zh: 緊咬在狂飆的紅牛後方，桑尼用無線電通報賽車因其巨大後擴散器噴出的窒息性亂流而不可控地劇烈顛簸。

segments.en: Kate redesigned the floor venture tunnels specifically to ensure that Sonny could hunt within dirty air without incinerating his sensitive front tires.
segments.zh: 凱特專門重新設計了底板文氏管通道，以確保桑尼能在前車亂流中持續追擊而不至於燒毀脆弱的前輪。

segments.en: As the track temperature plummeted following the sudden overcast skies, Joshua screamed over the team radio that his worn tires had surrendered all mechanical grip.
segments.zh: 隨著突如其來的陰天導致賽道溫度暴跌，約書亞在車隊無線電中尖叫著回報磨損的輪胎已喪失了所有機械抓地力。

segments.en: Starting on cold, hard compound tires meant that Sonny possessed virtually zero cornering grip, leaving him vulnerable to immediate overtakes down the straights.
segments.zh: 使用冰冷的硬胎膠料起跑意味著桑尼幾乎沒有任何過彎抓地力，讓他在直道上極易被對手瞬間超車。

segments.en: A slow corner exit allowed Perez to reclaim the racing line, ensuring that their hard-fought positions were instantly reversed before reaching the next braking zone.
segments.zh: 糟糕的出彎速度讓佩雷茲奪回了行車線，確保雙方苦戰得來的名次在抵達下一個煞車區前瞬間顛倒翻轉。

segments.en: What seemed like a guaranteed double-podium finish was disastrously reversed when both cars suffered mechanical retirements within seconds of each other.
segments.zh: 原本看似板上釘釘的雙登上頒獎台局面，在兩輛賽車相隔數秒相繼機械故障退賽時，遭遇了災難性的驚天逆轉。

segments.en: When the jammed front jack collapsed during Sonny's scheduled pit stop, absolute pandemonium erupted among the frantic pit crew as valuable seconds vanished.
segments.zh: 當卡死的千斤頂在桑尼計畫內進站時突然脫落，維修站團隊陷入徹底的大混亂，寶貴的時間一秒秒流逝。

segments.en: A sudden torrential downpour unleashed total pandemonium across the pit lane as ten competing teams scrambled simultaneously to mount intermediate rain tires.
segments.zh: 一場突如其來的傾盆大雨在整個維修區通道引發了全場大混亂，十支競爭車隊同時爭先恐後地搶著換上半雨胎。

segments.en: Refusing to yield an inch along the main straight, Sonny squeezed Joshua against the old pit barrier, threatening to make his young teammate eat concrete.
segments.zh: 桑尼在主直道上寸步不讓，將約書亞死死擠在老舊的維修區防護欄旁，甚至威脅要讓這位年輕隊友直接撞上混凝土牆。

segments.en: "If you keep braking three car lengths too late into turn one, you’re eventually going to eat concrete," Kaspar warned the rookie during debrief.
segments.zh: 「如果你每次進一號彎都硬要晚三個車身距離煞車，你早晚會去撞混凝土牆的，」卡什帕在賽後檢討時警告新秀。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 61–70：give quarter、brawl、barrier、cardinal sin、DNF、wheel gun、swan、entitled、prick、piss-poor。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Locking wheels in a ferocious scrap for fifteenth position, neither Sonny nor Joshua was willing to give quarter to the other.
segments.zh: 為了爭奪第十五名而輪胎互蹭激烈廝殺時，桑尼和約書亞誰也不肯對彼此手下留情。

segments.en: Hamilton defended his racing line aggressively against the charging rookie, demonstrating that seven-time world champions give no quarter to emerging young stars.
segments.zh: 漢密爾頓強硬防守自己的行車線以抵擋來勢洶洶的新秀，用行動證明七屆世界冠軍絕不會對崛起的新星手下留情。

segments.en: What began as a routine Grand Prix rapidly degenerated into an untamed mechanical brawl as midfield cars violently banged side pods around Silverstone.
segments.zh: 原本一場例行的大獎賽迅速退化成一場野蠻的機械混戰，中游賽車在銀石賽道上瘋狂側箱碰撞。

segments.en: Heated words traded over the team radio nearly escalated into an ugly physical brawl inside the garage once the helmets were pulled off.
segments.zh: 在車手摘下安全帽後，無線電裡交換的激烈言辭差點在維修車庫內升級為一場難看的肢體互毆。

segments.en: Joshua lost rear traction on the damp kerb, spinning violently across the runoff area before burying the car deeply into the impact-absorbing barrier.
segments.zh: 約書亞在濕滑的路肩上喪失了後輪抓地力，賽車失控狂甩穿過緩衝區，隨後深深撞扁在吸能防護牆中。

segments.en: Marshals worked against the clock to reconstruct the smashed tire barrier, sweeping debris to allow the red-flagged Grand Prix to resume.
segments.zh: 賽道工作人員分秒必爭地搶修被撞爛的輪胎防護牆並清掃碎片，好讓出示紅旗暫停的大獎賽能重新恢復。

segments.en: Crashing into your own teammate while fighting over dead last is the absolute cardinal sin of professional motorsport, prompting furious fury from the pit wall.
segments.zh: 在爭奪最後一名的殘酷戰鬥中與自家隊友相撞，是職業賽車運動的絕對大忌，這引發了指揮台的滔天怒火。

segments.en: Ruben lectured the garage that failing to communicate sudden brake pressure loss over the radio was a cardinal sin that endangered human lives.
segments.zh: 魯本訓斥維修團隊，煞車油壓突然下降卻不及時透過無線電通報是拿人命開玩笑的致命大忌。

segments.en: A tragic double DNF at Silverstone extinguished any immediate hope of clawing their way out of last place in the Constructors' Championship.
segments.zh: 銀石賽道上雙雙未完賽（DNF）的悲劇，徹底粉碎了車隊在車隊積分榜上立即擺脫墊底局面的希望。

segments.en: Experiencing another humiliating DNF due to gearbox failure drove the frustrated rookie to storm out of the hospitality suite in tears.
segments.zh: 又一次因為變速箱故障而遭遇羞辱性的退賽（DNF），讓挫敗的新秀痛哭著奪門衝出招待中心。

segments.en: The flustered pit crew member dropped a high-torque wheel gun in the middle of the pit box, nearly puncturing Joshua's car as it departed.
segments.zh: 心慌意亂的後勤換胎人員將一把高扭矩氣動輪胎槍掉在維修槽正中央，差點在約書亞出站時刺破輪胎。

segments.en: Operating a pressurized wheel gun during a lightning-fast two-second pit stop requires razor-sharp reflexes and nerves of hardened steel.
segments.zh: 在短短兩秒極速進站期間精準操作高壓氣動輪胎槍，需要極為敏銳的反應神經與千錘百鍊的鋼鐵意志。

segments.en: Joshua sneered that Sonny had no right to swan into their garage acting like an entitled Grand Prix royalty after three decades of hiding.
segments.zh: 約書亞冷嘲熱諷地表示，桑尼在銷聲匿跡三十年後，根本沒資格拽得跟大獎賽貴族似的大搖大擺闖入他們的車庫。

segments.en: "Don't just swan into my engineering office without telemetry charts and expect me to magically build you a faster machine," Kate fired back.
segments.zh: 「少在那兩手空空連遙測圖表都不帶就拽兮兮地走進我的工程辦公室，還指望我能變魔術替你造一輛更快的車，」凱特毫不留情地回嗆。

segments.en: Having clawed his way up through lower junior formulas without corporate backing, Joshua despised drivers whom he perceived as wealthy, entitled outsiders.
segments.zh: 在沒有雄厚企業資助下一路靠自己從低階初級方程式殺上來的約書亞，極度鄙視那些在他眼中家境優渥、自命不凡的外來者。

segments.en: Sonny's refusal to follow direct team orders made him appear like an entitled prima donna to the hardworking mechanics slaving over his engine.
segments.zh: 桑尼拒絕服從車隊直接指令的舉動，讓那些為他引擎賣命苦幹的技師們覺得他就像個自命不凡、難以侍候的耍大牌巨星。

segments.en: Tempers flared violently in the motorhome as the hot-headed young driver screamed that their new veteran signing was nothing more than an arrogant prick.
segments.zh: 車隊房車裡的火藥味徹底引爆，急躁的年輕車手扯著嗓子狂吼，罵新簽約的老將不過是個目中無人的混帳東西。

segments.en: Despite knowing that the corporate investor was a scheming prick, Ruben maintained a polite facade to secure ongoing bridge loans for payroll.
segments.zh: 儘管深知那名企業投資人是個陰險的混帳東西，魯本表面上仍強顏歡笑以求爭取到過渡貸款來發放員工薪資。

segments.en: Disgusted by the qualifying pace, the driver bluntly told the media that the machine's high-speed mechanical grip was utterly piss-poor.
segments.zh: 對排位賽速度感到絕望的車手對媒體直言不諱，稱這輛車的高速機械抓地力簡直爛透了。

segments.en: Making piss-poor strategic calculations from the pit wall cost the racing outfit their only realistic opportunity of scoring championship points.
segments.zh: 指揮台做出的爛透戰術計算，讓這支車隊喪失了奪取錦標賽積分的唯一現實機會。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 71–80：participation trophy、demolish、humiliate、cocky、arrogant、fiasco、pull the plug、replicate、lateral、drag。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Sonny dismissed Joshua’s proud junior championship statistics, coldly noting that finishing tenth in modern motorsport was equivalent to a meaningless participation trophy.
segments.zh: 桑尼對約書亞引以為傲的青年組錦標賽戰績嗤之以鼻，冷酷地指出在現代賽車運動中拿到第十名不過等同於領一個毫無意義的參與獎。

segments.en: "I didn’t drag my broken body back into an F1 cockpit just to collect a patronizing participation trophy," Sonny snarled at Ruben.
segments.zh: 「我拖著這副殘破的身軀重返 F1 駕駛艙，可不是為了來領施捨般的參與獎的，」桑尼對魯本怒吼道。

segments.en: Ruben clutched his temples in sheer horror after watching his substitute driver aggressively demolish both multi-million-dollar race cars into the Silverstone barriers.
segments.zh: 看著替補車手在銀石防護牆上把兩輛價值數百萬美元的賽車撞得稀爛報廢，魯本驚恐地抱頭抓狂。

segments.en: Upgrading the combat aerodynamic package allowed Sonny to demolish his previous sector benchmarks by almost half a second per lap.
segments.zh: 全面升級戰鬥空氣動力學套件後，桑尼將自己先前的計時段基準成績每圈大幅摧毀並縮短了將近半秒。

segments.en: Sonny sarcastically asked Ruben whether he had dragged him out of retirement simply to humiliate him on live international television before millions of spectators.
segments.zh: 桑尼冷嘲熱諷地問魯本，把他挖出山難道只是為了讓他在數百萬全球觀眾收看的電視直播前自取其辱。

segments.en: To humiliate the rookie who had insulted him at the press conference, Sonny executed a breathtaking dummy overtake around the outside kerb.
segments.zh: 為了洗刷在記者會上被新秀羞辱的怨氣，桑尼在外側路肩上演了一記令人拍案叫絕的假動作超車。

segments.en: Behind Joshua’s cocky demeanor lay deep-seated insecurity, terrified that losing his seat would force him into lower-tier racing irrelevance.
segments.zh: 在約書亞自大狂妄的外表之下隱藏著深深的自卑，他極度恐懼失去車手席位會迫使自己淪落到低階賽事的無名小卒。

segments.en: Ruben reminded Sonny that he had been equally arrogant and cocky when he first burst onto the Grand Prix scene thirty years prior.
segments.zh: 魯本提醒桑尼，三十年前當他初次闖入大獎賽舞台時，他同樣也是這般傲慢與狂妄自大。

segments.en: The young rookie refused to seek advice from senior mechanics, displaying an arrogant attitude that alienated the entire engineering department.
segments.zh: 這位年輕新秀拒絕向資深技師請益，展現出傲慢無比的態度，孤立了整個工程團隊。

segments.en: Underestimating veteran drivers on tricky wet surfaces was an arrogant mistake that ultimately cost Joshua a guaranteed podium finish.
segments.zh: 在複雜濕滑的路面上低估老牌車手的實力是一個傲慢的致命失誤，最終讓約書亞痛失了穩拿的頒獎台席位。

segments.en: What was supposed to be a triumphant home Grand Prix rapidly turned into an embarrassing public relations fiasco following the intra-team collision.
segments.zh: 原本預期會是一場凱旋的主場大獎賽，在隊內自相殘殺的相撞事故後，迅速演變為一場令人難堪的公關大鬧劇。

segments.en: The team principal demanded immediate operational changes to prevent their chaotic pit stop blunders from repeating this humiliating fiasco.
segments.zh: 車隊領隊要求立即進行營運改革，以防止混亂的進站失誤再次重演這場屈辱的徹底潰敗。

segments.en: Facing relentless financial bleeding, the board warned Ruben that they would pull the plug on Apex GP unless performance improved immediately.
segments.zh: 面對持續無底洞般的財務失血，董事會向魯本發出最後通牒，除非成績立即起色，否則他們將對彎心車隊徹底拔管中止資助。

segments.en: Fearful that devastating medical reports would leak to authorities, the team owner almost decided to pull the plug on Sonny's contract before qualifying.
segments.zh: 擔心桑尼觸目驚心的體檢報告會洩漏給主管機關，車隊老闆在排位賽前差點痛下決心終止他的參賽合約。

segments.en: Wind tunnel testing can evaluate straight-line drag, but it can never truly replicate the dynamic turbulent air experienced when tailgating another car.
segments.zh: 風洞測試固然能評估直線阻力，但它永遠無法真實複製緊跟前車時所體驗到的動態擾動亂流。

segments.en: Engineers struggled to replicate the mysterious telemetry glitch on the simulator that had crippled their car’s differential during sector three.
segments.zh: 工程師們在模擬器上絞盡腦汁，試圖重現那個在第三計時段徹底癱瘓賽車差速器的神祕遙測故障。

segments.en: Modern Formula 1 drivers endure immense lateral g-forces through sweeping curves, requiring months of rigorous neck conditioning to avoid blackout.
segments.zh: 現代 F1 車手在高速連續彎中必須承受巨大的橫向 G 力，這需要數月極度嚴苛的頸部抗壓訓練以防止黑視昏迷。

segments.en: Kate adjusted the floor strakes to maximize lateral aerodynamic grip without compromising the machine's maximum straight-line terminal velocity.
segments.zh: 凱特調整了底板導流葉片，以最大化橫向空氣動力學抓地力，同時絲毫不犧牲賽車的直線末端極速。

segments.en: Trimming excess downforce off the rear wing dramatically reduced aerodynamic drag, providing Sonny with the straight-line speed needed to overtake on the straights.
segments.zh: 削去後尾翼多餘的下壓力顯著降低了空氣阻力，為桑尼提供了在長直道上實施超車所需的直線尾速。

segments.en: The bulky side pod cooling ducts generated massive aerodynamic drag, handicapping their acceleration out of every medium-speed corner.
segments.zh: 笨重的側箱散熱進氣口產生了巨大的空氣阻力，嚴重拖累了賽車從每個中速彎出彎時的加速表現。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 81–90：turbulent、ambient、imply、clutch at straws、has-been、never-was、steadfast、disloyal、husk、combat。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Chasing directly behind high-downforce rivals blankets the following car in violently turbulent air that destroys tire life within laps.
segments.zh: 直接尾隨高下壓力的對手會讓後車被狂暴的動盪亂流完全籠罩，在幾圈之內就會徹底摧毀輪胎壽命。

segments.en: Kate worked miracles to reshape the vortex generators so the chassis could slice cleanly through turbulent wakes without destabilizing its rear axle.
segments.zh: 凱特展現奇蹟重新調整了渦流發生器的形狀，讓底盤得以乾淨地切過亂流尾流，而不至於動搖後軸的穩定性。

segments.en: High ambient temperatures across the desert track threatened to cook the delicate hybrid power units unless drivers managed cooling windows conservatively.
segments.zh: 沙漠賽道酷熱的環境溫度極有可能烤焦脆弱的混合動力單元，除非車手保守控制散熱時機。

segments.en: Factoring shifting ambient conditions into their computational strategy allowed the engineers to predict the exact window when slick tires would fall off the cliff.
segments.zh: 將變幻莫測的周遭環境條件納入運算策略，讓工程師得以精準預測光頭胎抓地力斷崖式崩解的確切時間點。

segments.en: "Don't try to sugarcoat your technical criticisms or imply that I don't belong here," Kate warned Sonny during their first debrief.
segments.zh: 「少在那拐彎抹角修飾你的技術批評，或是暗指我不配待在這裡，」凱特在第一次檢討會上警告桑尼。

segments.en: When reporters began to imply that Ruben was deliberately favoring the veteran driver, Joshua walked out of the press briefing in anger.
segments.zh: 當記者開始暗指魯本正偏袒老將車手時，約書亞憤怒地直接甩手走出新聞簡報室。

segments.en: Rival team principals openly mocked Ruben's signing of Sonny, claiming that hiring a sixty-year-old was the desperate move of a man clutching at straws.
segments.zh: 競爭對手車隊領隊公開嘲諷魯本簽下桑尼的舉動，聲稱僱用一名六十歲老將完全是一個溺水者抓住最後救命稻草的垂死掙扎。

segments.en: Running radical fuel loads and questionable tire pressures proved that the technical crew was blindly clutching at straws to find lap time.
segments.zh: 採取極端的載油量和令人費解的胎壓設定，證明技術團隊為了擠出圈速已經在盲目地抓最後救命稻草。

segments.en: Tabloids cruelly dismissed Sonny as an washed-up has-been whose glory days had vanished into the rearview mirror of motorsport history decades ago.
segments.zh: 八卦小報無情地將桑尼貶低為一個過氣的廢料，稱他的光輝歲月早在數十年前就已消失在賽車歷史的後照鏡中。

segments.en: Determined to prove he was far more than an irrelevant has-been, Sonny drove the wheels off the machine during the final sprint laps.
segments.zh: 桑尼決心證明自己絕非一個毫無價值的過氣人物，在最後衝刺幾圈中他竭盡全力將賽車性能壓榨到極致。

segments.en: Sonny admitted with biting honesty that critics didn't even view him as a fallen champion, but rather as an unfulfilled never-was who choked his big chance.
segments.zh: 桑尼以極其自嘲的坦誠承認，批評家甚至都不把他當作隕落的冠軍，而是將他視為一個砸了絕佳機會、從未真正成功過的小人物。

segments.en: Refusing to let his legacy be carved out as a tragic never-was, the aged driver put his health on the line to chase a solitary Grand Prix win.
segments.zh: 老將拒絕讓自己的歷史評價定格為一個悲劇性的無名小卒，他不惜賭上個人健康也要追逐一場真正的大獎賽分站冠軍。

segments.en: Despite relentless pressure from predatory corporate investors, Ruben remained steadfast in his loyalty toward his beleaguered engineering staff.
segments.zh: 儘管面對來自掠奪性企業投資人無情的施壓，魯本對身處困境的工程團隊依舊保持著堅定不移的忠誠。

segments.en: Sonny's steadfast refusal to yield track position to faster machinery allowed his young teammate to consolidate a safe gap out in front.
segments.zh: 桑尼堅定不移地拒絕將賽道位置讓給更快的後車，讓他的年輕隊友得以在前方穩穩拉開安全領先優勢。

segments.en: Joshua considered it deeply disloyal when rumors suggested his management was secretly shopping his talents to rival outfits behind Ruben’s back.
segments.zh: 當傳出經紀團隊背著魯本暗中向競爭對手兜售自己的天賦時，約書亞認為這是一種極度不忠的背叛行徑。

segments.en: Leaking confidential aerodynamic blueprints to the governing body was a disloyal act designed by Peter Banning to force a team bankruptcy sale.
segments.zh: 將機密的空氣動力學藍圖洩露給主管機關，是彼得·班寧為了強行促成車隊破產賤賣而精心策劃的不忠背叛。

segments.en: After the devastating crash in Spain stole his future, Sonny wandered through life for years as an angry, empty husk of the man he once was.
segments.zh: 在西班牙那場毀滅性的撞車事故偷走了未來之後，桑尼長年漫無目的地在生活中遊蕩，淪為一個滿腔怒火、徒有其表的空洞軀殼。

segments.en: The grueling sixty-lap battle under suffocating desert heat reduced the physically unprepared rookie to an exhausted husk inside the cockpit.
segments.zh: 在窒息般的沙漠酷熱下進行的六十圈嚴酷鏖戰，讓體能準備不足的新秀在座艙裡累癱成了一具毫無生氣的軀殼。

segments.en: Realizing they lacked straight-line velocity, Kate declared that their upgraded aerodynamics would transform their machine into a weapon forged purely for corner combat.
segments.zh: 意識到缺乏直線極速後，凱特宣布他們升級後的空氣動力學將把這台賽車打造成一把專為彎道搏殺格鬥而鍛造的致命武器。

segments.en: Wheel-to-wheel combat in dirty air demands complete spatial awareness, unyielding bravery, and utter trust between competing drivers.

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 91–100：rough-and-tumble、lone wolf、relentlessly、plunge、debris、severe、red flag、tire deg、medium、puncture。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Having cut his teeth on dusty dirt ovals and desert endurance runs, Sonny approached modern Formula 1 with a rough-and-tumble swagger that terrified technicians.
segments.zh: 在塵土飛揚的泥地橢圓賽道和沙漠耐力賽中歷練成長，桑尼帶著一種讓技術人員心驚膽戰的粗獷頑強姿態踏入了現代 F1 的殿堂。

segments.en: Modern motorsport has sanitized the paddock, leaving little room for the rough-and-tumble characters who once dominated Grand Prix racing in decades past.
segments.zh: 現代賽車運動已過度精緻與商業化，幾乎再無空間容納幾十年前曾統治大獎賽舞台的那些粗獷不羈的硬漢角色。

segments.en: Kate bluntly scolded Sonny that modern Formula 1 was an interdependent engineering collective, leaving no room for a selfish lone wolf who ignored protocols.
segments.zh: 凱特直截了當地訓斥桑尼，現代 F1 是一項環環相扣的工程團隊運動，絕不容許無視規範、特立獨行的自私獨狼肆意妄為。

segments.en: Acting like a stubborn lone wolf on track nearly cost Sonny his life when he refused to follow emergency instructions radioed from the pit wall.
segments.zh: 在賽道上表現得像個頑固的獨行俠差點讓桑尼送命，因為他固執地拒絕聽從維修區指揮台透過無線電發出的緊急避險指令。

segments.en: Lap after lap, Sonny relentlessly hunted down the race leaders, shaving hundredths of a second through every apex despite suffering agonizing back spasms.
segments.zh: 一圈又一圈，儘管飽受背部劇烈抽筋的折磨，桑尼依然在每個彎心無情地削去百分之幾秒，殘酷而不懈地追擊前方領先者。

segments.en: Red Bull developed their aerodynamic packages relentlessly throughout the season, leaving midfield constructors gasping to match their development curve.
segments.zh: 紅牛車隊在整個賽季中不懈地瘋狂研發空力套件，讓中游車隊只能望洋興嘆，難以企及他們的研發進化速度。

segments.en: Television cameras caught the terrifying moment when Sonny's rear wing snapped, sending the car plunging off into the barrier at full racing speed.
segments.zh: 電視攝影機捕捉到了令人膽戰心驚的瞬間：桑尼的後尾翼突然斷裂，導致賽車以全油門速度瞬間疾衝出賽道直撞防護欄。

segments.en: Team revenues would plunge catastrophically into the red if they failed to salvage a top-ten championship finish before the season concluded.
segments.zh: 如果無法在賽季結束前搶進錦標賽積分前十名，車隊營收將遭遇災難性的斷崖式暴跌並深陷巨額赤字。

segments.en: Carbon fiber debris littered the circuit following the massive turn-one pileup, instantly triggering safety car boards to protect recovering marshals.
segments.zh: 在一號彎發生大規模連環追撞後，碳纖維殘骸碎片散落了整座賽道，賽會立即亮起安全車指示牌以保護清理現場的賽道人員。

segments.en: Running over razor-sharp carbon debris sliced Joshua’s right rear tire, ruining his chances of converting a brilliant start into a Grand Prix podium.
segments.zh: 碾過鋒利如刀片的碳纖維殘骸刺破了約書亞的右後輪，摧毀了他將絕佳起跑轉化為大獎賽頒獎台席位的機會。

segments.en: Doctors warned that a single severe impact trauma to Sonny’s fragile cervical spine would result in permanent paralysis or instant fatal injury.
segments.zh: 醫生嚴肅警告，桑尼脆弱的頸椎只要再遭受一次嚴重的鈍性撞擊創傷，都將導致終身癱瘓或立即致命的危險。

segments.en: The stewards slapped the aggressive driver with a severe ten-second stop-and-go penalty for causing an avoidable collision entering the hairpin.
segments.zh: 幹事對該名激進車手處以極為嚴厲的十秒停站受罰（stop-and-go），理由是他在進入髮卡彎時引發了完全可避免的碰撞。

segments.en: When heavy wreckage completely blocked the narrow pit straight, race control had no choice but to wave the red flag and halt running immediately.
segments.zh: 當巨大的賽車殘骸徹底封死狹窄的維修區直道時，賽事控制中心別無選擇，只能揮舞紅旗立即暫停全場比賽。

segments.en: The unexpected red flag presented Apex GP with a golden lifeline, granting their battered mechanics ten crucial minutes to reconstruct the shattered rear suspension.
segments.zh: 突如其來的紅旗給彎心車隊送上了一道寶貴的救命稻草，給了滿身大汗的技師十分鐘關鍵時間去搶修被撞碎的後懸吊系統。

segments.en: Running high downforce setups through the abrasive curves generated extreme tire deg, rendering soft tires virtually undriveable after eight aggressive laps.
segments.zh: 在高磨損性的彎道中採用高下壓力設定引發了極端的輪胎衰退，使得軟胎在激烈狂飆八圈後幾乎完全喪失抓地力而無法駕馭。

segments.en: Sonny's masterful throttle manipulation mitigated severe tire deg, enabling him to extend his second stint far beyond rival strategic calculations.
segments.zh: 桑尼對油門出神入化的細膩掌控有效延緩了嚴重的輪胎磨損衰退，使他得以將第二輪駕駛圈數拉長，遠超對手戰術團隊的預期。

segments.en: Starting on the yellow-striped medium compound provided Joshua with the ideal compromise between early-race grip and extended stint durability.
segments.zh: 選用黃色胎壁標記的中性胎起跑，為約書亞在比賽初期的抓地力與長里程的耐久度之間提供了最理想的平衡。

segments.en: The strategic model dictated a medium-to-hard one-stop execution, assuming track temperatures remained stable throughout the afternoon.
segments.zh: 戰術數據模型顯示應採用中性胎轉硬胎的一停策略，前提是賽道溫度在整個下午能保持穩定不變。

segments.en: A sudden rear tire puncture forced Sonny to crawl into the pit lane on three wheels, showering sparks across the asphalt as rivals streaked past.
segments.zh: 後輪突如其來的爆胎迫使桑尼只能靠三個輪子步履蹣跚地爬回維修區，當對手呼嘯而過時，底盤在柏油路上摩擦爆出漫天火花。

segments.en: Grazing the concrete wall at over two hundred miles per hour triggered an instantaneous catastrophic puncture that sent the chassis violently careening across the grass.
segments.zh: 在時速超過兩百英里下擦碰到混凝土牆引發了瞬間的毀滅性爆胎，將底盤粗暴地甩出賽道在草地上狂暴打轉。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 101–110：clumsy、safety car、dagnabbit、back marker、blue flag、penalty、chip in、sub、rope-a-dope、demolition derby。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Sonny executed a clumsy dive down the inside of Kevin Magnussen, misjudging the braking marker and shearing off his own front wing endplate.
segments.zh: 桑尼對凱文·馬格努森發起了一次拙劣笨拙的內線強攻，因誤判煞車標誌而直接削掉了自家的前翼端板。

segments.en: Professional commentators criticized the clumsy wheel-banging as amateurish driving unworthy of an experienced Grand Prix veteran.
segments.zh: 專業賽事評論員批評那次笨拙的輪胎擦撞完全是不入流的業餘駕駛行為，根本配不上大獎賽老將的身分。

segments.en: The deployment of the safety car compressed the entire field, erasing Verstappen’s massive fifteen-second lead and gifting Apex GP a free pit stop.
segments.zh: 安全車的出動壓縮了全場車陣的間距，瞬間抹平了維斯塔潘原本巨大的十五秒領先優勢，並送給彎心車隊一次免費進站的良機。

segments.en: Knowing that their worn tires would never survive another restart, the strategists prayed for a late-race safety car to salvage their points finish.
segments.zh: 深知磨損的輪胎絕不可能撐過又一次重啟，戰術師們暗自祈禱比賽末段能出現安全車來保住他們的積分完賽席位。

segments.en: "Dagnabbit, I completely misread his turn-in angle and ruined our front downforce," Sonny muttered angrily over the team radio.
segments.zh: 「該死，我完全看錯了他的進彎角度，把我們的前下壓力全搞砸了，」桑尼在車隊無線電中氣急敗壞地咕噥道。

segments.en: The chief mechanic kicked a tire stack and shouted "dagnabbit" when the electronic telemetry screen suddenly flickered and went entirely dark.
segments.zh: 當電子遙測螢幕突然閃爍並徹底變黑時，首席技師狠狠踢了一腳輪胎堆並大罵了一聲「可惡」。

segments.en: Struggling as a lonely back marker after his unscheduled pit stop, Sonny found himself trapped a lap down behind the race leaders.
segments.zh: 在無預警進站後淪為孤獨的落後慢車，桑尼發現自己已經被前方領跑集團套了一整圈。

segments.en: Bottas grew increasingly infuriated behind the stubborn back marker who aggressively defended his line despite waving blue flags.
segments.zh: 博塔斯在前方那輛頑固的慢速後排車身後愈發抓狂，因為儘管藍旗狂揮，對方依然頑強死守行車線。

segments.en: The stewards threatened Sonny with an immediate time penalty if he ignored a third consecutive blue flag and continued holding up the charging leaders.
segments.zh: 賽會幹事威脅桑尼，若他膽敢無視連續揮出的第三面藍旗並繼續阻擋狂飆的領跑車輛，將對他祭出立即罰秒。

segments.en: Sonny deliberately timed his compliance with the blue flag, backing off just enough to dump Max Verstappen directly into suffocating dirty air.
segments.zh: 桑尼刻意精算服從藍旗讓路的時間點，剛好卡準時機減速，直接將馬克斯·維斯塔潘甩進令人窒息的亂流之中。

segments.en: Exceeding pit lane speed limits by a fraction of a kilometer resulted in a costly five-second time penalty that ruined Joshua’s track position.
segments.zh: 進站通道超速不到一公里導致了代價慘重的五秒罰秒，徹底摧毀了約書亞苦心爭取到的賽道排位優勢。

segments.en: Sonny willingly risked a post-race technical penalty because securing a solitary championship point meant everything to the bankrupt racing outfit.
segments.zh: 桑尼甘願冒著賽後遭受技術判罰的風險，因為對這支瀕臨破產的車隊而言，搶下一個錦標賽積分便意味著一切。

segments.en: With front wings costing over two hundred thousand pounds each, the team principal sarcastically suggested that Sonny should chip in for replacements.
segments.zh: 前翼每支造價超過二十萬英鎊，車隊領隊冷嘲熱諷地建議桑尼應該自掏腰包分擔更換零件的費用。

segments.en: Every mechanic agreed to chip in their weekend rest hours, working around the clock to weld a reinforced chassis for the season finale.
segments.zh: 全體技師一致同意犧牲週末休息時間全力支援，夜以繼日地趕工焊接，為收官戰打造加固底盤。

segments.en: Achieving a blistering sub-three-second pit stop was the mandatory requirement if Joshua hoped to retain tenth place ahead of the chasing Aston Martin.
segments.zh: 若約書亞希望能守在追擊的阿斯頓馬丁之前保住第十名，換胎團隊就必須完成低於三秒的極速進站。

segments.en: The aerodynamic upgrade generated sub-optimal straight-line speed, but its staggering downforce in the sweeping bends astonished telemetry engineers.
segments.zh: 空力升級在直線極速上表現略遜一籌（sub-optimal），但其在高速連續彎中展現的驚人下壓力讓遙測工程師目瞪口呆。

segments.en: Don Cavendish accused Sonny of playing a cynical rope-a-dope strategy at Silverstone, intentionally faking mechanical distress to cause late-race chaos.
segments.zh: 唐·卡文迪許指責桑尼在銀石賽道使出了陰險的誘敵消耗戰術（rope-a-dope），故意偽裝機械故障以製造比賽末段的混亂局勢。

segments.en: Sonny deployed a classic boxing rope-a-dope on the asphalt, absorbing relentless pressure on worn tires until his opponent burned out his front brakes.
segments.zh: 桑尼在賽道上完美演繹了經典的拳擊防守反擊戰術，頂著磨損胎承受狂轟濫炸般的施壓，直到對手耗盡前煞車性能。

segments.en: Outraged rival directors protested that Sonny had transformed an elite Grand Prix into an embarrassing, destructive demolition derby.
segments.zh: 狂怒的競爭車隊總監抗議桑尼將殿堂級的大獎賽變成了一場難堪且毀滅性的撞車破壞大賽。

segments.en: What was supposed to be a showcase of precision aerodynamic engineering degenerated into a chaotic demolition derby amidst treacherous rainy conditions.
segments.zh: 原本預期是一場精密空力工程的展示秀，在險惡的雨戰條件下卻徹底淪為一場混亂的撞車秀。
