articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 111–120：steward、aerospace、skirt the line、gray area、keep tabs on、DRS train、undercut、neutralize、virtual safety car、chicane。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Summoned to the head office after the collision, Sonny sat stone-faced while the chief steward reviewed high-definition onboard replays of turn one.
segments.zh: 在相撞事故後被傳喚至幹事辦公室，當首席監管幹事重放一號彎的高畫質車載畫面時，桑尼全程面無表情地坐在那裡。

segments.en: The stewards spent hours deliberating telemetry traces before officially ruling that the contact was a normal racing incident requiring no sanctions.
segments.zh: 幹事們花費數小時仔細研讀遙測曲線，隨後才正式裁定那次碰撞屬於常規競賽意外，無須追加任何處罰。

segments.en: Kate leveraged her extensive background in aerospace engineering to design structural underfloor tunnels that maintained ground effect under extreme yaw angles.
segments.zh: 凱特利用自己在航空航天工程領域的深厚背景，設計出能在極端偏航角下維持地面效應的底板文氏管結構。

segments.en: Transitioning from high-security aerospace projects to the pressure-cooker environment of Formula 1 proved both exhilarating and exhausting for the technical director.
segments.zh: 從高保密的航太工程計畫轉戰至高壓鍋般的 F1 賽場，對這位技術總監而言既令人血脈賁張又讓人身心俱疲。

segments.en: Throughout his volatile racing career, Sonny was notorious for his ability to skirt the line of technical regulations without suffering direct disqualification.
segments.zh: 在跌宕起伏的賽車生涯中，桑尼以游走在技術規則邊緣卻能全身而退未被直接取消資格的本領而聞名。

segments.en: Designing flexible wing edges allowed the team to skirt the line between legal aerodynamic deflection and banned active aerodynamic surfaces.
segments.zh: 設計具彈性的尾翼邊緣讓車隊得以遊走在合法空力形變與違規主動空力裝置的危險邊界上。

segments.en: Elite aerodynamicists thrive within the regulatory gray area, exploiting ambiguities in the FIA rulebook to unlock precious tenths of lap time.
segments.zh: 頂尖空氣動力學家擅長在規則的灰色地帶遊刃有餘，利用 FIA 規章中的含糊漏洞搾取寶貴的每圈零點幾秒優勢。

segments.en: Zak Brown noted that Sonny always operated inside the sport's murky gray area, manipulating sporting ethics to gain an unfair tactical advantage.
segments.zh: 扎克·布朗指出桑尼總是活動在運動規則的曖昧灰色地帶，操弄體育道德藉此獲取不公平的戰術優勢。

segments.en: The race engineer instructed Joshua to keep tabs on Sonny's sector splits, using the veteran’s reference points to improve his own throttle application.
segments.zh: 比賽工程師指示約書亞盯緊桑尼的各計時段分段時間，利用老將的參考點來修正自己的出彎油門踩踏點。

segments.en: Rival team telemetry analysts kept close tabs on Apex GP’s straight-line traps, suspecting that their sudden pace surge stemmed from illegal fuel flow.
segments.zh: 競爭對手的遙測分析師緊盯彎心車隊的直線尾速數據，懷疑他們速度的突然暴衝源自違法超額燃油噴射。

segments.en: Trapped in a frustrating DRS train behind four identically paced midfield machines, Sonny found it physically impossible to execute an overtake into turn four.
segments.zh: 被困在由四輛速度完全相同的中游賽車所組成的 DRS 高速車串中，桑尼發現想在四號彎實施超車在物理上根本辦不到。

segments.en: By backing up the chasing pack into a suffocating DRS train, Sonny successfully shielded his young teammate from being swallowed up by faster machinery.
segments.zh: 透過壓慢後方車陣形成窒息般的 DRS 車串，桑尼成功掩護了前方年輕隊友，使其未被後方速度更快的頂級賽車吞噬。

segments.en: Anticipating an aggressive undercut from Ferrari, the pit wall summoned Joshua a lap earlier to ensure he rejoined the asphalt ahead of Sainz.
segments.zh: 預判到法拉利將發動激進的搶先進站戰術（undercut），指揮台提前一圈將約書亞召回，以確保他出站時能穩穩卡在塞恩斯身前。

segments.en: Pulling off a successful undercut requires delivering an immaculate, qualifying-style in-lap on shredded, freezing rubber.
segments.zh: 想要成功發動進站超車戰術，車手就必須在磨爛且冰冷的輪胎狀態下跑出毫無瑕疵、如同排位賽般的進站圈。

segments.en: Waving double yellow flags effectively neutralized the fierce dogfight between the leading contenders, forcing every car to hold relative delta times.
segments.zh: 雙黃旗的揮舞有效地凍結中立化了領跑競爭者之間的激烈纏鬥，迫使所有賽車必須保持固定的相對速差時間。

segments.en: The race director chose to neutralize the race under virtual safety car conditions while heavy machinery cleared fractured suspension pieces from the racing line.
segments.zh: 賽事總監決定在虛擬安全車條件下將比賽進入中立化階段，同時調動重型吊車從行車線上清理斷裂的懸吊碎片。

segments.en: As the glowing virtual safety car delta lit up the digital steering wheel display, Sonny immediately eased off the throttle to avoid a severe timing penalty.
segments.zh: 當數位方向盤螢幕亮起虛擬安全車（VSC）速差警告時，桑尼立即鬆開油門，以免遭受嚴厲的超速計時處罰。

segments.en: Diving into the pit lane during a sudden virtual safety car period saved Apex GP nearly ten seconds compared to pitting under green-flag racing conditions.
segments.zh: 在突如其來的虛擬安全車期間拐入維修區，相比全場綠旗爭先狀態下進站，替彎心車隊省下了將近十秒的時間。

segments.en: Bouncing violently over the raised serrated kerbs of the final chicane damaged the delicate floor edges of Sonny's black-and-gold chassis.
segments.zh: 在最後的減速雙急彎處狂暴彈跳輾過凸起的鋸齒路肩，撞壞了桑尼這輛黑金底盤脆弱的底板邊緣。

segments.en: The two rival contenders went wheel-to-wheel into the tight Monza chicane, neither driver willing to yield the apex before catastrophic contact occurred.
segments.zh: 兩位競爭對手並排殺入狹窄的蒙札連續雙急彎，在發生災難性碰撞之前，誰都不肯讓出彎心半步。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 121–130：disapproval、intermediate tire、slicks、dry line、tow、slipstream、slingshot、striking distance、stable、inevitable。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Max Verstappen waved a furious fist of disapproval from his cockpit after Sonny aggressively slammed the door shut into the braking zone.
segments.zh: 在桑尼於煞車區強勢關門阻擋後，馬克斯·維斯塔潘在座艙內憤怒地揮舞拳頭表達強烈不滿。

segments.en: Bernadette’s icy silence conveyed profound maternal disapproval regarding her son’s willingness to risk life and limb for corporate racing applause.
segments.zh: 伯納黛特冰冷的沉默傳達了一位母親深深的斥責與不滿，痛心兒子竟然為了企業的賽車喝采而不惜拿命去賭。

segments.en: With dark storm clouds breaking over the circuit, the pit wall frantically debated whether the asphalt was wet enough to justify switching to inters.
segments.zh: 隨著烏雲在賽道上方炸裂，指揮台陷入激烈爭辯，研判柏油路面是否已經濕到足以換上半雨胎（inters）。

segments.en: Sonny's intermediate tires rapidly overheated and disintegrated into melted rubber shreds once the afternoon sun dried out the racing line.
segments.zh: 當午後的陽光曬乾了行車線後，桑尼換上的半雨胎迅速過熱，並融化解體成滿地的橡膠碎屑。

segments.en: Gamblers who chose to brave the treacherous greasy drizzle on grooveless slicks found themselves sliding helplessly off the asphalt like curling stones.
segments.zh: 那些冒險頂著油滑細雨堅持使用無溝槽光頭胎（slicks）的賭徒們，發現自己如同冰壺般無助地滑出柏油路面。

segments.en: If Joshua could nurse his fragile slicks along the single dry asphalt groove, he stood a genuine chance of stealing a sensational podium finish.
segments.zh: 如果約書亞能護著脆弱的光頭胎沿著僅存的一條乾地走線苦撐，他就有極大機會爆冷偷下一座令人震撼的頒獎台。

segments.en: Straying mere millimeters off the narrow dry line in the wet immediately pitched Sonny's rear tires into standing water, triggering a high-speed spin.
segments.zh: 在雨戰中哪怕偏離狹窄的乾地行車線幾毫米，都會讓桑尼的後輪瞬間壓上積水，引發高速打轉。

segments.en: Drivers carefully searched the damp edges of the circuit to cool their blistering tires before diving back onto the rubbered-in dry line.
segments.zh: 車手們小心翼翼地尋找賽道邊緣潮濕的積水處冷卻起泡的輪胎，隨後才重新切回滿佈橡膠的乾地走線上。

segments.en: Sonny sacrificed his own qualifying sector time by running ahead of Joshua along the back straight, providing his rookie teammate with a massive aerodynamic tow.
segments.zh: 桑尼在後直道上跑在約書亞前方，透過犧牲自己的排位計時段成績，為這位新秀隊友提供了巨大的破風牽引（tow）。

segments.en: Latching onto the tow of the slipstreaming Mercedes allowed the underpowered Apex GP machine to punch far above its weight in sector one.
segments.zh: 死死咬住前方奔馳賽車的破風牽引，讓這輛動力偏弱的彎心賽車得以在第一計時段爆發出遠超水準的驚人表現。

segments.en: Tucking deeply inside the low-pressure pocket of Sonny's slipstream, Joshua watched his digital speed readout jump past two hundred and ten miles per hour.
segments.zh: 深深潛入桑尼尾流的低壓區內，約書亞看著數位儀表上的速度讀數瞬間飆破了時速兩百一十英里。

segments.en: Blinding water spray kicked up by the lead car's diffuser transformed driving in the slipstream into a terrifying act of blind faith.
segments.zh: 前車擴散器捲起遮天蔽日的漫天水霧，讓在尾流中跟車飛馳變成了一場拿命去搏的盲開賭局。

segments.en: Timing his steering input with millimeter precision, Joshua pulled out of Sonny’s wake to slingshot past him on the approach to turn one.
segments.zh: 將方向盤轉向時機精算到毫米級精度，約書亞猛地抽離桑尼的尾流，在逼近一號彎時如彈弓般彈射超車飛掠而過。

segments.en: Sonny used the slingshot maneuver to sweep past the stunned Ferrari around the outside of the banked Curva Grande.
segments.zh: 桑尼利用尾流彈射動作，在帶有傾角的大圓弧彎（Curva Grande）外側乾淨俐落地刷過了目瞪口呆的法拉利。

segments.en: Closing the gap to half a second brought Joshua within striking distance of race leader Lewis Hamilton as the final laps ticked down.
segments.zh: 隨著最後幾圈倒數計時，將差距縮小至半秒讓約書亞進入了對領跑者劉易斯·漢密爾頓發動致命進攻的攻擊範圍之內。

segments.en: A flawless battery deployment strategy kept the underdog car within striking distance of the podium all the way through the final sector.
segments.zh: 無懈可擊的電能釋放策略，讓這輛黑馬賽車一路緊咬在頒獎台席位觸手可及的攻擊範圍內，直到通過最後計時段。

segments.en: Hospital officials confirmed to anxious reporters that Joshua was in stable condition, resting peacefully after undergoing treatment for severe hand burns.
segments.zh: 醫院主管向焦慮的媒體證實約書亞目前生命體徵穩定，在接受了嚴重的雙手燒傷救治後正平靜休養。

segments.en: Kate redesigned the floor vortex generators to ensure that the car's aerodynamic downforce remained predictable and stable under heavy braking.
segments.zh: 凱特重新設計了底板渦流產生器，以確保賽車在重踩煞車時空氣動力學下壓力依然保持平穩且可預測。

segments.en: Pushing worn wet tires on a bone-dry racing line made catastrophic tread delamination an inevitable conclusion for the stubborn driver.
segments.zh: 用磨損嚴重的雨胎在完全乾透的行車線上狂操，對那名頑固的車手而言，胎面徹底脫膠解體是無可避免的必然下場。

segments.en: Given the simmering personal hostility between the two ambitious teammates, a high-speed intra-team collision felt almost inevitable.
segments.zh: 鑑於兩位野心勃勃的隊友之間不斷升溫的個人敵意，一場高速隊內互撞事故似乎已是命中注定、無法避免。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 131–140：controversy、dock、cellar、valiant、saboteur、pawn、knight、deficient、frontal cortex、constructive。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: The fierce media controversy surrounding Sonny’s aggressive blocking maneuvers completely overshadowed the historic first points scored by Apex GP.
segments.zh: 圍繞著桑尼激進阻擋動作引發的巨大媒體爭議，完全掩蓋了彎心車隊破天荒奪下隊史首個積分的歷史光芒。

segments.en: Heated regulatory controversy erupted when rival engineers lodged a formal protest against the flexible carbon floor mounted on Sonny's chassis.
segments.zh: 當對手工程師就桑尼底盤上安裝的彈性碳纖維底板提起正式抗議時，圍場內爆發了激烈的技術合規爭議。

segments.en: The race stewards decided to dock Apex GP ten grid positions after discovering an unscheduled overnight gearbox and power unit replacement.
segments.zh: 在發現車隊夜間無預警更換了變速箱與動力單元後，賽會幹事決定罰退彎心車隊十個發車位。

segments.en: "They can dock our prize money and drop us to the back of the grid, but they can't kill our fighting spirit," Sonny growled.
segments.zh: 「他們儘管扣光我們的獎金、把我們罰到最後一位發車，但他們休想撲滅我們的戰鬥鬥志，」桑尼低吼道。

segments.en: Crawling out of the championship cellar seemed impossible until Sonny’s fearless tactical gambles began yielding unexpected top-ten finishes.
segments.zh: 在桑尼無畏的戰術豪賭開始帶來出人意料的前十名完賽之前，想要從積分榜墊底的地窖深淵中爬出看似是天方夜譚。

segments.en: Starting from the absolute cellar in twenty-second position, Sonny put his head down and methodically passed six back markers on the opening lap.
segments.zh: 從排在第二十二位的絕對末流地窖起跑，桑尼低下頭心無旁騖，在第一圈就有條不紊地連斬六輛後排賽車。

segments.en: Despite nursing broken suspension pushrods across the final two laps, Sonny delivered a valiant drive to cross the finish line in seventh place.
segments.zh: 儘管在最後兩圈忍受著斷裂的懸吊推桿，桑尼依然展現了英勇頑強的奮戰精神，穩穩將賽車帶回第七名衝線。

segments.en: The mechanics applauded Joshua's valiant defense against reigning world champions, recognizing that the rookie had given every ounce of his soul.
segments.zh: 技師們起立為約書亞抵禦衛冕世界冠軍的英勇防守鼓掌致敬，深知這名新秀已經傾注了靈魂深處的每一分力氣。

segments.en: Joshua's manipulative manager whispered poison into the young driver's ear, claiming that Sonny was a calculating saboteur out to steal his seat.
segments.zh: 約書亞那位善於操弄人心的經紀人在年輕車手耳邊煽風點火，聲稱桑尼是個深謀遠慮的內鬼破壞者，一心只想奪走他的席位。

segments.en: When technical blueprints were mysteriously leaked to the governing body, Ruben realized there was an insidious corporate saboteur sitting on his board.
segments.zh: 當機密技術藍圖被神祕洩露給監管機構時，魯本驚覺自己的董事會裡竟然坐著一個陰險狡詐的企業內鬼。

segments.en: "Stop letting corporate suit-wearers treat you like an expendable marketing pawn," Sonny snapped, trying to shake the confused rookie awake.
segments.zh: 「別再任由那些穿西裝的企業高層把你當作隨時可棄的行銷小棋子來擺佈了，」桑尼厲聲喝斥，試圖罵醒迷茫的新秀。

segments.en: Joshua refused to be used as a strategic pawn to block rivals, demanding that the pit wall give him full engine power to fight for the win.
segments.zh: 約書亞拒絕充當阻擋對手的戰術棄子，強烈要求指揮台解鎖全部引擎動力，放手讓他去爭奪分站冠軍。

segments.en: Urged by his entourage to stop being a passive pawn and become an aggressive knight, Joshua boldly launched a high-risk divebomb into the chicane.
segments.zh: 在隨行人員的不斷慫恿下，約書亞不再甘心當一枚被動的兵卒，而是化身為主動出擊的重裝騎士，在減速彎發起了一記高風險的自殺式超車。

segments.en: On the asphalt chessboard of Grand Prix racing, Sonny maneuvered like a rogue knight, cutting unpredictable angles across the championship favorites.
segments.zh: 在大獎賽這張柏油棋盤上，桑尼宛如一名不按牌理出牌的遊俠騎士，以難以捉摸的角度在奪冠熱門車手之間縱橫穿插。

segments.en: During their late-night poker clash, Sonny mockingly diagnosed Joshua with a deficient frontal cortex that rendered him incapable of analyzing high-speed risk.
segments.zh: 在深夜的撲克對決中，桑尼嘲弄地診斷約書亞前額葉皮質發育不良，導致他在高速馳騁時根本不具備分析風險的能力。

segments.en: The baseline car was severely deficient in low-speed mechanical downforce, causing drivers to helplessly slide across every hairpin apex.
segments.zh: 最初的基礎賽車在低速機械下壓力方面極度匱乏，導致車手在每個髮卡彎的彎心都無助地側滑失控。

segments.en: "Your frontal cortex won't fully mature until you’re twenty-five, which explains why you keep throwing perfectly good cars into tire barriers," Sonny laughed.
segments.zh: 「你的前額葉皮質要到二十五歲才會完全成熟，這正好解釋了為什麼你老是把好端端的賽車往輪胎牆上撞，」桑尼大笑嘲諷道。

segments.en: Mastering emotional regulation through your frontal cortex is what separates a reckless hot-lap qualifier from an enduring Grand Prix world champion.
segments.zh: 能否運用前額葉皮質精準掌控情緒，是區分只會刷單圈的魯莽排位賽車手與名留青史的常勝世界冠軍的關鍵所在。

segments.en: Exchanging sarcastic insults across the dinner table failed to qualify as constructive feedback, forcing Kate to slam her fists down for order.
segments.zh: 在餐桌上互撕漫罵與冷嘲熱諷根本算不上任何建設性的回饋，迫使凱特用力捶桌喝令全場安靜守秩序。

segments.en: Kate offered constructive engineering modifications, showing Joshua how adjusting his steering angle could extend front tire life by five laps.
segments.zh: 凱特提出了極具建設性的工程修改方案，向約書亞展示如何透過微調入彎打方向盤的角度來延長前輪五圈的壽命。

articles.titleZh: 第 15 課 · full house–pinch of salt
articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 141–150：full house、trips、two pair、sanity、resentful、shithead、boundary、anonymous、violation、pinch of salt。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Tossing his cards triumphantly onto the green felt, Sonny revealed a commanding full house to snatch the bluff away from the arrogant rookie.
segments.zh: 桑尼得意地將手中的底牌甩在綠色呢絨桌面上，亮出堅不可摧的滿堂紅（葫蘆），俐落地粉碎了傲慢新秀的偷雞詐唬。

segments.en: Surviving mechanical gremlins, pit lane blunders, and torrential rain, Apex GP pulled off the ultimate full house by securing a double-podium finish.
segments.zh: 挺過了機械故障、進站大亂與暴雨傾盆，彎心車隊在最後奇蹟般拿下雙雙登上頒獎台的完美大滿貫局面（full house）。

segments.en: Joshua smugly announced he was holding trips, only to freeze in disbelief when Kate quietly laid down an unbeatable royal hand.
segments.zh: 約書亞沾沾自喜地宣稱自己握有三條（trips），然而當凱特平靜地亮出無可匹敵的大牌組時，他瞬間目瞪口呆。

segments.en: Sonny smirked across the poker chips, daring his young teammate to push all his money into the pot on nothing more than vulnerable trips.
segments.zh: 桑尼隔著籌碼堆冷笑，挑釁這位年輕隊友敢不敢單憑區區三條的牌力就將全部身家推入底池梭哈。

segments.en: "Two pair isn't going to save your race seat or win you this pot, kid," Sonny chuckled as he scooped up the towering pile of banknotes.
segments.zh: 「區區兩對可救不了你的正賽席位，也贏不走這個底池，小子，」桑尼一邊輕聲笑著，一邊將堆積如山的鈔票攬入懷中。

segments.en: Relying on two pair in poker is like trusting a compromised differential on track—it looks decent until serious pressure is applied.
segments.zh: 在撲克中指望兩對獲勝，就像在賽道上信任一顆有毛病的差速器——在面臨生死考驗施壓前看似不錯，實則不堪一擊。

segments.en: Wandering the globe living in a camper van was the only way Sonny could preserve his fragile mental sanity after losing his Grand Prix seat.
segments.zh: 在失去大獎賽車手席位後，開著露營廂型車浪跡天涯是桑尼唯一能夠維持脆弱精神理智的生存方式。

segments.en: Ruben questioned his own sanity for investing millions of borrowed capital into an unproven racing team hovering on the brink of total ruin.
segments.zh: 魯本深深懷疑自己是否心智健全，竟然會將數百萬借貸資本砸進一支在徹底毀滅邊緣苦苦掙扎的墊底車隊。

segments.en: Bitter from decades of obscurity, Sonny had evolved into a resentful, cynical recluse who hated the commercial circus of modern Formula 1.
segments.zh: 長達數十年的默默無聞讓他心生怨懟，桑尼逐漸演變為一個怨恨憤慨、憤世嫉俗的隱士，極度厭惡現代 F1 的商業名利場。

segments.en: Joshua felt deeply resentful when engineers immediately gathered around Sonny to praise his technical feedback on the new combat floor.
segments.zh: 當工程師們第一時間圍繞在桑尼身邊、對他針對新戰鬥底板提出的技術回饋讚不絕口時，約書亞心裡充滿了嫉妒與怨恨。

segments.en: "I was an angry, self-absorbed shithead who destroyed his own career thirty years ago, and I won't let you follow my footsteps," Sonny confessed.
segments.zh: 「三十年前我就是個暴躁自私的混球，親手毀了自己的一切，我絕不會眼睜睜看著你重蹈我的覆轍，」桑尼坦承道。

segments.en: Joshua stormed through the paddock cursing that the arrogant Mercedes driver who ran him into the gravel was an unpunished shithead.
segments.zh: 約書亞怒氣沖沖地穿過圍場，破口大罵那個把他逼上碎石緩衝區的傲慢奔馳車手簡直是個逃脫制裁的混球。

segments.en: Kate maintained a rigorous professional boundary between herself and the drivers, refusing to let personal drama compromise her engineering integrity.
segments.zh: 凱特在自己與車手之間劃下了壁壘分明的職業邊界，絕不容許任何私人情感糾葛動搖她在工程專業上的嚴謹操守。

segments.en: Sonny's aggressive wheel-to-wheel defense tested the absolute legal boundary of acceptable track limits along the narrow harbor section.
segments.zh: 桑尼激進的輪對輪卡位防守，在狹窄的港灣路段挑戰了賽道限制邊界所能容忍的絕對法律極限。

segments.en: The FIA received an explosive anonymous dossier alleging that Apex GP's revolutionary combat floor had been illegally manufactured outside their certified facility.
segments.zh: FIA 收到了一份毀滅性的匿名舉報卷宗，指控彎心車隊革命性的戰鬥底板是在其認證工廠之外違法秘密代工的。

segments.en: Sending an anonymous complaint to the race stewards was Peter Banning’s calculated scheme to undermine Ruben’s ownership of the racing outfit.
segments.zh: 向賽會幹事發送匿名投訴信，是彼得·班寧為了搞垮魯本對車隊的所有權而精心策劃的毒計。

segments.en: Technical delegates served the team an official notice of regulatory violation, forcing the mechanics to strip the upgraded aerodynamic components from the car.
segments.zh: 技術代表向車隊下達了正式的規章違規通知書，強令技師們從賽車上拆除所有升級過的空氣動力學套件。

segments.en: Sonny avoided a sporting violation by millimeters, ensuring that his front tires kept fractional contact with the white line during the controversial overtake.
segments.zh: 桑尼以幾毫米的毫釐之差避開了競賽違規處罰，在爭議性超車過程中確保前輪始終有微小部分壓在賽道白線上。

segments.en: Ruben listened to the rival team principal's effusive compliments with a heavy pinch of salt, knowing full well the man was plotting his downfall.
segments.zh: 魯本對競爭對手車隊領隊那番熱情洋溢的奉承持高度保留態度，因為他心知肚明這傢伙正暗中盤算著如何置自己於死地。

segments.en: Given Sonny's reputation for psychological warfare, younger drivers learned to take his technical advice with a healthy pinch of salt.
segments.zh: 鑑於桑尼在心理戰方面的狠辣名聲，年輕車手們學會了對他的技術指點持適度保留態度，不敢全盤輕信。

items.baseEn: Joshua felt deeply resentful when engineers immediately gathered around Sonny to praise his technical.
items.baseZh: 當工程師們第一時間圍繞在桑尼身邊、對他針對新戰鬥底板提出的技術回饋讚不絕口時，約書亞心裡充滿了嫉妒與怨恨。

items.pattern: "I was [SWAP], self-absorbed shithead who destroyed his own career thirty years ago,.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: "I was an angry, self-absorbed shithead who destroyed his own career thirty years ago,.
items.baseZh: 「三十年前我就是個暴躁自私的混球，親手毀了自己的一切，我絕不會眼睜睜看著你重蹈我的覆轍，」桑尼坦承道。

items.baseZh: 凱特在自己與車手之間劃下了壁壘分明的職業邊界，絕不容許任何私人情感糾葛動搖她在工程專業上的嚴謹操守。

items.pattern: Sonny's aggressive wheel-to-wheel defense tested [SWAP] boundary of acceptable track limits along.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Sonny's aggressive wheel-to-wheel defense tested the absolute legal boundary of acceptable track limits along.
items.baseZh: 桑尼激進的輪對輪卡位防守，在狹窄的港灣路段挑戰了賽道限制邊界所能容忍的絕對法律極限。

items.pattern: The FIA received an explosive anonymous dossier alleging [SWAP] revolutionary combat floor.

items.baseZh: FIA 收到了一份毀滅性的匿名舉報卷宗，指控彎心車隊革命性的戰鬥底板是在其認證工廠之外違法秘密代工的。

items.pattern: Technical delegates served [SWAP] official notice of regulatory violation.

items.pattern: Sonny avoided [SWAP] by millimeters.

items.baseEn: Sonny avoided a sporting violation by millimeters.
items.baseZh: 桑尼以幾毫米的毫釐之差避開了競賽違規處罰，在爭議性超車過程中確保前輪始終有微小部分壓在賽道白線上。

items.pattern: Ruben listened to the rival team principal's effusive compliments with [SWAP] of salt.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Ruben listened to the rival team principal's effusive compliments with a heavy pinch of salt.
items.baseZh: 魯本對競爭對手車隊領隊那番熱情洋溢的奉承持高度保留態度，因為他心知肚明這傢伙正暗中盤算著如何置自己於死地。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 151–160：fabricate、espionage、screwed、cervical、fracture、spinal contusion、compressed、thoracic、vertebrae、blunt force。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Kate argued passionately before the FIA hearing that a bitter rival had deliberately fabricated internal supply chain invoices to frame Apex GP.
segments.zh: 凱特在 FIA 聽證會上慷慨激昂地抗辯，指出是有心懷怨恨的對手蓄意偽造內部供應鏈發票，以此陷害彎心車隊。

segments.en: Desperate to secure media headlines, the tabloid journalist attempted to fabricate an imaginary romantic scandal between the technical director and her driver.
segments.zh: 為了搏取媒體版面，八卦記者企圖無中生有捏造技術總監與車手之間子虛烏有的浪漫緋聞。

segments.en: What began as a dispute over aerodynamic tolerances escalated into an explosive investigation into high-tech corporate espionage within the paddock.
segments.zh: 起初一場關於空力公差的爭端，隨後迅速升級為一場針對圍場內高科技商業間諜刺探行動的毀滅性大調查。

segments.en: Accusing rival engineering teams of industrial espionage, Ruben demanded that the governing body inspect their cloud databases for stolen CAD models.
segments.zh: 魯本指控競爭工程車隊涉嫌工業間諜活動，強烈要求管理機構清查他們的雲端資料庫是否有失竊的 CAD 模型。

segments.en: "If they force us to race with last year's sluggish shitbox floor, we are completely screwed this weekend," the chief mechanic spat bitterly.
segments.zh: 「如果他們逼我們換回去年那塊慢如蝸牛的破爛底板出賽，我們這個週末就徹底完蛋了，」首席技師恨恨地啐了一口。

segments.en: Knowing that their battery storage system was failing in the desert heat, Joshua realized his championship podium chances were entirely screwed.
segments.zh: 深知電池儲能系統在沙漠高溫下正全面崩潰，約書亞意識到自己登上錦標賽頒獎台的機會已經完全搞砸了。

segments.en: The historical medical record highlighted an unhealed fracture at the C5 cervical vertebra, a horrific legacy from Sonny’s fiery crash thirty years ago.
segments.zh: 這份過往的病歷報告赫然標註著第五節頸椎（C5）存在未癒合的陳舊性骨折，那是三十年前桑尼烈火撞車留下的慘痛印記。

segments.en: Drastic physical strain across the cervical spine during 5G cornering posed an ongoing threat of catastrophic spinal trauma to the veteran racer.
segments.zh: 在承受 5G 過彎重力時施加在頸椎上的劇烈物理拉扯，對這位老將而言隨時潛藏著災難性脊髓重創的致命風險。

segments.en: Doctors warned that even a microscopic stress fracture in the neck column could snap under the violent braking forces of modern Grand Prix cars.
segments.zh: 醫生警告，在現代大獎賽賽車極其狂暴的煞車減速力下，頸椎骨上哪怕是微小的應力性骨折都可能瞬間徹底斷裂。

segments.en: The heavy crash into the barriers caused an invisible carbon hairline fracture in the chassis tub, rendering the car unsafe for qualifying.
segments.zh: 撞向防護牆的猛烈衝擊導致單體座艙內部產生了肉眼不可見的碳纖維髮絲狀微裂紋，使賽車無法安全參加排位賽。

segments.en: Sonny’s confidential medical scan detailed an acute spinal contusion, confirming that another violent blunt impact could permanently paralyze his limbs.
segments.zh: 桑尼的機密醫療掃描報告詳列了嚴重的脊髓挫傷病歷，證實若再承受一次猛烈的鈍力衝擊，將可能導致他四肢永久癱瘓。

segments.en: Ruben was horrified to learn that Sonny had been concealing a lingering spinal contusion while driving flat-out at over two hundred miles per hour.
segments.zh: 魯本驚恐萬狀地得知，桑尼在以超過兩百英里時速全油門狂飆的同時，竟然一直在向全車隊隱瞞未癒的脊髓挫傷。

segments.en: Years of brutal high-G impacts had left Sonny suffering from multiple compressed thoracic vertebrae, causing agonizing pain during every curb strike.
segments.zh: 多年來兇狠的高 G 力撞擊讓桑尼落下了多處胸椎壓縮性骨折的毛病，每一次壓過路肩都會引發撕心裂肺的劇痛。

segments.en: Telemetry confirmed that the compressed suspension springs completely bottomed out along the bumpy back straight, grinding the plank into dust.
segments.zh: 遙測數據證實，被極度壓縮的懸吊彈簧在顛簸的後直道上已完全觸底壓死，將底盤木底板磨成了漫天碎屑。

segments.en: The medical report clearly documented chronic thoracic trauma, proving that the sixty-year-old was physically unfit to endure an entire Grand Prix distance.
segments.zh: 體檢報告清清楚楚記載著慢性胸椎創傷，證明這名六十歲的老人在生理條件上根本無法承受整場大獎賽的極限摧殘。

segments.en: Sonny grit his teeth in silent agony as sharp thoracic back spasms ripped through his upper torso while wrestling the twitchy steering wheel.
segments.zh: 當桑尼奮力修正劇烈抖動的方向盤時，胸椎部位傳來的劇烈痙攣劇痛席捲上半身，他只能咬緊牙關默默死撐。

segments.en: An array of surgical titanium pins held several of Sonny’s shattered vertebrae together, an engineering feat rivaling the race car itself.
segments.zh: 一排手術植入的鈦合金鋼釘將桑尼多處碎裂的脊椎骨固定在一起，這項人體醫學工程的精密程度絲毫不亞於賽車本身。

segments.en: High-frequency engine vibrations traveling directly through the carbon seat threatened to dislodge his fragile reconstructed vertebrae.
segments.zh: 直接穿透碳纖維座椅傳導進來的高頻引擎共振，時刻威脅著他體內脆弱重建的脊椎骨結構。

segments.en: Impact tests revealed that modern carbon safety cells absorb catastrophic blunt force, dispersing kinetic energy away from the vulnerable cockpit.
segments.zh: 撞擊測試表明，現代碳纖維安全單體座艙能吸收毀滅性的鈍性撞擊力，將致命動能引導疏散開來以保護脆弱的駕駛艙。

segments.en: The doctor gravely explained that Sonny’s neck could withstand zero additional blunt force trauma before catastrophic neurological failure occurred.
segments.zh: 醫生神情凝重地解釋，桑尼的頸部已無法再承受哪怕一丁點額外的鈍力撞擊創傷，否則將導致毀滅性的神經系統衰竭。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 161–170：trauma、paralysis、liable、loophole、sentimental、unload、profile、nail in the coffin、power unit、irony。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Returning to the very track where he had suffered career-ending trauma thirty years earlier reignited long-buried psychological demons within Sonny.
segments.zh: 重返三十年前讓他遭遇終結職業生涯慘劇的同一座賽道，重新點燃了桑尼心頭深埋已久的心理夢魘與創傷。

segments.en: Immediate extraction protocols were initiated by the medical chase car to evaluate Joshua for internal abdominal trauma following his fiery impact.
segments.zh: 醫療救援車第一時間啟動了緊急脫困醫療程序，在約書亞遭遇烈火撞擊後立即評估他是否受有內部腹部外傷。

segments.en: The terrifying threat of permanent paralysis hung over Sonny's head every time he clicked the six-point harness and dropped into the cockpit.
segments.zh: 每當扣緊六點式安全帶跌坐進駕駛座艙時，終身癱瘓的致命威脅便如同達摩克利斯之劍般高懸在桑尼頭頂。

segments.en: Ruben shouted that he would never forgive himself if their desperate quest for corporate sponsors ended in his old friend's permanent paralysis.
segments.zh: 魯本厲聲嘶吼，如果他們為了爭取企業贊助的孤注一擲最終導致老友終身癱瘓，他這輩子都將永遠無法原諒自己。

segments.en: Ruben reminded Sonny that as team owner, he was legally liable for permitting a medically disqualified driver to compete under his racing banner.
segments.zh: 魯本鄭重提醒桑尼，身為車隊老闆，若准許一名體檢不合格的車手代表車隊出戰，他將承擔全部法律責任。

segments.en: Peter Banning warned that Cervantes Capital would be held financially liable for millions if the cars failed to start the final Grand Prix.
segments.zh: 彼得·班寧警告，如果賽車未能在收官大獎賽中起跑，塞萬提斯資本將承擔數百萬美元的巨額財務賠償責任。

segments.en: Sonny produced a signed affidavit from a Mexican attorney, exploiting an obscure legal loophole to waive team liability and force his entry into the race.
segments.zh: 桑尼拿出一份由墨西哥律師簽署的宣誓書，利用一處晦澀的法律漏洞全面免除車隊責任，強行逼迫車隊讓自己參賽。

segments.en: Kate searched the technical regulations relentlessly, hoping to find an aerodynamic loophole that would allow them to deploy the combat floor safely.
segments.zh: 凱特沒日沒夜地鑽研技術法規，希望能找到一個空力漏洞，讓他們能合法且安全地安裝這套戰鬥底板。

segments.en: "Stop being a pair of dumb, sentimental losers chasing a glory that expired thirty years ago," Ruben shouted at Sonny in bitter exhaustion.
segments.zh: 「別再當一對愚蠢、感情用事、成天追逐三十年前早已過期榮耀的失敗者了，」魯本在身心俱疲中對桑尼痛心疾首地吼道。

segments.en: Professional motorsport has no room for sentimental attachments to aging drivers who cannot deliver consistent championship points.
segments.zh: 職業賽車運動殘酷而現實，絕不容許對那些無法穩定貢獻錦標賽積分的遲暮老將抱有任何感情用事的憐憫。

segments.en: Peter Banning’s primary agenda on the board was to intentionally depress the team's valuation, enabling a hostile consortium to unload and acquire Apex GP cheaply.
segments.zh: 彼得·班寧在董事會上的核心算計就是故意壓低車隊估值，好讓一個敵意財團能低價接手並賤賣拋售彎心車隊。

segments.en: Once the brand profile surged following their Abu Dhabi triumph, Ruben received numerous lucrative offers from suitors desperate to unload capital into the team.
segments.zh: 在阿布達比奪冠使車隊聲名大噪後，魯本收到了無數追求者開出的豐厚收購要約，爭先恐後想將大筆資金傾倒進這支車隊。

segments.en: Sonny’s high-profile return from three decades of exile dramatically boosted the struggling team’s media profile, drawing millions of global fans.
segments.zh: 桑尼結束三十年隱退的高調回歸，戲劇性地提升了這支苦苦掙扎車隊的全球媒體知名度，吸引了數以百萬計的車迷關注。

segments.en: Maintaining a flawless sponsor-friendly profile was the constant demand of corporate marketing managers who feared controversial driving tactics.
segments.zh: 維持無懈可擊、討好贊助商的公關形象，是企業行銷經理們不斷提出的要求，他們極度害怕車手激進爭議的駕駛手段會惹惱金主。

segments.en: Failing to qualify for the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix would have been the definitive final nail in the coffin for the insolvent racing venture.
segments.zh: 若未能在阿布達比大獎賽排位賽中出線，對這支早已資不抵債的賽車隊伍而言，將會是徹底蓋棺定論的致命一擊。

segments.en: Peter Banning believed that Sonny’s inevitable crash would serve as the ultimate nail in the coffin to force Ruben out of management.
segments.zh: 彼得·班寧深信桑尼注定要發生的撞車事故，將成為迫使魯本交出管理權、將其徹底掃地出門的最後一根稻草。

segments.en: Kate negotiated frantically to secure a factory-spec Mercedes hybrid power unit, knowing that superior kilowatt output was vital for next year’s title campaign.
segments.zh: 凱特費盡周折爭取引進廠隊規格的奔馳油電混合動力單元，深知更強悍的千瓦動力輸出是明年角逐總冠軍不可或缺的基石。

segments.en: Extreme ambient desert heat placed immense stress on the battery packs, threatening to throttle the power unit into safe limp-home mode.
segments.zh: 沙漠酷烈的高溫給電池組帶來了巨大的散熱負荷，隨時可能迫使動力單元自動降載進入保護性的龜速跛行模式。

segments.en: The bitter irony was that the board originally hired Sonny assuming he would guarantee failure, only for the veteran to ignite an unprecedented winning streak.
segments.zh: 殘酷的諷刺在於，董事會當初簽下桑尼本以為他能確保車隊徹底擺爛輸光，沒想到這位老將卻親手點燃了一場前所未有的連勝奇蹟。

segments.en: It was a supreme irony that the very veteran accused of being a selfish lone wolf sacrificed his own car to drag his teammate to victory.
segments.zh: 最諷刺的是，那個曾被全圍場痛斥為自私獨狼的老車手，最終竟不惜犧牲自己的賽車，將年輕隊友一路保駕護送向冠軍寶座。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 171–180：forge、demographic、incentive、parc fermé、morgue、waiver、vis-à-vis、substitute、jockey、full-throttle。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Technical investigators uncovered undeniable proof that Peter Banning had conspired with an insider to forge illegal component delivery documents.
segments.zh: 技術調查員掌握了無可辯駁的確鑿鐵證，證實彼得·班寧曾與內部人員串通，偽造了非法的零件採購與交付文件。

segments.en: Sonny and Joshua managed to forge an unbreakable bond of mutual trust through hours of testing in high-speed dirty air.
segments.zh: 在高速亂流中歷經無數小時的極限測試，桑尼與約書亞在烈火中鍛造（forge）出了一份堅不可摧的彼此信任。

segments.en: Commercial agents relentlessly reminded Joshua that expanding his digital footprint was essential to attract a younger, highly lucrative consumer demographic.
segments.zh: 商業經紀人不斷向約書亞灌輸，擴大其網路社群影響力對於吸引年輕且含金量極高的消費族群至關重要。

segments.en: Formula 1’s booming popularity among a diverse global demographic brought unprecedented corporate sponsorship into the midfield paddock.
segments.zh: F1 在全球多元受眾族群中的爆發性人氣，為中游車隊圍場注入了前所未有的雄厚企業贊助資金。

segments.en: Ruben added a million-dollar victory incentive into Sonny’s contract, fully convinced at the time that the team had zero probability of ever winning.
segments.zh: 魯本在桑尼的合約中加入了一筆百萬美元的獲勝激勵獎金，只因他當時深信車隊獲勝的機率根本是零。

segments.en: The prospect of securing a guaranteed long-term contract served as Joshua’s primary incentive to conquer his fear and race through pain.
segments.zh: 鎖定一份受保障的長期車手合約的前景，成為了約書亞克服恐懼、帶傷浴血奮戰的最大動力與激勵。

segments.en: Under strict parc fermé conditions, mechanics were legally forbidden from modifying the suspension geometry or altering engine mapping before the race.
segments.zh: 在嚴苛的賽車封存監管（parc fermé）條件下，法規嚴厲禁止技師在正賽開打前私自改動懸吊幾何結構或刷寫引擎動力曲線。

segments.en: Officials sealed both Apex GP machines inside the parc fermé compound, awaiting the FIA technical delegate's arrival to inspect the legal floor legality.
segments.zh: 賽事官員將兩輛彎心賽車封鎖在封存監管區內，靜候 FIA 技術代表親自抵達以查驗底板規格是否完全合規。

segments.en: Walking into the stone-cold garage after the dual qualifying disaster felt like stepping into an abandoned, depressing morgue.
segments.zh: 在雙雙排位賽折戟的災難後走進冰冷死寂的車庫，感覺就像一腳踏進了一間陰森荒涼、壓抑至極的停屍房。

segments.en: "Stop sitting around moping like we're in a damn morgue—we still have two cars and fifty-five laps to fight," Sonny bellowed to his crew.
segments.zh: 「別一個個垂頭喪氣坐著跟守停屍房一樣——我們手裡還有兩輛車，還有整整五十五圈可以去拼命，」桑尼對著他的團隊怒吼打氣。

segments.en: Sonny defiantly tossed a signed legal waiver onto Ruben’s desk, absolving the team of all financial and criminal liability should he die on track.
segments.zh: 桑尼桀驁不馴地將一份簽署好的免責協議甩在魯本桌上，白紙黑字聲明若他命喪賽道，將免除車隊的一切經濟與刑事責任。

segments.en: The governing body agreed to waive the routine technical inspection deadline after Ruben demonstrated proof of administrative sabotage.
segments.zh: 在魯本出示了內部行政惡意破壞的確鑿鐵證後，監管機構同意特批免除（waive）常規技術審查的截止時限。

segments.en: The legal document explicitly terminated all obligations vis-à-vis Sonny’s health, leaving the veteran solely responsible for the catastrophic consequences of racing.
segments.zh: 這份法律文件白紙黑字終止了關於（vis-à-vis）桑尼健康狀況的所有法律義務，使這位老將獨自承擔參賽可能帶來的毀滅性後果。

segments.en: Ruben carefully evaluated their financial exposure vis-à-vis potential sponsor default if the cars failed to cross the finish line in the top ten.
segments.zh: 魯本仔細評估了相較於（vis-à-vis）賽車若未能跑進前十衝線、贊助商可能隨之違約所引發的巨大財務風險敞口。

segments.en: Luca Cortez waited nervously in the wings, eager to step in as a reserve substitute if either primary driver succumbed to physical exhaustion.
segments.zh: 盧卡·科爾特斯在闈場後方焦急待命，一旦任何一名正賽車手因體力不支倒下，他便渴望作為替補車手立即披掛上陣。

segments.en: The technical team was forced to substitute their cracked composite front wing with an older, heavier aluminum specification.
segments.zh: 技術團隊被迫用一套老舊、更沉重的鋁合金規格套件，替換掉那支破裂受損的複合材料前翼。

segments.en: Roaring off the grid at over two hundred miles per hour, multiple contenders jockied aggressively for position into the narrowing bottleneck of turn one.
segments.zh: 以時速兩百多英里從發車格轟鳴起步，數名強烈爭冠者在一號彎收窄的瓶頸路段為了搶佔身位展開了激烈的推擠卡位。

segments.en: Sonny jockied the vibrating steering wheel across the slippery kerbs, using lightning counter-steering inputs to keep the rear end planted.
segments.zh: 桑尼在濕滑的路肩上熟練微調著劇烈震動的方向盤，利用閃電般的反打修正動作死死壓住車尾。

segments.en: Holding the machine full-throttle through the blind sweep of Eau Rouge required an absolute, terrifying suspension of basic human survival instinct.
segments.zh: 全油門盲衝穿過艾爾羅格彎（Eau Rouge）的盲區大盲彎，需要車手徹底封印人體與生俱來的求生本能。

segments.en: Apex GP launched a full-throttle developmental push back at the factory, manufacturing three entirely new chassis within a frantic forty-eight-hour window.
segments.zh: 彎心車隊在後方工廠發動了一場全力以赴的研發突擊，在瘋狂的四十八小時極限窗口內趕製出三架全新底盤。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 181–190：lock up、irresistible、immovable、at bay、fabulous、short-term、neck and neck、underdog、stacked against、substantial。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Desperate to defend against the charging Red Bull, Joshua stomped on the left pedal only to lock up his front left tire in a cloud of blue smoke.
segments.zh: 為了死守狂飆逼近的紅牛，約書亞慌亂重踩煞車踏板，卻導致左前輪在漫天青煙中瞬間抱死拖滑。

segments.en: An unexpected brake balance shift caused Sonny to lock up heavily into the hairpin, creating an enormous flat spot that vibrated his vision blurry.
segments.zh: 突如其來的煞車平衡比失衡導致桑尼在髮卡彎發生嚴重輪胎抱死，磨出的巨大胎面平點震得他視線一片模糊。

segments.en: Sonny's late-braking charge along the outside line was an irresistible force that intimidated even the most hardened Grand Prix champions.
segments.zh: 桑尼從外線發動的延遲煞車超車有如一股不可阻擋的滔天巨浪，連身經百戰的大獎賽世界冠軍都為之膽寒。

segments.en: The romantic and professional thrill of steering Apex GP to its first world championship proved an irresistible temptation for Kate.
segments.zh: 引領彎心車隊奪得隊史首座世界冠軍的巨大職業誘惑與傳奇色彩，對凱特而言是一份無法抗拒的終極召喚。

segments.en: Hamilton positioned his Mercedes across the racing line like an immovable wall, refusing to give the eager rookie even a millimeter of passing room.
segments.zh: 漢密爾頓將奔馳賽車橫亙在最佳行車線上，宛如一堵不可撼動的鋼鐵長城，連一毫米的超車空間都不肯施捨給急躁的新秀。

segments.en: Despite suffering agonizing neck pain from spinal trauma, Sonny remained an immovable barrier against rival overtakes during the dying laps.
segments.zh: 儘管脊椎重創引發了痛徹心扉的頸部劇痛，桑尼在最後幾圈依然化身為一道不可撼動的屏障，死死將對手的超車企圖化為泡影。

segments.en: Managing his hybrid deployment with surgical precision, Sonny kept the faster Ferrari at bay for six agonizing laps along the desert straights.
segments.zh: 桑尼以如同外科手術般精準的節奏調度混合動力電能，在沙漠長直道上苦苦牽制阻擋了速度更快的法拉利整整六圈。

segments.en: Joshua’s aggressive positioning kept the entire midfield DRS train at bay, creating the essential buffer his veteran teammate needed to pit safely.
segments.zh: 約書亞強硬的行車卡位將整條中游 DRS 車串死死阻隔在外，為老將隊友爭取到了安全進站不可或缺的黃金緩衝帶。

segments.en: Delivering a fabulous opening stint on worn medium compound tires, Joshua proved to the global audience that he belonged at the pinnacle of motorsport.
segments.zh: 用磨損的中性胎跑出了一輪極佳的開局駕駛，約書亞向全球觀眾證明了他完全配得上站上賽車運動的最高殿堂。

segments.en: Kate congratulated the mechanics for delivering a fabulous turnaround, rebuilding a smashed gearbox and front wing assembly in record time.
segments.zh: 凱特向技師團隊送上祝賀，讚揚他們完成了一次絕妙的逆轉搶修，在創紀錄的時間內重建了撞碎的變速箱與前翼總成。

segments.en: Sacrificing early-race track position was a painful short-term compromise designed to yield superior tire life for the final sprint laps.
segments.zh: 犧牲正賽前期的賽道位置是一項痛苦的短期妥協，旨在換取最後衝刺階段傲視全場的輪胎壽命。

segments.en: The board cared only about short-term financial returns, completely blind to the long-term engineering vision Ruben was painstakingly constructing.
segments.zh: 董事會眼裡只有短期的財務回報，對魯本慘澹經營、精心構築的長期工程藍圖完全視而不見。

segments.en: Screaming down the main straight at two hundred and twenty miles per hour, Sonny and Hamilton raced neck and neck toward the chequered flag.
segments.zh: 以兩百二十英里的時速呼嘯衝下主直道，桑尼與漢密爾頓並駕齊驅，在毫釐之間向方格旗展開了最後的生死衝刺。

segments.en: The two rival drivers emerged from the pit exit lane neck and neck, their titanium wheel nuts nearly locking as they fought for track position.
segments.zh: 兩位宿敵車手並駕齊驅殺出維修區出口線，在爭奪賽道身位時兩車的鈦合金輪圈螺栓幾乎直接鎖死蹭在一起。

segments.en: Paddock crowds cheered wildly for the underfunded underdog, captivated by the spectacle of an aging racer humiliating multi-billion-dollar corporate giants.
segments.zh: 圍場觀眾為這支預算吃緊的黑馬車隊爆發出震天動地的喝采，完全被這位遲暮老將在賽道上羞辱百億企業巨頭的壯舉所征服。

segments.en: Embracing their identity as the scrappy underdog allowed the Apex GP crew to take audacious strategic risks that conservative teams dared not attempt.
segments.zh: 坦然接納自己作為頑強黑馬的底層身分，讓彎心團隊敢於放手進行保守廠隊根本不敢設想的瘋狂戰術冒險。

segments.en: With zero championship points, broken machinery, and a fractured driver lineup, the odds were heavily stacked against Apex GP surviving the weekend.
segments.zh: 積分掛零、賽車受損且車手陣容內鬨撕裂，整個局勢對彎心車隊而言極度不利，幾乎沒人相信他們能活著挺過這個週末。

segments.en: Despite the competitive deck being stacked against him from the start, Sonny refused to let corporate saboteurs dictate his final destiny.
segments.zh: 儘管競爭的底牌從一開始就對他極度不利，桑尼依然拒絕讓那些企業內鬼與陰謀家主宰自己最後的命運。

segments.en: The high-speed impact with the steel barriers inflicted substantial structural damage across the monocoque, fracturing the carbon safety cell.
segments.zh: 與鋼製防護牆的高速猛烈碰撞對單體座艙造成了實質重大的結構性破壞，甚至撞裂了碳纖維安全艙。

segments.en: Scoring an unexpected victory in Abu Dhabi guaranteed the team a substantial windfall of commercial prize money from the FIA.
segments.zh: 在阿布達比爆冷奪冠，為車隊鎖定了來自國際汽聯的一大筆極其可觀的巨額商業分紅獎金。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 191–200：marshal、lifeline、racing incident、decoy、send it、toe-to-toe、back down、breathtaking、slay、bitching。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Alert marshals leaped across the crash barriers with dry chemical extinguishers the instant flames erupted from the ruptured fuel system.
segments.zh: 在破裂的燃油系統噴出烈焰的瞬間，機警的賽道工作人員手提乾粉滅火器飛躍防撞護欄衝入現場撲救。

segments.en: Waving yellow flags with fierce urgency, the circuit marshal warned oncoming drivers of the shattered carbon wing lying in the braking zone.
segments.zh: 賽道裁判員極其急促地揮舞著黃旗，警告迎面飛馳而來的車手煞車區內散落著碎裂的碳纖維尾翼。

segments.en: The sudden red flag was an unexpected lifeline for Sonny, allowing his exhausted mechanics to replace a shattered rear wing before the restart.
segments.zh: 突如其來的紅旗成了桑尼意想不到的救命稻草，讓精疲力竭的技師得以在重啟前及時更換被撞爛的後尾翼。

segments.en: Scoring a single world championship point served as an economic lifeline that kept the bank loans from defaulting on Monday morning.
segments.zh: 搶下哪怕僅僅一個世界錦標賽積分，都成了維繫車隊生命的經濟救命稻草，確保週一清晨銀行貸款不至於全面違約。

segments.en: The stewards reviewed multi-angle telemetry footage and officially classified the turn-four collision between Russell and Hayes as a racing incident.
segments.zh: 幹事在仔細審查了多角度的遙測畫面後，正式將拉塞爾與海耶斯在四號彎的碰撞定性為免予受罰的常規競賽意外。

segments.en: Relieved that their aggressive tactics were dismissed as a normal racing incident, the team principal ordered his crew to prepare for the final three-lap shootout.
segments.zh: 慶幸己方的激進戰術被裁定為免罰的常規競賽意外，車隊領隊立即下令後勤團隊全力備戰最後三圈的決戰衝刺。

segments.en: Sonny acted as a high-speed aerodynamic decoy along the outside kerb, baiting Leclerc into defending while Joshua sliced cleanly through the open inside line.
segments.zh: 桑尼在外側路肩充當高速空氣動力學誘餌，引誘勒克萊爾向外線防守，從而掩護約書亞從空出的內線乾淨俐落地反超殺出。

segments.en: Using their second car as a tactical decoy forced rival strategists to split their pit stop windows, handing Apex GP the outright lead.
segments.zh: 將第二輛賽車作為戰術誘餌，迫使對手戰術師分化進站窗口，從而將全場絕對領先的寶座拱手送給了彎心車隊。

segments.en: "It's the final lap of my life—tell the team I’m just going to send it," Sonny whispered over the radio before diving down the inside of turn one.
segments.zh: 「這是我這輩子最後一圈了——轉告車隊，我要不管不顧全力豁出去衝了，」桑尼在無線電中低語，隨後如死神般強插進一號彎內線。

segments.en: With fresh soft tires mounted on the chassis, Joshua knew he had to send it through the high-speed chicane to secure the lead.
segments.zh: 底盤換上了全新的軟胎，約書亞深知自己必須在高速雙急彎放手一搏全力豁出去衝，才能將領先優勢死死握在手中。

segments.en: The championship finale erupted into an unforgettable spectacle as the veteran and the seven-time champion went toe-to-toe through the desert curves.
segments.zh: 收官戰徹底引爆成一場載入史冊的傳奇名局，老將與七屆世界冠軍在沙漠賽道的連續彎道中展開了短兵相接的正面血戰。

segments.en: Refusing to back down against factory powerhouses, Apex GP proved their upgraded machine could battle toe-to-toe with the world's best.
segments.zh: 在廠隊豪門面前寸步不讓，彎心車隊用實力證明了他們升級後的戰車完全具備與世界頂級強隊正面硬碰硬的實力。

segments.en: Lewis Hamilton is legendary for his racecraft, but Sonny Hayes proved that he would never back down from a wheel-to-wheel scrap along the straight.
segments.zh: 劉易斯·漢密爾頓的戰術走線堪稱傳奇，但桑尼·海耶斯用行動證明，他在直道進行輪對輪肉搏時絕不會退縮讓步半吋。

segments.en: Joshua held his line aggressively into the braking zone, refusing to back down even as titanium sparks rained across his front wing.
segments.zh: 約書亞在煞車區強硬死守自己的行車線，即便漫天鈦合金火花如暴雨般澆淋在他的前翼上，他也誓死絕不退讓。

segments.en: Sonny swept past two championship contenders in a single breathtaking sweep around the outside of the banked curve, electrifying the grandstands.
segments.zh: 桑尼在帶有傾角的高速彎外側，以上演了一記令人屏息的一挑二連續反超，引爆了整座看台的狂歡聲浪。

segments.en: Crossing the finish line to claim victory after thirty years of heartbreak was a breathtaking conclusion to an improbable Grand Prix journey.
segments.zh: 在承受了三十年的心碎沉淪後衝過終點線斬獲冠軍，為這段不可思議的大獎賽救贖之旅劃下了一個令人屏息的史詩句點。

segments.en: With the Grand Prix victory secured, Sonny smiled, packed his bags, and quietly declared he had a couple more personal dragons to slay in Baja.
segments.zh: 大獎賽分站冠軍已然收入囊中，桑尼微微一笑收拾行囊，平靜地表示自己還要在巴哈越野賽場上去斬殺幾條屬於他人生的心魔惡龍。

segments.en: To win the championship, the rookie had to conquer his internal demons and slay the giant reputations of seasoned world champions on track.
segments.zh: 要想問鼎總冠軍，這位新秀就必須戰勝內心的心魔，在賽道上正面屠滅那些聲名顯赫的常勝老將們的巍峨神話。

segments.en: Molly chuckled into the headset, telling Sonny that the rival BMW mechanics were over there bitching incessantly about fading brake pressures.
segments.zh: 莫莉對著耳機耳麥輕聲笑道，轉告桑尼隔壁寶馬車隊的技師正聚在那邊對不斷衰退的煞車油壓牢騷抱怨個沒完。

segments.en: "Stop bitching about the stiff suspension balance and just drive the car through the apex," the race engineer barked over the team radio.
segments.zh: 「少在無線電裡對死硬的懸吊平衡發牢騷抱怨了，專心把車給我切過彎心，」比賽工程師沒好氣地在通話中斥責道。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 201–210：superstar、overnight、high-speed balance、head of the pack、straight、brake pedal、set sights on、pit lane、head start、bad luck。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Sonny flashed a grateful grin and called Molly an absolute superstar after she tipped him off about BMW's overheating front brake calipers.
segments.zh: 在莫莉向他通報寶馬車隊前煞車卡鉗過熱的關鍵情報後，桑尼露出感激的微笑，稱讚她真是個無可替代的得力助手（superstar）。

segments.en: Thrust into the global spotlight after his podium finish, Joshua struggled to balance the intoxicating lifestyle of a motorsport superstar with the grueling discipline of testing.
segments.zh: 登上頒獎台後被推至全球聚光燈下，約書亞難以在賽車超級巨星令人沉醉的生活方式與試車測試極其折磨的自律之間取得平衡。

segments.en: The crew chief instructed Sonny to nurse the vibrating transmission overnight, hoping that the rising morning sun would bring cooler track temperatures and a change of fortune.
segments.zh: 車隊主管指示桑尼整夜小心保護劇烈震動的變速箱，期望清晨升起的太陽能帶來更低的賽道溫度與翻盤轉機。

segments.en: Mechanics worked flat-out overnight inside the garage, completely stripping the monocoque and rebuilding the rear suspension before dawn broke over the circuit.
segments.zh: 技師們在車庫裡徹夜連軸轉狂暴搶修，在破曉曙光籠罩賽道之前，將整架單體座艙徹底拆解並重建了後懸吊系統。

segments.en: Radioing the cockpit through Copse corner, the engineer repeatedly warned Sonny to monitor his high-speed balance as violent crosswinds swept across the runway straights.
segments.zh: 當強烈的側風席捲跑道直道時，工程師在桑尼切過科普斯彎時透過無線電反覆警告他，務必密切監控賽車的高速車身平衡。

segments.en: Kate trimmed the rear wing flap angle by half a degree, successfully restoring the delicate high-speed balance required to navigate the sweeping desert esses flat-out.
segments.zh: 凱特將後尾翼襟翼角度微調了半度，成功恢復了全油門高速劈過沙漠連續 S 彎所必需的敏銳高速車身平衡。

segments.en: Staring at the gleaming taillights at the head of the pack, Sonny realized that hunting down the dominant works BMW would require nothing short of an aerodynamic miracle.
segments.zh: 凝視著車群領先位置那幾具閃爍的尾燈，桑尼意識到想要追擊全場最具統治力的寶馬廠車，除了空氣動力學奇蹟之外別無他法。

segments.en: A lightning-fast reaction at the start vaulted Joshua directly to the head of the pack, placing the entire tactical pressure of the race onto his young shoulders.
segments.zh: 起跑時閃電般的極致反應將約書亞直接送上了車群領先位置，將整場比賽全部的戰術重壓瞬間壓在了這名年輕車手的肩頭。

segments.en: Lacking the raw engine kilowatts to challenge rivals down the main straight, Apex GP was forced to execute suicidal late-braking overtakes into the chicanes.
segments.zh: 缺乏在主直道上與對手正面硬拼的純粹引擎千瓦輸出，彎心車隊被迫在減速急彎前執行近乎自殺式的延遲極限煞車超車。

segments.en: Deploying the full electric boost along the back straight allowed Sonny to pull completely alongside Hamilton before reaching the two-hundred-meter braking marker.
segments.zh: 在後直道上全面釋放所有混合動力電能加速，讓桑尼在抵達兩百米煞車標誌牌之前，便已經與漢密爾頓徹底並駕齊驅。

segments.en: Watching Sonny divebomb three cars simultaneously, the trackside commentator joked that the reckless veteran seemed to have left his brake pedal at home.
segments.zh: 看著桑尼一口氣自殺式俯衝強超三輛賽車，場邊解說員調侃說這位魯莽的老將似乎把他的煞車踏板落在家裡忘記帶出門了。

segments.en: Joshua stamped frantically on the spongy brake pedal, only to feel hydraulic pressure vanish entirely as boiling fluid poured across the calipers.
segments.zh: 約書亞瘋狂重踩疲軟的煞車踏板，卻只感受到液壓徹底潰散，沸騰的煞車油已然噴淋在整組卡鉗之上。

segments.en: Once he cleared the snarling midfield traffic, Sonny immediately set his sights on the charging Red Bull disappearing over the distant crest.
segments.zh: 一旦擺脫了混戰糾纏的中游車陣，桑尼立即將目光死死鎖定在正消失在遠處坡頂的狂飆紅牛賽車。

segments.en: Determined to cement his legacy before retirement, the veteran set his sights on taking the checkered flag in the season finale at Abu Dhabi.
segments.zh: 決心在退役前徹底奠定自己的歷史地位，這位老將將全部心力瞄準在阿布達比收官之戰中率先斬獲方格旗。

segments.en: Sonny brought the smoking machine into the pit lane on three rims after an epic stint that dragged his team from last place to the front.
segments.zh: 在完成了一輪將車隊從墊底一路拖上領先集團的史詩級長途駕駛後，桑尼開著僅剩三隻輪圈冒著濃煙的賽車拐入了維修區通道。

segments.en: A sudden pit lane speed limiter failure resulted in a disastrous penalty that instantly wiped out thirty laps of painstaking tactical gains.
segments.zh: 維修區限速器突如其來的電子故障導致了一次災難性的罰秒，瞬間抹平了全隊苦戰三十圈才累積出的寶貴戰術戰果。

segments.en: Cale thanked Sonny for handing him an unexpected thirty-second head start, leaping into the driver's seat to protect their hard-won endurance lead.
segments.zh: 凱爾向桑尼致謝，感謝他為自己爭取到了意料之外的三十秒領先優勢，隨後躍入駕駛座力保這場艱難耐力賽的頭名戰果。

segments.en: Entering the championship battle mid-season without winter testing meant the rookie had surrendered an enormous head start to his factory-backed rivals.
segments.zh: 在沒有參加冬季測試的情況下季中半路殺入錦標賽爭奪，意味著這名新秀已經向擁有廠隊全力支援的對手拱手讓出了巨大的先行優勢。

segments.en: Sonny adamantly refused to touch the gleaming Daytona victory trophy before the official race classification was ratified, superstitious that celebrating early invited terrible bad luck.
segments.zh: 在官方正式確認最終成績之前，桑尼堅決拒絕觸摸那座閃閃發光的代托納冠軍獎盃，迷信地認為提前慶祝會招來厄運與晦氣。

segments.en: Experiencing three consecutive engine failures during qualifying was written off as atrocious bad luck by the frustrated engineering crew.
segments.zh: 在排位賽中連續遭遇三次引擎爆缸，被滿腹挫折感的工程後勤團隊無奈歸咎為極度倒楣的飛來霉運。

articles.titleZh: 第 22 課 · bonus check–assembly line
articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 211–220：bonus check、bring on board、run it back、one and done、start over、down the road、in the hole、turn it around、force a sale、assembly line。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Shrugging off the ceremonial champagne shower, Sonny pocketed the five-thousand-dollar bonus check and quietly packed his bags to slip away.
segments.zh: 對儀式性的香檳慶祝嗤之以鼻，桑尼將那張五千美元的獎金支票塞進口袋，隨後默默收拾行囊悄然離去。

segments.en: Ruben promised the exhausted mechanics a massive performance bonus check if they managed to keep both cars running inside the points.
segments.zh: 魯本向疲憊不堪的技師們許諾，只要他們能確保兩輛賽車雙雙完賽搶下積分，就給全體發放一筆巨額的戰績獎金支票。

segments.en: Desperate to inject championship-winning DNA into his foundering squad, Ruben traveled thousands of miles to bring Sonny on board as a primary driver.
segments.zh: 為了將奪冠基因注入自己這支搖搖欲墜的車隊，魯本奔波數千英里，竭盡全力想要將桑尼招攬入隊擔任主力車手。

segments.en: Attracting top-tier aerodynamic talent was impossible until Kate was brought on board to completely restructure the technical department.
segments.zh: 在凱特被正式招募進來全面重組技術部門之前，想要吸引頂級空氣動力學天才加盟對這支車隊而言根本是痴人說夢。

segments.en: Ecstatic over their stunning 24-hour endurance triumph, Chip begged Sonny to sign a multi-year extension and run it back together next season.
segments.zh: 沉浸在二十四小時耐力賽震撼奪冠的狂喜中，奇普懇求桑尼簽下一份多年續約合約，下個賽季原班人馬再戰一回。

segments.en: Following their violent crash at Silverstone, Joshua challenged Sonny to run it back on identical setups during private testing to prove who was genuinely faster.
segments.zh: 在銀石發生慘烈相撞後，約書亞向桑尼發起挑釁，要求在私人測試中使用完全相同的調校重來一局，以證明誰才是真正更快的那個人。

segments.en: Sonny made it clear from the opening handshake that his endurance appearance was strictly a one and done freelance assignment with zero long-term commitments.
segments.zh: 從最初握手那一刻起桑尼便明確表示，自己參加這場耐力賽純粹是一次性的跑腿買賣，絕不附帶任何長期續約承諾。

segments.en: "Don't treat this Grand Prix opportunity like a reckless one and done joyride," Ruben pleaded with the veteran as they finalized contract terms.
segments.zh: 「別把這次重返大獎賽的寶貴機會當成一場破罐子破摔、僅此一次的兜風狂歡，」在敲定合約條款時魯本對這位老將苦苦相勸。

segments.en: Having burned through championships, fortunes, and marriages, Sonny had spent his entire chaotic life being forced to pack a van and start over.
segments.zh: 在揮霍光了錦標賽頭銜、財富與婚姻之後，桑尼跌宕起伏的大半生都在被迫收拾一輛破廂型車然後狼狽地東山再起。

segments.en: Erasing the catastrophic first half of their season allowed the entire Apex GP garage to mentally reset and start over from scratch.
segments.zh: 將上半賽季災難性的慘敗戰績從腦海中徹底抹去，讓整個彎心車隊的維修庫在心理上重整旗鼓，一切從零重新開始。

segments.en: Parting ways after their unlikely victory celebration, Sonny simply tapped his old friend on the shoulder and said he would see him down the road.
segments.zh: 在那場不可思議的勝利慶祝後分道揚鑣之際，桑尼只是拍了拍老友的肩膀，淡淡說了句後會有期、江湖再見。

segments.en: Investing heavily in youth simulator training was a strategic gamble designed to pay enormous competitive dividends three years down the road.
segments.zh: 在大力投資青年車手模擬器培訓上豪賭一把，是一項旨在三年後的未來收穫巨大競爭紅利的深遠戰略佈局。

segments.en: Ruben nervously poured a shot of cheap tequila before confessing to Sonny that Apex GP was currently three point five million dollars deep in the hole.
segments.zh: 魯本神經質地倒了一杯廉價龍舌蘭一飲而盡，隨後才向桑尼坦白彎心車隊目前深陷三百五十萬美元的巨額財務虧損黑洞中。

segments.en: Racing without primary title sponsors pushed the independent constructor two million dollars further in the hole with every passing Grand Prix weekend.
segments.zh: 在缺乏一級冠名贊助商的情況下裸奔參賽，讓這家獨立私人車隊在每度過一個大獎賽週末後，負債帳目上便又多出兩百萬美元的窟窿。

segments.en: If the technical department could not turn it around and score points before the summer shutdown, the board was legally empowered to auction off the team.
segments.zh: 如果技術部門無法在夏季夏休停擺前逆轉局勢奪得積分，董事會將在法律上獲得強制拍賣出售整支車隊的權力。

segments.en: Sonny's arrival provided the emotional spark required to turn it around, transforming a defeated collection of mechanics into a fearless race-winning unit.
segments.zh: 桑尼的空降帶來了扭轉乾坤所需的情感火花，將一群原本士氣渙散的後勤技師徹底蛻變為一支無所畏懼的冠軍鐵軍。

segments.en: Under the strict clauses of the shareholder covenant, failing to secure a podium finish within three seasons permitted hostile investors to force a sale.
segments.zh: 根據股東協議中嚴格的對賭條款，若三個賽季內未能登上頒獎台，敵意投資人將獲准啟動條款強行出售車隊。

segments.en: Peter Banning plotted in secret to sabotage their race strategy, deliberately trying to orchestrate a technical failure that would force a fire sale.
segments.zh: 彼得·班寧在暗中精心策劃破壞正賽策略，處心積慮試圖製造一場機械故障，好以跳樓價強行賤賣車隊。

segments.en: Sonny scoffed at modern driver academies, dismissing modern rookies as robotic clones churned off a soulless corporate assembly line.
segments.zh: 桑尼對當代青訓學院嗤之以鼻，將現代新秀車手貶低為沒有靈魂的企業裝配流水線上成批生產出來的機器人複製品。

segments.en: Back at the factory, the carbon fiber production line operated like a high-precision military assembly line to output new wings every twelve hours.
segments.zh: 在後方工廠裡，碳纖維生產線如同高精密的軍工裝配流水線般全速運轉，每十二小時便能下線一套嶄新的機翼套件。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 221–230：simulator、pilot a rocket、Grand Prix、know-how、off one's meds、upgrade package、development、finish line、first-class、open seat。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Joshua spent hundreds of grueling hours strapped inside the multi-million-dollar motion simulator, memorizing every asphalt bump and curb profile across Silverstone.
segments.zh: 約書亞在價值數百萬美元的動態模擬器裡苦戰了數百個小時，將銀石賽道上每一處柏油顛簸與路肩起伏死死印在腦海中。

segments.en: Rejecting modern digital telemetry, Sonny claimed that thirty minutes of feeling lateral G-forces on asphalt taught him more than a month inside a simulator.
segments.zh: 排斥現代數位遙測技術的桑尼聲稱，在真實柏油路上肉身感受三十分鐘橫向 G 力，比在模擬器裡待上整整一個月學到的東西還要多。

segments.en: Sonny retorted that you don't just pull someone off a commercial street corner and expect them to pilot a rocket without extensive muscle memory.
segments.zh: 桑尼反脣相譏道，你可不能隨隨便便從商業大街上隨便拉個人，就指望他在毫無肌肉記憶的情況下跑去駕馭開動一艘極速火箭。

segments.en: Strapped inside a modern ground-effect hybrid machine generating a thousand horsepower, the rookie felt like he was being commanded to pilot a rocket into orbit.
segments.zh: 被緊緊綁在一輛能壓榨出一千匹馬力的現代地面效應油電賽車裡，這名新秀感覺自己像是被下令去駕駛一艘衝向軌道的載人火箭。

segments.en: Winning a solitary Grand Prix after a thirty-year odyssey of injury and poverty represented the ultimate emotional redemption for Sonny Hayes.
segments.zh: 在歷經長達三十年傷痛與潦倒的流浪放逐後奪得一座大獎賽分站冠軍，代表了桑尼·海耶斯人生最極致的情感救贖。

segments.en: The atmospheric buildup before the British Grand Prix was electric as over one hundred thousand roaring spectators flooded the historic circuit.
segments.zh: 英國大獎賽開跑前夕的現場氛圍令人血脈賁張，十多萬名狂熱吶喊的觀眾湧入了這座歷史悠久的傳奇賽道。

segments.en: While young drivers relied blindly on computer-modeled throttle maps, Sonny brought decades of hard-won mechanical know-how to vehicle setup.
segments.zh: 當年輕車手只會盲目依賴電腦模擬的油門輸出曲線時，桑尼為車輛調校注入了他耗費數十年心血換來的實戰機械訣竅（know-how）。

segments.en: Without the engineering know-how of veteran mechanics who understood titanium heat tolerances, the fragile turbochargers would have detonated under race loads.
segments.zh: 如果沒有那些深諳鈦合金耐熱極限的老牌技師提供的實務技能訣竅，脆弱的渦輪增壓器在正賽負荷下早就爆炸解體了。

segments.en: Watching Ruben sign an uninsurable sixty-year-old drifter to pilot their multimillion-dollar race car, Kaspar bluntly asked if the owner was off his meds.
segments.zh: 看著魯本簽下一名連保險都買不了的六十歲流浪老頭來開他們價值數百萬美元的賽車，卡什帕直截了當地質問老闆是不是腦子進水發瘋了。

segments.en: Proposing a radical zero-stop tire strategy in scorching desert conditions convinced the pit wall that the senior strategist had gone completely off his meds.
segments.zh: 在酷熱的沙漠極端環境下提議採用零進站的瘋狂輪胎策略，讓指揮台確信這位資深戰術師絕對是徹底瘋了。

segments.en: Kate proudly unveiled the comprehensive mid-season upgrade package, featuring radically sculpted floor edges and redesigned titanium exhaust exits.
segments.zh: 凱特驕傲地揭開了這套季中全面升級套件的神秘面紗，其亮點在於雕塑感極強的激進底板邊緣與重新設計的鈦合金排氣口。

segments.en: Bolting on the untested upgrade package mere minutes before Friday practice gave the drivers no baseline data to benchmark their mechanical balance.
segments.zh: 在週五自由練習賽開始前幾分鐘才匆匆把未經測試的升級套件栓在車上，讓車手們根本沒有任何基準數據來衡量機械平衡。

segments.en: Ruben assured the panicked investors that their revolutionary combat floor had undergone six intense months of confidential aerodynamic development.
segments.zh: 魯本向恐慌的投資人打包票保證，他們革命性的戰鬥底板已經歷了整整六個月高度保密的空氣動力學研發歷程。

segments.en: Shifting all computational fluid resources into next year's car halted developmental progress on their current chassis, locking them into a defensive strategy.
segments.zh: 將全部計算流體力學運算資源轉移到明年的新車上，徹底叫停了當前底盤的研發進程，迫使他們在本賽季陷入被動防守。

segments.en: Sonny dragged the violently sparking car across the finish line by five thousandths of a second, collapsing over the steering wheel in total exhaustion.
segments.zh: 桑尼開著火花狂噴的賽車以千分之五秒的微弱優勢率先衝過終點線，隨後筋疲力盡地直接癱倒在方向盤上。

segments.en: As black-and-gold machines crossed the finish line in formation, tears of disbelief and euphoric relief erupted across the entire pit garage.
segments.zh: 當黑金塗裝的戰車編隊呼嘯衝過終點線時，難以置信的熱淚與狂喜釋懷的歡呼在整間維修車庫內瞬間爆發。

segments.en: Flipping a non-refundable first-class plane ticket to London across the greasy diner table, Ruben dared his cynical old friend to refuse the offer.
segments.zh: 將一張無法退票的倫敦頭等艙機票甩在油膩的餐館桌面上，魯本挑釁這位憤世嫉俗的老友敢不敢拒絕這份邀約。

segments.en: Operating a first-class engineering facility requires millions in continuous tooling investment that an impoverished independent team can rarely sustain.
segments.zh: 運營一座第一流的工程研發中心需要持續投入數以百萬計的機具研發資金，這對於一家貧困潦倒的私人獨立車隊而言幾乎難以為繼。

segments.en: Ruben made the pitch of a lifetime, dangling the rarest commodity in global motorsport before Sonny’s eyes: a fully funded open seat in Formula 1.
segments.zh: 魯本開出了這輩子最誘人的條件，將全球賽車運動中最稀缺的昂貴籌碼直接懸在桑尼眼前：一個全額資助的 F1 空缺車手席位。

segments.en: Hearing rumors that Luca was being courted for the second open seat drove Joshua to push recklessly during rainy practice sessions.
segments.zh: 聽到車隊正極力拉攏盧卡來填補第二個空缺車手席位的傳言，迫使約書亞在雨地練習賽中瘋狂失控冒進。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 231–240：miracle、too good to be true、tire temp、strat、sector、purple sector、flat spot、press conference、steer around、bond。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: "Have you ever witnessed an honest-to-god miracle in your life?" Sonny asked with a smirk, fully aware of the sheer impossibility of their quest.
segments.zh: 「你這輩子親眼見過哪怕一次真真切切的奇蹟嗎？」桑尼冷笑著問道，心裡對這項任務純粹的異想天開與不可能心知肚明。

segments.en: Rebuilding a shattered rear wing structure inside ten red-flagged minutes and returning the car to the grid was nothing short of an engineering miracle.
segments.zh: 在出示紅旗的短短十分鐘內重構被撞得稀爛的後尾翼結構並讓賽車奇蹟般重返發車格，這不折不扣是一場工程奇蹟。

segments.en: Being offered an immediate multimillion-dollar Grand Prix comeback without bringing personal sponsorship sounded entirely too good to be true.
segments.zh: 在完全不需要自帶贊助資金的情況下被奉上一紙價值數百萬的大獎賽復出合約，這聽起來美好得簡直令人難以置信。

segments.en: When telemetry showed a sudden gain of eight tenths through sector two, Kate suspected a sensor failure because the speed jump was simply too good to be true.
segments.zh: 當遙測數據顯示在第二計時段圈速暴增零點八秒時，凱特首先懷疑是感應器壞了，因為這種速度暴漲美好得太不真實。

segments.en: Hugh radioed constant updates on front tire temps, advising Sonny to weave aggressively across the safety car convoy to keep the compound sticky.
segments.zh: 休在無線電中不斷通報前輪胎溫度的即時數據，建議桑尼在安全車帶隊時猛烈蛇形走位，以保持輪胎膠料處於黏性工作溫度。

segments.en: Plunging tire temps during the drizzle phase transformed the grooved slicks into rock-hard ice skates that offered zero lateral bite.
segments.zh: 在細雨階段暴跌的輪胎溫度，將光頭胎瞬間變成了冰冷堅硬的溜冰鞋，完全喪失了任何橫向過彎抓地力。

segments.en: "Confirming battery reserves are optimal—switch dial to strat two and prepare for a flying qualification lap," the race engineer instructed sharply.
segments.zh: 「確認電池儲能處於最佳狀態——將旋鈕切換至二號動力模式（strat two），準備展開飛馳排位圈，」比賽工程師乾脆俐落地指示道。

segments.en: Running in maximum attack strat for five consecutive laps overheated the motor generator units, forcing the driver to dial back into conservation mode.
segments.zh: 連續五圈處於最大進攻引擎模式下狂飆導致電動發電機單元過熱，迫使車手不得不將旋鈕切回保守模式。

segments.en: Sonny pinned the throttle through the blind crest, shaving two tenths off his personal best and setting the fastest time through sector one.
segments.zh: 桑尼頂住全油門狂衝過盲眼坡頂，將個人最佳成績縮短了零點二秒，並在第一計時段刷出了全場最快成績。

segments.en: A yellow flag waved suddenly across the second sector, forcing all chasing cars to lift off and abort their fast flying attempts.
segments.zh: 黃旗突然在第二計時段瘋狂揮舞，迫使所有後方追擊的賽車不得不鬆開油門，被迫放棄飛馳計時圈的衝刺。

segments.en: The digital timing screens flashed an electric purple sector one for Joshua, sending an electric shockwave of excitement through the quiet garage.
segments.zh: 數位計時螢幕上為約書亞亮起了一道代表全場最快的紫色計時段（purple sector one），讓原本死寂的車庫瞬間爆發出觸電般的興奮狂潮。

segments.en: Hooking up all three purple sectors on a single qualifying flyer requires absolute precision, flawless machine setup, and zero mechanical compromises.
segments.zh: 在單個排位飛馳圈中將全部三個計時段通通刷紫，需要絕對的精準度、完美無瑕的車輛調校以及零機械妥協。

segments.en: Stamping on the brakes to avoid an errant back marker locked the front left tire, burning a severe flat spot into the rubber compound.
segments.zh: 為了避開失控打轉的慢車而猛踩煞車導致左前輪抱死，在橡膠胎面上狠狠磨出了一個嚴重的輪胎平點。

segments.en: Violent cockpit vibrations caused by a massive tire flat spot tore the steering wheel from the rookie’s hands through the braking zone.
segments.zh: 巨大的輪胎平點引發了駕駛艙內極其劇烈的震顫，在煞車區狂暴地把方向盤從這名新秀的手中猛震脫手。

segments.en: Media handlers warned Joshua to steer clear of divisive technical questions during the live press conference and focus entirely on commercial unity.
segments.zh: 公關人員警告約書亞在現場直播的新聞發布會上避開具有爭議的技術問題，將話題焦點完全鎖定在展現商業團結上。

segments.en: Don Cavendish used the post-qualifying press conference to ruthlessly interrogate Sonny regarding his thirty-year absence and past personal bankruptcies.
segments.zh: 唐·卡文迪許利用排位賽後的新聞發布會，無情地當眾盤問桑尼三十年的銷聲匿跡與過去的個人破產黑歷史。

segments.en: Lisbeth instructed the drivers to steer around delicate internal sabotage inquiries and emphasize the newfound harmony developing inside the garage.
segments.zh: 利斯貝思指示車手們刻意繞開敏感的內部破壞醜聞調查，著重強調車庫內部日益建立的新和睦關係。

segments.en: Sonny skillfully steered around aggressive journalistic baiting, refusing to give the hostile press corps any inflammatory pull-quotes.
segments.zh: 桑尼老練地迴避了記者們咄咄逼人的言語陷阱，堅決不給敵意滿滿的媒體記者團任何可供大作文章的煽動性話柄。

segments.en: Public relations demanded that the team manufacture a false marketing bond between the young rookie and his skeptical veteran teammate.
segments.zh: 公關團隊強烈要求在年輕新秀與心存戒備的老將隊友之間，憑空捏造包裝出一份迎合行銷宣傳的虛假默契與羈絆。

segments.en: Surviving terrifying high-G crashes and late-night debriefings forged an unspoken, unbreakable bond between the two fiercely competitive racers.
segments.zh: 挺過可怕的高 G 力撞車慘劇與深夜高強度賽後檢討，在這兩位競爭心極強的車手之間鑄就了一份無需言語的堅固羈絆。

articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 241–250：teammate、let that sink in、maintenance、technical director、chief mechanic、team principal、Constructors champion、turn down、floor、lap time。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: In Formula 1, your teammate is simultaneously your sole strategic collaborator and the single most dangerous threat to your ongoing career.
segments.zh: 在 F1 賽場上，你的隊友既是你唯一的戰術合作夥伴，同時也是對你職業生涯構成最致命威脅的頭號敵人。

segments.en: Sonny sacrificed his own tires to build an impenetrable aerodynamic wall, shielding his charging teammate from the closing Ferrari behind.
segments.zh: 桑尼犧牲了自己的輪胎磨損構建起一道固若金湯的空力屏障，為身後瘋狂追擊的年輕隊友擋住了步步進逼的法拉利。

segments.en: "If Ruben sells the operation to corporate raiders, your Grand Prix dream dies by Monday morning—let that sink in, bro," his manager warned.
segments.zh: 「如果魯本把車隊賣給企業收購狂人，你的大獎賽之夢在週一早晨就會徹底粉碎——給我好好想清楚這個殘酷現實，兄弟，」經紀人厲聲警告。

segments.en: Standing before the towering trophy cabinet of past world champions, the rookie stood frozen as he let the sheer weight of his opportunity sink in.
segments.zh: 站在陳列著歷代世界冠軍獎盃的高聳榮譽陳列櫃前，這名新秀僵在原地，任由這份天賜良機無比沉重的份量在心頭慢慢消化沉澱。

segments.en: Dressed in a faded racing jacket, Sonny was mistaken for an ordinary maintenance worker by security guards and directed toward the rear deliveries gate.
segments.zh: 身穿一件褪色賽車夾克的桑尼，被安保警衛誤當成了普通的維修保養雜工，直接被指派打發走向後方的貨物卸載大門。

segments.en: Rigorous post-race maintenance protocols required technicians to x-ray every titanium bolt to detect hidden stress fractures.
segments.zh: 賽後嚴格的保養維護規程要求技術人員對每一顆鈦合金螺栓進行 X 光光學透視掃描，以檢測隱藏的應力微裂紋。

segments.en: As the first female technical director in the history of the sport, Kate refused to let paddock sexism undermine her radical aerodynamic revolution.
segments.zh: 身為這項運動歷史上第一位女性技術總監，凱特絕不容許圍場內任何性別偏見動搖她大刀闊斧的激進空氣動力學革命。

segments.en: The technical director locked herself in the composites room for thirty hours, personally supervising the curing of their newly legal floor tunnels.
segments.zh: 技術總監把自己反鎖在複合材料工作室裡整整三十個小時，親自監督他們新合法化底板通風文氏管的加溫固化成型過程。

segments.en: Dodge, the weathered chief mechanic, barked orders across the bustling garage, coordinating four tire changes inside a blistering two seconds.
segments.zh: 飽經滄桑的首席機械師道奇在喧囂繁忙的車庫裡扯著嗓子發號施令，精準調度團隊在短短兩秒極限內完成了四輪更換。

segments.en: Consulting the chief mechanic before every session provided Sonny with invaluable tactical feedback regarding composite suspension wear.
segments.zh: 在每個節次開跑前與首席機械師深度溝通，為桑尼提供了關於複合材料懸吊磨損狀況不可或缺的實戰技術回饋。

segments.en: The beleaguered team principal faced relentless pressure from corporate executives demanding immediate performance justifications for their millions.
segments.zh: 身陷重圍的車隊領隊面臨著來自企業高層無休止的問責施壓，強烈要求他對數百萬投資預算換來的糟糕戰績給出合理解釋。

segments.en: Kaspar proved his worth as team principal by maintaining absolute iron discipline inside the garage even as rumors of bankruptcy swirled.
segments.zh: 即便破產謠言甚囂塵上，卡什帕透過在維修庫內維持絕對鐵腕的紀律，充分展現了他身為車隊負責人的無可替代價值。

segments.en: Kaspar reminded arrogant younger engineers that he had earned five rings as Constructors champion with Ferrari through pure sweat and discipline.
segments.zh: 卡什帕嚴肅訓誡那些狂妄自大的年輕工程師，自己曾隨法拉利五度問鼎車隊世界總冠軍榮耀，靠的完全是血汗付出與鐵一般的紀律。

segments.en: Hoisting the coveted Constructors champion trophy remains the ultimate collective holy grail for every specialized engineer in the paddock.
segments.zh: 高高捧起夢寐以求的車隊世界總冠軍獎盃，依然是圍場內每一名各領域頂尖工程師心中至高無上的集體聖杯。

segments.en: Ruben confessed bitterly that seven established veteran drivers had flatly turned down his desperate offer before he tracked down Sonny in Florida.
segments.zh: 魯本苦澀地坦承，在他前往佛羅里達找到桑尼之前，已經有整整七位成名老將毫不留情地斷然拒絕了他孤注一擲的合約要約。

segments.en: Joshua proudly decided to turn down a lucrative reserve seat offer from a rival powerhouse, choosing instead to stay loyal to the Apex crew.
segments.zh: 約書亞無比自豪地決定回絕對手豪門拋出的高薪替補車手合約，毅然選擇留下來繼續堅定效忠於彎心團隊。

segments.en: Sweeping changes to the aerodynamic floor generated massive ground-effect downforce, effectively sucking the black chassis directly onto the tarmac.
segments.zh: 對空氣動力學底板進行的翻天覆地改造產生了無比狂暴的地面效應下壓力，如同一隻無形巨手將黑色底盤死死吸附在柏油路面上。

segments.en: Grinding over aggressive exit kerbs damaged the carbon floor fences, instantly bleeding off twenty points of vital high-speed downforce.
segments.zh: 在狂暴的出彎路肩上劇烈磨底刮壞了碳纖維底板導流柵，瞬間流失了高達二十分的高速關鍵下壓力。

segments.en: Finding half a second of precious lap time overnight astonished rival telemetry analysts who suspected illegal flexible wing deflection.
segments.zh: 僅用一個晚上便匪夷所思地將單圈圈速縮短了半秒，震驚了競爭對手的遙測分析團隊，懷疑他們違規使用了彈性尾翼形變作弊。

segments.en: Sonny posted a blistering lap time that fell within five hundredths of Joshua’s benchmark, proving his raw qualifying speed remained intact.
segments.zh: 桑尼跑出了一個震撼全場的極限圈速，距離約書亞的基準成績僅差百分之五秒，證明他純粹的排位賽速度依舊寶刀未老。

articles.titleZh: 第 26 課 · within a second–national anthem
articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 251–260：within a second、see oneself out、race engineer、self-test、sponsor、put head down、reckless phenomenon、abrupt halt、driver signing、national anthem。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Sonny staked his entire comeback on the bold promise that he would lap within a second of Joshua's time or voluntarily walk out the door.
segments.zh: 桑尼將自己整個復出前途押在了一個豪賭承諾上：圈速必須跑進約書亞的一秒以內，否則他將主動收拾鋪蓋走人。

segments.en: Crossing the finish line within a second of the race leader secured Apex GP their first double-points finish in franchise history.
segments.zh: 以距離領跑者不到一秒之差呼嘯衝過終點線，為彎心車隊鎖定了隊史上首個雙車挺進積分區完賽的里程碑。

segments.en: "If I cannot match this kid's telemetry on equal machinery, I will gladly pack my bag and see myself out," Sonny challenged the garage.
segments.zh: 「如果用完全相同的賽車我還追不上這孩子的遙測數據，我會高高興興收拾行囊自行滾蛋走人，」桑尼在車庫裡公開立下戰書。

segments.en: Knowing he had betrayed the team's engineering secrets, the corporate spy quietly packed his laptop and saw himself out before security arrived.
segments.zh: 深知自己已經出賣了車隊的工程機密，那名商業間諜在安保人員抵達前默默收拾好筆記型電腦，主動夾著尾巴溜出了大門。

segments.en: Hugh served as Sonny's calm and analytical race engineer, whispering crucial tactical updates and delta lap times into the driver's headset.
segments.zh: 休擔任桑尼沉著冷靜的比賽工程師，透過通話耳機將關鍵的戰術走線指示與即時速差單圈數據持續灌輸給車手。

segments.en: A furious radio argument erupted when Joshua repeatedly overrode his race engineer's explicit commands to box for fresh intermediate tires.
segments.zh: 當約書亞再三抗命、公然無視比賽工程師要求他立即進站換上半雨胎的明確指令時，無線電通話中爆發了極其激烈的爭吵。

segments.en: Strapping himself into the brutal carbon cockpit after thirty years was Sonny’s ultimate self-test to prove he was still an elite racing driver.
segments.zh: 在時隔三十年後重新將自己綁進冰冷暴烈的碳纖維座艙，是桑尼向自己發起的終極自我考驗，旨在證明自己依然是頂尖的菁英車手。

segments.en: Navigating through pouring rain on slicks without crashing served as a terrifying self-test of Joshua’s evolving maturity and car control.
segments.zh: 在傾盆大雨中頂著乾地光頭胎保持不撞車飛馳，成為了對約書亞日益成熟的心理素質與控車極限的一場驚魂自我測試。

segments.en: Joshua's manager dragged him to another lavish VIP party, reminding him that keeping the title sponsor happy was what funded his multimillion-dollar engine.
segments.zh: 經紀人強行把約書亞拽到了另一場奢華的貴賓派對上，告誡他只有哄好冠名贊助商，才能為他那台價值數百萬的引擎持續買單。

segments.en: Fearing negative brand association following the violent track collision, their primary European sponsor threatened to void their contract early.
segments.zh: 因極度擔憂嚴重的撞車事故會給品牌形象帶來負面打擊，他們的主要歐洲贊助商威脅要提前終止合約。

segments.en: Remembering his late father's enduring advice, Joshua blocked out the deafening paddock noise, put his head down, and focused purely on hitting every apex.
segments.zh: 牢記已故父親言猶在耳的叮嚀，約書亞徹底屏蔽了圍場內震耳欲聾的喧囂雜音，低下頭全神貫注，將全部心力投注在精準切中每一個彎心。

segments.en: "Stop worrying about the championship standings—just put your head down and drive this machine to the limit," Sonny radioed his teammate.
segments.zh: 「少在那為車手積分榜胡思亂想——給我低下頭全神貫注，把這台機器給我推到極限，」桑尼在無線電中對隊友喊話。

segments.en: Decades ago, the international press had hailed Sonny Hayes as a reckless phenomenon whose raw speed was matched only by his complete disregard for danger.
segments.zh: 數十年前，國際媒體曾將桑尼·海耶斯奉為一名魯莽的曠世奇才，他與生俱來的絕對速度，唯有其視危險如無物的狂妄能與之匹敵。

segments.en: The team feared that Joshua was walking the same perilous tightrope, evolving from a disciplined prodigy into an uncontrollable reckless phenomenon.
segments.zh: 車隊深恐約書亞正在重蹈同一條危險的鋼絲之路，正從一名紀律嚴明的賽車神童退化為一個無法掌控的魯莽奇才。

segments.en: A horrific fiery collision at the Spanish Grand Prix brought Sonny's golden trajectory toward the world championship to an abrupt and agonizing halt.
segments.zh: 西班牙大獎賽上一場慘絕人寰的烈火相撞慘劇，讓桑尼邁向世界總冠軍的黃金征程驟然中斷、戛然而止。

segments.en: The sudden failure of their shared hybrid power unit brought their simulated qualifying battle to an abrupt halt, stranding both drivers in the pit box.
segments.zh: 共用混合動力單元突如其來的爆裂癱瘓，讓兩位車手的模擬排位決鬥戛然而止，將兩台賽車雙雙困死在維修槽內。

segments.en: Paddock journalists unanimously mocked the desperate driver signing, labeling Sonny's shocking recruitment as the definitive laughingstock of the racing season.
segments.zh: 圍場記者們異口同聲地嘲諷這起病急亂投醫的車手簽約引進，將桑尼令人跌破眼鏡的加盟定性為本賽季最荒唐的大笑話。

segments.en: Announcing the long-term driver signing of Joshua Pearce solidified Apex GP's commercial future, ensuring continuity for their engineering projects.
segments.zh: 正式宣布與約書亞·皮爾斯簽訂長期車手引進合約，穩固了彎心車隊的商業未來，為他們的工程研發計畫提供了延續性保障。

segments.en: Standing solemnly along the grid two minutes before the national anthem, Sonny closed his eyes and inhaled the intoxicating scent of burning racing fuel.
segments.zh: 在國歌儀式奏響前兩分鐘肅穆地佇立在發車格上，桑尼閉上雙眼，深深吸入空氣中那令人無比沉醉的高辛烷值賽車廢氣。

segments.en: Hearing his country's national anthem echo across the Abu Dhabi harbor podium moved the hardened veteran to tears after thirty years of hardship.
segments.zh: 聽著祖國的國歌迴盪在阿布達比港灣頒獎台上，這位飽經三十載苦難滄桑的硬漢老將終於忍不住熱淚盈眶。

items.pattern: Standing solemnly along the grid two minutes before [SWAP].

items.baseZh: 在國歌儀式奏響前兩分鐘肅穆地佇立在發車格上，桑尼閉上雙眼，深深吸入空氣中那令人無比沉醉的高辛烷值賽車廢氣。

articles.titleZh: 第 27 課 · eyes and ears–pull back entry
articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 261–270：eyes and ears、clean finish、fire crew、elderly、hard ears、sign of weakness、sign of strength、drag reduction、hold off、pull back entry。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Peter Banning acted as the board's trusted eyes and ears inside the garage, secretly taking notes on technical deficiencies to justify a corporate takeover.
segments.zh: 彼得·班寧在維修車庫內充當董事會安插的親信眼線與耳目，暗中記錄各項技術短板，以此作為發動企業惡意收購的藉口。

segments.en: Molly served as Sonny's loyal eyes and ears along the pit lane, gathering vital intelligence regarding rival tire strategy and fuel loads.
segments.zh: 莫莉在整個維修通道充當桑尼最忠實的眼線與耳目，四處刺探蒐集競爭對手輪胎策略與載油量的關鍵情報。

segments.en: Surviving the treacherous monsoon rain to deliver a clean finish was the non-negotiable directive issued by the team principal to both drivers.
segments.zh: 在險象環生的狂暴季風大雨中倖存下來並交出一份無碰撞的乾淨完賽答卷，是車隊領隊向兩位車手下達的不容任何談判的死命令。

segments.en: A clean finish inside the top six secured the vital constructors' championship payout needed to keep the factory doors open through winter.
segments.zh: 乾淨俐落地跑進前六名完賽，鎖定了車隊急需的年度車隊錦標賽分紅，確保工廠大門在整個嚴冬不至於關門倒閉。

segments.en: Joshua boasted to the press that Apex GP possessed a fire crew of hungry young engineers capable of out-designing any legacy team on the grid.
segments.zh: 約書亞在媒體面前誇下海口，誇耀彎心車隊擁有一支戰鬥力爆表、飢渴進取的頂尖工程團隊，完全有能力在設計上挑落任何圍場老牌傳統強隊。

segments.en: When the chassis caught fire following fuel spillages, the circuit fire crew reacted in seconds, extinguishing flames before the carbon monocoque melted.
segments.zh: 當燃油洩漏引發底盤起火時，賽道消防救援小組在幾秒鐘內火速出擊，在碳纖維單體座艙融化前徹底撲滅了火勢。

segments.en: Joshua fired a cheeky jab during the press conference, joking that it was wonderful that Apex GP was giving second chances to the elderly.
segments.zh: 約書亞在新聞發布會上開了一記嘴賤的玩笑，調侃說彎心車隊能為年長者（elderly）提供改過自新、發揮餘熱的二次就業機會真是太有愛心了。

segments.en: Dismissed by arrogant younger competitors as an elderly has-been, Sonny used sixty years of raw cunning to teach them a brutal masterclass on track limits.
segments.zh: 被狂妄自大的年輕對手蔑視為行將就木的老年廢柴，桑尼用他一甲子沉澱的狠辣狡黠，在賽道極限邊緣給所有人好好上了一堂殘酷的大師課。

segments.en: Bernadette slapped Joshua upside the head, scolding him for having hard ears whenever senior mentors tried to teach him patience and humility.
segments.zh: 伯納黛特狠狠給了約書亞後腦勺一巴掌，痛罵他每次在資深前輩試圖教導他耐心與謙卑時，總是死腦筋一根筋聽不進半句勸（hard ears）。

segments.en: "Don't let your hard ears ruin this race seat—listen to the telemetry and ease off your front tires," his mother pleaded before the start.
segments.zh: 「少在那冥頑不靈聽不進勸毀了自己的正式席位——給我好好看數據，保護好你的前輪，」起跑前他的母親苦苦告誡道。

segments.en: Young Joshua stubbornly argued that apologizing to an aging teammate was an unacceptable sign of weakness that compromised his alpha status.
segments.zh: 年輕氣盛的約書亞頑固地爭辯道，向一位過氣老將隊友低頭道歉是不可接受的軟弱表現，會徹底動搖自己身為頭號車手的霸氣地位。

segments.en: Sonny countered that true strength lies in owning your mistakes, teaching the rookie that maturity is never a sign of weakness in professional racing.
segments.zh: 桑尼反脣相譏道，真正的強大在於敢於正視並承擔自己的錯誤，告誡這名新秀在職業賽車中成熟自省絕非軟弱的表現。

segments.en: Bernadette firmly lectured her son that swallowing your childish pride to apologize to the crew is the ultimate sign of strength.
segments.zh: 伯納黛特嚴肅教導兒子，能夠嚥下幼稚的虛榮自尊主動向全體後勤團隊低頭道歉，才是一個人真正堅強成熟的最高體現。

segments.en: Admitting to the engineering crew that the chassis balance was beyond his physical limit was seen as a rare sign of strength from the veteran driver.
segments.zh: 坦然向工程團隊承認這套底盤平衡已經逼近自身肉體承受極限，被視為這位老將車手極為罕見、極具勇氣的堅強表現。

segments.en: Kate’s radical aerodynamic floor tunnels provided enormous drag reduction down the straightaway without forfeiting downforce in the sweeping bends.
segments.zh: 凱特大刀闊斧設計的革命性底板導流通道，在直道上實現了驚人的減少風阻效果，同時在高速大彎中絲毫沒有犧牲任何下壓力。

segments.en: Effective drag reduction allowed Sonny to reach two hundred and twenty miles per hour, giving him the straight-line velocity needed to battle Ferrari.
segments.zh: 高效的減少風阻工程讓桑尼得以狂飆至時速兩百二十英里，為他提供了與法拉利正面硬撼所需的高速直線尾速。

segments.en: Nursing blistered rear tires on the dying laps, Sonny fought like a lion to hold off Perez’s charging Red Bull through the final complex.
segments.zh: 在最後幾圈護著滿是起泡磨損的後輪，桑尼宛如一頭浴血雄獅般死守，在最後的複合彎道死死防守阻擋住佩雷茲狂飆的紅牛。

segments.en: Joshua deployed every kilowatt of stored hybrid battery to hold off Lewis Hamilton down the Yas Marina straight.
segments.zh: 約書亞釋放了儲存的每一千瓦混合動力電能，在亞斯碼頭賽道長直道上力挽狂瀾，阻擋防守住劉易斯·漢密爾頓的絕地進攻。

segments.en: Hugh analyzed the telemetry traces and urged Sonny to pull back his entry, sacrificing minimum corner speed to achieve a devastating straight-line exit.
segments.zh: 休仔細剖析了遙測軌跡，力勸桑尼延遲切入入彎點（pull back entry），適當犧牲彎中最低速度以換取更為狂暴的直線出彎速度。

segments.en: By pulling back his entry into the tight hairpin, Joshua found clean traction early and out-accelerated the defending Mercedes down the straight.
segments.zh: 透過在狹窄的髮卡彎延遲切入入彎點，約書亞提早獲得了純淨的抓地牽引力，在隨後的長直道上以加速優勢強吃防守的奔馳。
