items.baseZh: 休仔細剖析了遙測軌跡，力勸桑尼延遲切入入彎點（pull back entry），適當犧牲彎中最低速度以換取更為狂暴的直線出彎速度。

articles.titleZh: 第 28 課 · soft tires–blunt trauma
articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 271–280：soft tires、hard tires、go backwards、jammed、eat dirt、clean start、qualifying mode、run down、vision loss、blunt trauma。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Demanding a switch to red-walled soft tires against the pit wall’s advice, Sonny proved that immediate explosive grip mattered far more than long-term durability.
segments.zh: 力排眾議無視指揮台的勸阻執意要求換上紅色胎壁的軟胎，桑尼用行動證明了瞬間爆發的抓地力遠比長期耐久性重要得多。

segments.en: Soft tires provided Joshua with a massive one-lap pace advantage during the final three-lap shootout, allowing him to dive down the inside for the lead.
segments.zh: 在最後三圈的生死決戰衝刺中，軟胎為約書亞提供了壓倒性的單圈速度優勢，讓他得以直接俯衝強插內線奪取全場領先。

segments.en: Starting on durable white-striped hard tires required extreme patience, as the driver spent five laps skating dangerously across cold, low-grip asphalt.
segments.zh: 選用耐磨的白色胎壁硬胎起跑需要極限的耐心，因為車手在最初五圈裡宛如踩著溜冰鞋，在冰冷低抓地力的柏油路面上危險滑行。

segments.en: The strategists made a catastrophic blunder by forcing Joshua onto hard tires in damp conditions, turning his chassis into an uncontrollable toboggan.
segments.zh: 戰術師們犯下了一個毀滅性的大錯，竟在潮濕的路面上強迫約書亞換上硬胎，將他的賽車瞬間變成了一架失控的大雪橇。

segments.en: "Get me off these cooked tires immediately—I’m losing two seconds a lap and going backwards through the field," Joshua screamed over the radio.
segments.zh: 「馬上讓我進站換掉這幾顆磨爛烤焦的破輪胎——我每圈落後整整兩秒，在車陣裡名次正瘋狂倒退被一路超車！」約書亞在無線電中崩潰尖叫。

segments.en: Making the premature switch to dry compound tires while rain pelted sector three caused the entire midfield pack to go backwards rapidly.
segments.zh: 在第三計時段暴雨傾盆時過早換上乾胎，導致整批中游車隊的賽車速度暴跌，名次在場上迅速狂掉倒退。

segments.en: Panic erupted along the pit wall when the front left air-gun jammed during Sonny’s stop, stranding the car in the box for an agonizing seven seconds.
segments.zh: 當桑尼進站換胎時左前輪氣動扳手意外卡住，指揮台瞬間陷入極度恐慌，將賽車足足卡死在維修槽中長達令人窒息的七秒之久。

segments.en: A jammed wastegate valve choked the turbocharger's boost pressure, robbing the engine of fifty horsepower down the main straight.
segments.zh: 一個卡死的排氣洩壓閥卡住了渦輪增壓器的增壓壓力，在主直道上無情剝奪了引擎整整五十匹馬力的輸出。

segments.en: Refusing to yield the racing line through the gravel traps, Sonny forced his aggressive rival wide and made him eat dirt on the exit kerb.
segments.zh: 在碎石緩衝區旁死活不讓行車線，桑尼強勢將激進的對手逼出邊界，讓他在出彎路肩上狼狽地衝出賽道啃碎石。

segments.en: Making an over-ambitious divebomb into turn one locked both front tires, sending the rookie car straight into the runoff area to eat dirt.
segments.zh: 在一號彎發動了一次野心過大、不切實際的自殺式俯衝導致雙前輪死死抱死，直接將新秀賽車送進了緩衝區大啃碎石。

segments.en: Navigating through the treacherous opening chicane without carbon contact gave Sonny the clean start he desperately needed to execute his alternate strategy.
segments.zh: 在毫無碳纖維刮蹭碰撞的情況下安然穿過險象環生的開局連續減速急彎，為桑尼提供了執行替代戰術所迫切需要的乾淨起步。

segments.en: "Forget about fighting the Ferraris into turn one—just deliver a clean start and keep the chassis in one piece," Ruben begged over the comms.
segments.zh: 「別在一號彎跟法拉利死磕——給我做一個無碰撞的乾淨起步，確保底盤完整無缺就行，」魯本在通話中苦苦哀求。

segments.en: In a fit of reckless fury, Sonny bypassed team orders and flipped the engine dial into full qualifying mode, draining the hybrid battery within three laps.
segments.zh: 在狂怒失控的暴衝之下，桑尼公然無視車隊指令，將引擎旋鈕強行切入全功率排位賽模式，在短短三圈內便將混合動力電池徹底榨乾。

segments.en: Unleashing the power unit's extreme qualifying mode along the back straight provided the split-second burst of acceleration required to claim pole position.
segments.zh: 在後直道上全面解鎖動力單元極限的排位賽模式，提供了搶下杆位所必需的稍縱即逝的瞬間狂暴加速度。

segments.en: The race engineer frantically warned Sonny that driving aggressively in hot air would run down his electrical reserves before the final overtaking straight.
segments.zh: 比賽工程師心急如焚地警告桑尼，在滾燙的亂流中激進狂飆會在抵達最後的超車直道之前，便提前耗盡全部的儲備電能。

segments.en: Pitting for fresh soft compound tires allowed Sonny to relentlessly run down the leading Ferrari, erasing a ten-second deficit in five laps.
segments.zh: 進站換上一套全新軟胎膠料，讓桑尼得以勢如破竹地瘋狂追趕上領跑的法拉利，在短短五圈內便抹平了整整十秒的巨大差距。

segments.en: The confidential medical dossier warned that further blunt-force trauma to Sonny's compressed cervical spine could trigger instantaneous, irreversible vision loss.
segments.zh: 這份高度機密的醫療檔案嚴正警告，若桑尼受壓迫的頸椎再遭遇一次鈍性外力衝擊，極有可能引發瞬間且不可逆的雙眼失明。

segments.en: Intense cockpit heat and extreme dehydrating physical exertion caused momentary vision loss across Joshua’s eyes as he crossed the finish line.
segments.zh: 駕駛艙內高達五十度的窒息高溫與極度脫水的肉體透支，讓約書亞在衝過終點線的瞬間眼前陷入了短暫的黑視失明。

segments.en: The emergency medical team evaluated Sonny for internal blunt trauma after his car absorbed a bone-shattering forty-G deceleration into the steel wall.
segments.zh: 在賽車以撕裂人體骨骼的四十 G 減速度轟然撞上鋼製防護牆後，緊急醫療救援小組第一時間對桑尼進行了內部鈍性撞擊傷的深度排查。

segments.en: Decades of surviving violent motorsport impacts left the veteran racer's skeletal frame permanently scarred by cumulative blunt trauma.
segments.zh: 數十年在狂暴賽車事故中死裡逃生的慘烈經歷，給這位老將的骨骼架構留下了累積性鈍性挫傷帶來的永久殘疾與傷痕。

articles.titleZh: 第 29 課 · lock down–season finale
articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 281–290：lock down、forged、demographic appeal、cut the seals、Paddock Club、premium economy、waive liability、corporate espionage、full-throttle blast、season finale。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Peter Banning demanded that Sonny sign the buyout agreement immediately following the podium ceremony to lock down the takeover deal by Sunday night.
segments.zh: 彼得·班寧強烈要求桑尼在頒獎儀式結束後立即簽署收購協議，以便在週日深夜前徹底敲定鎖死這筆車隊收購交易。

segments.en: Securing their maiden Grand Prix victory allowed Ruben to lock down a lucrative five-year title sponsorship deal with an American tech giant.
segments.zh: 強勢斬獲隊史大獎賽處子勝，讓魯本得以與一家美國科技巨頭徹底敲定鎖死了一份價值連城的五年一級冠名贊助大單。

segments.en: Kate uncovered irrefutable evidence proving that the technical non-compliance allegations were based entirely on forged supply chain documents.
segments.zh: 凱特挖出了無可辯駁的鐵證，證明那些指控車隊技術違規的檢舉信，完全是建立在一批偽造篡改的假冒供應鏈文件之上。

segments.en: Disqualifying the competitor was the FIA's immediate verdict after technical stewards confirmed that their aerodynamic floor had been stamped with a forged homologation serial.
segments.zh: 在技術幹事證實對手的空力底板上打印了偽造的認證序列號後，國際汽聯當場作出了立即取消該參賽者成績的終審判決。

segments.en: Commercial managers explained to Joshua that his massive social media following provided the demographic appeal required to secure global lifestyle brands.
segments.zh: 商業經理向約書亞解釋，他在社交媒體上的天量粉絲群體所帶來的年輕受眾族群吸引力，正是拿下全球頂級潮牌贊助的致勝法寶。

segments.en: Pairing an irreverent aging rebel with a young social media star gave Apex GP an unprecedented demographic appeal spanning generations.
segments.zh: 將一名玩世不恭的遲暮叛逆老將與一名年輕的社群明星車手組合搭檔，給予了彎心車隊橫跨數個世代、前所未有的全方位族群吸引力。

segments.en: The mechanics waited anxiously outside the parc fermé gates for the official FIA technical delegate to arrive and cut the seals on their impounded race cars.
segments.zh: 技師們焦急萬分地佇立在封閉監管區大門外，苦候國際汽聯官方技術代表親臨現場，剪開扣押賽車上的監管封條。

segments.en: The instant technical scrutineers cut the seals on the engine cover, the mechanics rushed in to install Kate's revised combat floor before pit exit opened.
segments.zh: 技術車檢員剛剪開引擎蓋上封條的瞬間，技師們便一擁而上，爭分奪秒在維修區出口開放前將凱特修改後的戰鬥底板搶裝上車。

segments.en: While mechanics sweated inside the sweltering garage, ultra-wealthy investors sipped vintage champagne in the air-conditioned luxury of the Paddock Club.
segments.zh: 當技師們在酷熱難耐的車庫裡汗流浹背苦戰時，腰纏萬貫的富豪投資人們正坐在空調奢華的闈場俱樂部（Paddock Club）裡愜意地啜飲年份香檳。

segments.en: Sonny walked right past the glamorous Paddock Club invitations, preferring to eat a greasy street taco sitting on a stack of used slick tires.
segments.zh: 桑尼對金碧輝煌的闈場俱樂部貴賓邀請函不屑一顧，寧可一屁股坐在廢舊光頭胎堆上啃著油膩的街頭玉米捲。

segments.en: Arriving unannounced at the Abu Dhabi paddock, Sonny smirked that he had financed his own last-minute rescue mission by flying premium economy.
segments.zh: 無預警現身阿布達比圍場，桑尼冷笑著調侃自己是自掏腰包買了張豪華經濟艙機票，千里迢迢前來展開這場壓軸營救行動的。

segments.en: Ruben joked that despite managing a multi-million-dollar Formula 1 operation, their microscopic budget forced the senior engineers into premium economy seats.
segments.zh: 魯本自嘲道，儘管掌管著一項耗資數千萬的 F1 頂級車隊，他們微薄的預算卻迫使資深工程師只能擠在高級經濟艙出差。

segments.en: Sonny signed an ironclad legal instrument prepared by a Mexican attorney to completely waive liability for Ruben should he perish behind the wheel.
segments.zh: 桑尼毅然簽署了一份由墨西哥律師起草的無懈可擊法律文書，聲明若自己猝死在方向盤後，將徹底免除魯本的一切法律與賠償責任。

segments.en: The circuit owners refused to open the track for wet testing until every competing driver agreed to sign an emergency document to waive liability.
segments.zh: 賽道所有方拒絕在雨天開放賽道進行濕地測試，除非每位參賽車手都同意簽署一份免除賠償責任的緊急文件。

segments.en: Discovering stolen composite manufacturing schematics inside Peter Banning’s briefcase confirmed that the team was being dismantled by insidious corporate espionage.
segments.zh: 在彼得·班寧的公事包裡截獲失竊的複合材料製造圖紙，確鑿證實了這支車隊正被一場陰險的商業間諜刺探行動暗中肢解。

segments.en: Kate locked down the aerodynamic design servers with biometric security to protect their revolutionary floor geometry from high-stakes corporate espionage.
segments.zh: 凱特利用生物識別安全系統鎖死了空力設計伺服器，嚴密保護他們革命性的底板幾何結構免遭高風險商業間諜的竊取。

segments.en: Exiting the final turn with tires spinning wildly, Sonny launched the machine into a full-throttle blast along the illuminated Yas Marina waterfront straight.
segments.zh: 伴隨著後輪瘋狂打滑衝出最後一個彎道，桑尼駕車將油門踩到底，沿著燈火輝煌的亞斯碼頭濱水長直道展開了全油門極速狂飆。

segments.en: Surviving the full-throttle blast through the high-speed sweepers required iron neck muscles capable of resisting sustained four-G lateral forces.
segments.zh: 在承受持續四 G 橫向重力的情況下在全油門極速狂飆中挺過高速大弧彎，需要具備鋼鐵般堅硬的頸部肌肉。

segments.en: All the year's simmering personal resentments, corporate betrayals, and technical gambles converged under the floodlights of the Abu Dhabi season finale.
segments.zh: 這一年所有暗流湧動的個人恩怨、企業背叛與技術豪賭，在阿布達比這座泛光燈照耀的賽季閉幕收官之戰中迎來了總爆發。

segments.en: Pulling off an impossible maiden victory in the dramatic season finale secured Apex GP's entry on the grid for the upcoming championship year.
segments.zh: 在極具戲劇性的賽季收官戰中奇蹟般斬獲隊史首勝，為彎心車隊徹底鎖定了出戰下賽季世界錦標賽的寶貴發車格席位。

articles.titleZh: 第 30 課 · clean sweep–take a gamble
articles.summaryZh: 詞彙 291–300：clean sweep、elbows out、fresh rubber、decoy maneuver、pit wall、race for the ages、slay dragons、racing gods、tight margin、take a gamble。每詞兩句電影場景例句，可 TTS 跟讀與標熟練度。

segments.en: Marshals executed a rapid clean sweep across sector two, clearing sharp carbon fragments and gravel to prevent a safety car restart delay.
segments.zh: 賽道工作人員在第二計時段展開了雷厲風行的全面清掃，徹底排除了鋒利的碳纖維碎片與碎石，以防安全車重啟被延誤。

segments.en: Apex GP pulled off a clean sweep of the final sprint laps, posting purple sector times and executing two breathtaking overtakes for the lead.
segments.zh: 彎心車隊在最後的衝刺圈中上演了一場無懈可擊的全面橫掃，包攬全部紫色最快計時段並完成了兩次令人屏息的致命超車奪得領先。

segments.en: Radioing the cockpit before the restart, Sonny told Joshua that it was time to race with elbows out and show their rivals zero mercy.
segments.zh: 在安全車重啟前向駕駛座艙通話，桑尼告誡約書亞是時候張開手肘頑強卡位、硬碰硬強勢超車了，對對手絕不能有一絲一毫的憐憫。

segments.en: Driving with elbows out through the crowded midfield, the rookie bumped side pods aggressively to carve his way toward the podium.
segments.zh: 以硬碰硬頑強卡位的悍勇姿態殺穿擁擠的中游車陣，這名新秀激烈推擠側箱，硬生生為自己殺出一條通往頒獎台的血路。

segments.en: Utilizing the sudden red-flag stoppage, the mechanics bolted a set of untouched fresh rubber onto Sonny's chassis for the final three-lap shootout.
segments.zh: 利用突如其來的紅旗暫停良機，技師們以迅雷不及掩耳之勢為桑尼的底盤換上了一套未經磨損的嶄新軟胎，全力備戰最後三圈的生死決戰。

segments.en: The staggering mechanical grip of fresh rubber allowed the driver to brake ten meters later into turn one than rivals on scrubbed tires.
segments.zh: 嶄新輪胎帶來的極致機械抓地力，讓車手在一號彎得以便捷地比那些使用磨損舊胎的對手延遲整整十米實施極限煞車。

segments.en: Sonny executed a daring decoy maneuver down the outside line, forcing Hamilton to cover his flank while Joshua slipped through the vacant inside lane.
segments.zh: 桑尼從外線發動了一次大膽絕倫的佯攻誘敵戰術，迫使漢密爾頓分心封堵側翼，從而掩護約書亞從空無一車的內線如幽靈般穿刺超車。

segments.en: Rival strategists fell hook, line, and sinker for the pit wall's clever decoy maneuver, bringing their lead driver in too early for a second stop.
segments.zh: 對手戰術團隊徹底被指揮台巧妙的佯攻誘敵戰術所矇騙，中了圈套過早將領跑車手召回進行第二次進站。

segments.en: Pandemonium erupted across the pit wall as telemetry engineers slammed down their headsets and embraced, celebrating their first Grand Prix victory.
segments.zh: 當遙測工程師猛地摔下耳機相擁狂呼時，整座維修區指揮台陷入了瘋狂，全體同仁失控慶祝這座隊史首座大獎賽冠軍獎盃。

segments.en: The team principal watched the monitors from the pit wall with white knuckles, calculating fuel deltas and gap times as the final lap commenced.
segments.zh: 車隊領隊雙手緊抓著維修區指揮台的監控螢幕、指關節因過度用力而發白，在最後一圈開跑之際瘋狂計算著剩餘油量速差與領先秒差。

segments.en: The trackside commentator's voice cracked with emotion as he declared the Abu Dhabi showdown an unforgettable race for the ages.
segments.zh: 現場解說員的嗓音因激動而哽咽沙啞，對著麥克風振臂高呼，宣告這場阿布達比大對決是一場必將載入史冊的跨時代傳奇名局。

segments.en: Overcoming bankruptcy, sabotage, and broken vertebrae to win on the final lap transformed their campaign into a cinematic race for the ages.
segments.zh: 克服破產危機、內部背叛破壞與脊椎骨折重創，在最後一圈強勢奪冠，將他們的奮戰史詩定格為一場載入史冊的傳奇絕唱。

segments.en: Turning down the corporate after-party, Sonny packed his road gear, casually mentioning to Joshua that he still had a couple more dragons to slay.
segments.zh: 謝絕了企業慶功狂歡晚宴，桑尼收拾好越野行裝，輕描淡寫地對約書亞說，自己在未來的路上還有好幾條人生的心魔巨龍等著他去斬殺克敵。

segments.en: To survive as an underdog in Formula 1, every team member must learn to conquer self-doubt and slay the dragons of entrenched factory privilege.
segments.zh: 若想以黑馬之姿在殘酷的 F1 圍場生存，每位成員都必須學會戰勝自我懷疑，在賽道上正面屠滅那些老牌廠隊特權的龐然惡龍。

segments.en: "It's out of our engineering hands now—we have to leave our championship fate to the racing gods," Ruben whispered as the red flags fluttered.
segments.zh: 「這一切在工程層面上已經不是我們所能左右的了——我們只能將錦標賽的命運全權託付給掌控賽車的神祇了，」魯本在紅旗飄揚中喃喃低語。

segments.en: When a sudden mechanical failure struck the leader on the ultimate lap, the garage knew the fickle racing gods had finally smiled upon them.
segments.zh: 當領跑車手在最後一圈遭遇突如其來的機械爆缸時，車庫內的全體人員深知，變幻莫測的賽車之神終於對他們露出了眷顧的微笑。

segments.en: Sonny threaded his machine through the closing gap with a tight margin of mere millimeters between his carbon side pod and the concrete wall.
segments.zh: 桑尼駕車強行穿過那道正不斷收窄的縫隙，碳纖維側箱與冰冷混凝土牆之間僅僅維持著幾毫米的毫釐之差。

segments.en: Operating within the tight margin of legal fuel-flow regulations was the only way their underpowered engine could challenge the Mercedes down the straight.
segments.zh: 緊貼著法定噴油量法規極限的微小毫釐區間走鋼絲，是他們動力偏弱的引擎在直道上能與奔馳一決雌雄的唯一手段。

segments.en: With nothing left to lose and bankruptcy looming on Monday, the pit wall decided to take a gamble and fit slick tires on a soaking wet track.
segments.zh: 深知已退無可退、週一便將面臨破產清算，指揮台毅然決定鋌而走險放手一搏，在暴雨濕滑的賽道上強行換上乾地光頭胎。

segments.en: Sonny's career was forged in the fire of taking a gamble whenever conservative competitors hesitated, diving into gaps that barely existed.
segments.zh: 桑尼的整個傳奇生涯，正是在保守對手猶豫不決時毅然決然放手一搏、大膽強插進幾乎不存在的狹窄空隙的烈火中百鍊成鋼的。

articles.summaryZh: 能源展場經理視角：開館動線、導覽協調、團隊分工與下一季規劃。

segments.en: I'm on the floor an hour before doors open.
segments.zh: 開門前一小時我就已在展場。

segments.en: We walk the aisles and check every safety sign.
segments.zh: 我們沿走道巡視，確認每塊安全標示。

segments.en: The main stage lights are still warming up.
segments.zh: 主舞臺燈光還在預熱。

segments.en: I need the badge scanners online before the rush.
segments.zh: 人潮來前我得先把證件掃描器連上線。

segments.en: Our energy demo booth looks ready for photos.
segments.zh: 我們的能源示範攤位看起來可以拍照了。

segments.en: If anything slips, I call ops on the radio.
segments.zh: 若有疏漏，我會用無線電叫營運組。

segments.en: Peak crowd hits around eleven every morning.
segments.zh: 每天上午十一點左右是人潮高峰。

segments.en: We steer school groups through the north hall.
segments.zh: 我們把學校團體導向北館動線。

segments.en: Wide aisles keep people moving, not stuck.
segments.zh: 寬走道讓人流持續移動，不會卡住。

segments.en: I watch the heat map on my tablet.
segments.zh: 我在平板上盯著熱點圖。

segments.en: When a zone gets packed, we open a side route.
segments.zh: 某區太擠時，我們會開側線通道。

segments.en: Smooth flow means fewer complaints at the desk.
segments.zh: 動線順了，服務臺抱怨就少。

segments.en: Our docents run tours every forty minutes.
segments.zh: 我們的導覽志工每四十分鐘一團。

segments.en: I brief them on the new hydrogen display.
segments.zh: 我會向他們簡報新的氫能展示。

segments.en: VIP groups get a shorter, sharper script.
segments.zh: 貴賓團用更精簡有力的講稿。

segments.en: We keep Q and A time at the solar wall.
segments.zh: 問答時間安排在太陽能牆前。

segments.en: If a mic drops out, backup headsets are in row C.
segments.zh: 麥克風掛了，C 排有備用耳麥。

segments.en: Good tours turn walk-ins into repeat visitors.
segments.zh: 好的導覽能把路過的人變成回訪客。

segments.en: Security, AV, and catering share one channel.
segments.zh: 維安、音響與餐飲共用同一頻道。

segments.en: I sync with the city utility partner at noon.
segments.zh: 中午我會跟市府公用事業夥伴對表。

segments.en: Marketing wants more live demos on the floor.
segments.zh: 行銷希望展場多一點現場示範。

segments.en: We trade space so no booth blocks a fire exit.
segments.zh: 我們調整展位，不擋任何消防出口。

segments.en: When tempers flare, I pull people offline to talk.
segments.zh: 有人火氣上來時，我會拉離線私下談。

segments.en: End of day, we debrief what worked and what didn't.
segments.zh: 收館後我們檢討哪些有效、哪些沒有。

segments.group: Part 1 · 下一季與永續方向
segments.en: Next season we're adding a smart-grid pavilion.
segments.zh: 下一季我們要加智慧電網館。

segments.group: Part 1 · 下一季與永續方向
segments.en: We're cutting single-use plastic at food courts.
segments.zh: 我們在美食區減少一次性塑膠。

segments.group: Part 1 · 下一季與永續方向
segments.en: Solar on the roof should offset part of our power.
segments.zh: 屋頂太陽能應能抵消部分用電。

segments.group: Part 1 · 下一季與永續方向
segments.en: I want clearer signs for recycling and compost.
segments.zh: 我想把回收與堆肥標示弄更清楚。

segments.group: Part 1 · 下一季與永續方向
segments.en: Partners ask for data on foot traffic and dwell time.
segments.zh: 夥伴想要人流與停留時間的數據。

segments.group: Part 1 · 下一季與永續方向
segments.en: If we nail this show, the contract renews easier.
segments.zh: 這場辦好了，續約會順很多。

segments.en: Where's the nearest restroom?
segments.zh: 最近的洗手間在哪？

segments.en: Is the guided tour still running?
segments.zh: 導覽團還有嗎？

segments.en: This booth is really crowded.
segments.zh: 這攤位好擠。

segments.en: Do we need tickets for the demo?
segments.zh: 示範要另外買票嗎？

segments.en: The AC feels weak in here.
segments.zh: 這裡冷氣好像不太夠。

segments.en: Which hall has the EV displays?
segments.zh: 電動車展示在哪一館？

segments.en: Sorry, I'm a bit lost.
segments.zh: 抱歉，我有點迷路。

segments.en: Is photography allowed?
segments.zh: 可以拍照嗎？

segments.en: The keynote starts when?
segments.zh: 主題演講幾點開始？

segments.en: Great layout this year.
segments.zh: 今年動線規劃很棒。

segments.en: My badge won't scan.
segments.zh: 我的證件掃不過。

segments.en: Where can I charge my phone?
segments.zh: 哪裡可以幫手機充電？

segments.en:
This hydrogen exhibit blew my mind.
→ Right? We worked hard to make it hands-on and safe for everyone.
segments.zh:
這個氫能展示太震撼了。
→ 對吧？ 我們花很多心力，讓它既互動又對所有人都安全。

segments.en:
The line for coffee is insane.
→ Yeah, peak hour. Try the cart near hall B—it's usually shorter.
segments.zh:
買咖啡的隊伍太誇張了。
→ 是啊，高峰時段。 試試 B 館旁的餐車，隊伍通常比較短。

segments.en:
Your staff was super helpful.
→ Thank you! I'll pass that to the volunteer lead at tonight's briefing.
segments.zh:
你們的工作人員超幫忙。
→ 謝謝！ 今晚簡報我會轉達給志工隊長。

segments.en:
Is the show kid-friendly?
→ Mostly, yes. We have a quiet zone and strollers are fine in the main aisle.
segments.zh:
這展適合帶小孩嗎？
→ 大致上可以。 我們有安靜區，主要走道也推得動嬰兒車。

segments.en:
I didn't expect it to be this big.
→ It sprawls! Grab a map at the desk—we marked the must-see stops.
segments.zh:
沒想到場地這麼大。
→ 是很大！ 在服務臺拿地圖，我們標了必看站點。

segments.en:
The solar wall demo stalled.
→ Oh no. I'll ping AV; they usually reset it in five minutes.
segments.zh:
太陽能牆示範好像停了。
→ 哎呀。 我通知音響組，他們通常五分鐘內會重啟。

segments.en:
Are you the venue manager?
→ That's me. Happy to help—what do you need for your group?
segments.zh:
您是場地經理嗎？
→ 是我。 很樂意幫忙—您的團需要什麼？

segments.en:
Parking was a nightmare.
→ Sorry about that. Shuttle B from the garage runs every ten minutes tomorrow too.
segments.zh:
停車根本是惡夢。
→ 很抱歉。 明天從停車場發的 B 號接駁車也是每十分鐘一班。

segments.en:
Love the focus on clean energy.
→ Me too. That's the theme our partners asked us to push this year.
segments.zh:
很喜歡你們強調乾淨能源。
→ 我也。 這是夥伴今年希望我們主打的主軸。

segments.en:
Can we book a private tour?
→ Sure. Email groups@ the show site with your date and head count.
segments.zh:
可以預約私人導覽嗎？
→ 可以。 寫信到展覽官網的團體信箱，附上日期與人數。

segments.en:
It's loud near the main stage.
→ True. Earplugs are free at the info booth if you need them.
segments.zh:
主舞臺附近好吵。
→ 確實。 若需要，服務臺有免費耳塞。

segments.en:
See you next year's show?
→ Hope so! We're already sketching a bigger smart-grid section.
segments.zh:
明年展還會來嗎？
→ 希望啊！ 我們已在草擬更大的智慧電網區。

lesson.introZh: 四部分：五段心得口說、十二句參訪回應、十二組「附和＋完整補充」。先讀 Part 1 片語，再逐句跟讀；Part 4 再練 15 句抽換模板。

articles.summaryZh: 大聯盟球賽日：進場、加油、局勢討論與賽後閒聊。

segments.en: We got here early to watch batting practice.
segments.zh: 我們提早到，想看打擊練習。

segments.en: Our seats are down the third-base line.
segments.zh: 我們的座位在三壘方向線旁。

segments.en: The sun hits this section until the fifth inning.
segments.zh: 第五局前這區會一直曬到太陽。

segments.en: I grabbed us peanuts and two sodas.
segments.zh: 我買了花生和兩杯汽水。

segments.en: Don't forget to keep your ticket stub handy.
segments.zh: 別忘了把票根留著好出示。

segments.en: The jumbotron just showed tonight's lineup.
segments.zh: 大螢幕剛放出今晚先發名單。

segments.en: First pitch is in ten minutes.
segments.zh: 十分鐘後就要開球。

segments.en: The starter looks sharp in warm-ups.
segments.zh: 先發投手熱身看起來狀態很好。

segments.en: That was a nasty slider for strike three.
segments.zh: 那顆滑球三振太刁鑽了。

segments.en: Runner on second with nobody out—big chance.
segments.zh: 二壘有人、無人出局，機會很大。

segments.en: They're shifting the infield to the pull side.
segments.zh: 他們把內野守備往拉打方向移。

segments.en: Extra innings mean free baseball for us.
segments.zh: 延長賽代表我們多看免費的棒球。

segments.en: Everyone stands for the seventh-inning stretch.
segments.zh: 第七局中場大家會起立伸展。

segments.en: We sing along even if we're off-key.
segments.zh: 我們跟著唱，就算走音也沒關係。

segments.en: The wave went around twice tonight.
segments.zh: 今晚人浪繞了球場兩圈。

segments.en: A foul ball landed two rows behind us.
segments.zh: 界外球落在後面兩排。

segments.en: Kids still chase every t-shirt cannon shot.
segments.zh: 小孩還是會追每一發 T 恤炮。

segments.en: This crowd gets loud when the closer walks in.
segments.zh: 終結者上場時這裡觀眾會很吵。

segments.en: His exit velocity has been up all month.
segments.zh: 他這個月擊球初速一直偏高。

segments.en: They should pinch-hit here against the lefty.
segments.zh: 對左投這裡應該代打。

segments.en: Bullpen is gassed after yesterday's doubleheader.
segments.zh: 牛棚昨天雙header 後很疲勞。

segments.en: That error cost them at least one run.
segments.zh: 那個失誤至少讓對方多一分。

segments.en: I'm fine with a sacrifice fly to tie it.
segments.zh: 用高飛犧牲打追平我可以接受。

segments.en: Stats nerds and old-school fans both yell here.
segments.zh: 數據派跟老派球迷在這都會喊。

segments.en: We lost in the ninth, but what a game.
segments.zh: 九局輸了，但真是好比賽。

segments.en: Traffic out of the lot is always brutal.
segments.zh: 離場車流永遠很慘。

segments.en: Let's meet at the bar across from the stadium.
segments.zh: 我們在球場對街酒吧碰面吧。

segments.en: I'll rewatch the highlight clip on the train.
segments.zh: 搭車時我會重看精彩片段。

segments.en: Next homestand I want better seats behind home.
segments.zh: 下一個主場系列我想換本壘後方座位。

segments.en: Nothing beats a summer night at the ballpark.
segments.zh: 夏天夜晚在球場沒什麼比得上。

segments.en: Who's pitching tonight?
segments.zh: 今晚誰先發？

segments.en: This beer is nine bucks.
segments.zh: 這杯啤酒要九塊。

segments.en: Did he safe or out?
segments.zh: 他安全還是出局？

segments.en: Catch that home run!
segments.zh: 接那發全壘打！

segments.en: I'm freezing in this breeze.
segments.zh: 這風吹得我好冷。

segments.en: Where's our section again?
segments.zh: 我們區域又在哪？

segments.en: Nice jersey.
segments.zh: 球衣不錯。

segments.en: Rain delay?
segments.zh: 要因雨延賽嗎？

segments.en: Let's do the wave.
segments.zh: 來做人浪吧。

segments.en: Scoreboard's wrong.
segments.zh: 計分板錯了。

segments.en: One more inning, okay?
segments.zh: 再看一局，好嗎？

segments.en: Subway's packed after games.
segments.zh: 賽後地鐵超擠。

segments.en:
I've never been to a big-league park.
→ Welcome! Watch the lights dim for the anthem—it's a cool moment.
segments.zh:
我沒來過大聯盟球場。
→ 歡迎！ 唱國歌前燈會暗下來，那刻很值得看。

segments.en:
That call was garbage.
→ Rough. Replay might flip it; the umps are checking now.
segments.zh:
那判決爛透了。
→ 真糟。 重播可能改判，裁判正在看。

segments.en:
Your team is on fire.
→ Fingers crossed. Pitching depth is what I'm worried about in August.
segments.zh:
你們球隊狀態火熱。
→ 希望繼續。 我比較擔心八月牛棚深度夠不夠。

segments.en:
Is that player still hurt?
→ Day to day. He ran sprints yesterday, so maybe back this series.
segments.zh:
那球員還受傷嗎？
→ 逐日觀察。 他昨天有衝刺練習，這系列可能復出。

segments.en:
Hot dogs here beat the ones at home.
→ Stadium magic. It's half nostalgia, half secret onion sauce.
segments.zh:
這熱狗比在家吃的好吃。
→ 球場魔法。 一半懷舊，一半秘密洋蔥醬。

segments.en:
Why did they pull the starter?
→ Pitch count. He hit ninety-five pitches and the hook was quick tonight.
segments.zh:
為什麼換下先發？
→ 球數到了。 他投到九十五球，教練今晚換人很快。

segments.en:
Kids are asleep already.
→ Same here. We can slip out after this inning—no shame.
segments.zh:
小孩都睡著了。
→ 我這也是。 這局結束溜也沒關係。

segments.en:
Got any tips for cheap tickets?
→ Weekday games. Tuesday nights in the upper deck are usually under thirty bucks.
segments.zh:
有買便宜票的技巧嗎？
→ 平日賽。 週二晚上外野上層常不到三十塊。

segments.en:
That foul almost got me.
→ Stay alert! Always watch the batter, even between pitches.
segments.zh:
那顆界外球差點打到我。
→ 小心！ 就算沒投球也要盯打者。

segments.en:
Who's your favorite player?
→ The shortstop. He makes hard plays look easy and never showboats.
segments.zh:
你最喜歡哪個球員？
→ 遊擊手。 難守備他做得輕鬆，從不炫技。

segments.en:
Extra innings again?
→ Free baseball! Last time we left at midnight and still loved it.
segments.zh:
又要延長賽？
→ 免費加局！ 上次半夜才走，我們還是覺得值。

segments.en:
Same time next week?
→ I'm in. I'll grab tickets once the rotation drops.
segments.zh:
下週同一時間？
→ 算我一份。 先發輪值公佈我就去買票。

items.baseZh: 我們提早到，想看打擊練習。

items.pattern: The sun hits this section until [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: The sun hits this section until the fifth inning.
items.baseZh: 第五局前這區會一直曬到太陽。

items.pattern: Don't forget to keep your [SWAP] handy.

items.pattern: First pitch is in [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。

items.pattern: That was a nasty slider for [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: That was a nasty slider for strike three.
items.baseZh: 那顆滑球三振太刁鑽了。

items.pattern: They're shifting the infield to [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: They're shifting the infield to the pull side.
items.baseZh: 他們把內野守備往拉打方向移。

items.pattern: Everyone stands for the [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Everyone stands for the seventh-inning stretch.
items.baseZh: 第七局中場大家會起立伸展。

items.pattern: The wave went around twice [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: The wave went around twice tonight.
items.baseZh: 今晚人浪繞了球場兩圈。

items.pattern: Kids still chase [SWAP] shot.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Kids still chase every t-shirt cannon shot.
items.baseZh: 小孩還是會追每一發 T 恤炮。

items.pattern: His [SWAP] has been up all month.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: His exit velocity has been up all month.
items.baseZh: 他這個月擊球初速一直偏高。

items.pattern: Bullpen is gassed after [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Bullpen is gassed after yesterday's doubleheader.
items.baseZh: 牛棚昨天雙header 後很疲勞。

items.pattern: I'm fine with a [SWAP] to tie it.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: I'm fine with a sacrifice fly to tie it.
items.baseZh: 用高飛犧牲打追平我可以接受。

items.pattern: We lost in the ninth, but [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: We lost in the ninth, but what a game.
items.baseZh: 九局輸了，但真是好比賽。

items.pattern: Let's meet at the bar across from [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Let's meet at the bar across from the stadium.
items.baseZh: 我們在球場對街酒吧碰面吧。

items.pattern: Next [SWAP] I want better seats behind home.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Next homestand I want better seats behind home.
items.baseZh: 下一個主場系列我想換本壘後方座位。

articles.summaryZh: NBA 現場：入場氛圍、比分拉鋸、球星話題與散場後討論。

segments.en: The arena lights drop before player intros.
segments.zh: 球員介紹前球館會關燈。

segments.en: Our row is mid-level behind the bench.
segments.zh: 我們在中層替補席後方那排。

segments.en: I already smell popcorn and floor polish.
segments.zh: 我已聞到爆米花和地板蠟味。

segments.en: Tonight's giveaway is a mini basketball.
segments.zh: 今晚進場禮是小籃球。

segments.en: Tip-off is at seven thirty on the dot.
segments.zh: 跳球準時七點半。

segments.en: The crowd roars when the home team runs out.
segments.zh: 主隊跑出來時全場吼。

segments.en: They push pace in transition every chance.
segments.zh: 他們一有機會就打快攻。

segments.en: That three was deep—logo range.
segments.zh: 那三分好遠—logo 射程。

segments.en: He's in foul trouble with four in the first half.
segments.zh: 他上半場就四犯，麻煩了。

segments.en: Coach calls timeout to stop their run.
segments.zh: 教練叫暫停止住對方攻勢。

segments.en: Second half starts with a tighter defense.
segments.zh: 下半場一開始防守更緊。

segments.en: We're down six but it's still anybody's game.
segments.zh: 落後六分但勝負還難說。

segments.en: Their star draws two defenders and kicks out.
segments.zh: 當家球星吸引雙人再外傳。

segments.en: Pick-and-roll looks rusty tonight.
segments.zh: 擋拆今晚有點生疏。

segments.en: Bench unit gave us a spark in the third.
segments.zh: 板凳在第三節帶起氣勢。

segments.en: He Euro-stepped through contact for the and-one.
segments.zh: 他歐洲步扛身體還打成加罰。

segments.en: Zone defense messed up their spacing.
segments.zh: 區域防守打亂他們空間。

segments.en: Clutch time means no easy shots.
segments.zh: 關鍵時刻沒有輕鬆球。

segments.en: The dance cam always picks the funniest dad.
segments.zh: 舞蹈鏡頭總挑最搞笑的爸爸。

segments.en: T-shirt toss never reaches our section.
segments.zh: 扔 T 恤永遠扔不到我們這區。

segments.en: Kiss cam makes strangers blush every time.
segments.zh: 親吻鏡頭每次都讓陌生人臉紅。

segments.en: Halftime show is a local kids' dance crew.
segments.zh: 中場是本地小孩舞團。

segments.en: DJ drops the beat when we get a stop.
segments.zh: 我們防下時 DJ 會砸重拍。

segments.en: Arena Wi-Fi dies when forty thousand phones upload.
segments.zh: 四萬支手機上傳時 Wi-Fi 就掛。

segments.en: Buzzer-beater—are you kidding me?
segments.zh: 絕殺—開什麼玩笑？

segments.en: Fans stay to cheer even after a loss.
segments.zh: 輸了球迷還是會留下來歡呼。

segments.en: I'll argue about that last foul call all night.
segments.zh: 最後那犯規我能吵一整晚。

segments.en: We grab late-night tacos on the way home.
segments.zh: 回家路上我們會買宵夜塔可。

segments.en: Trade rumors always spike after tough losses.
segments.zh: 慘輸後交易流言就會爆。

segments.en: Same seats next month—deal?
segments.zh: 下月同座位—說定了？

segments.en: Which team you rooting for?
segments.zh: 你支持哪一隊？

segments.en: Refs are blind tonight.
segments.zh: 裁判今晚瞎了。

segments.en: Need more beer.
segments.zh: 還要啤酒。

segments.en: That's a travel.
segments.zh: 那是走步。

segments.en: MVP chants start now.
segments.zh: MVP 喊聲現在開始。

segments.en: My phone's at five percent.
segments.zh: 我手機剩五趴電。

segments.en: Defense!
segments.zh: 防守！

segments.en: He can't shoot threes.
segments.zh: 他三分不行。

segments.en: Line for merch is long.
segments.zh: 周邊隊伍好長。

segments.en: Great seats, by the way.
segments.zh: 話說座位真不錯。

segments.en: Overtime?
segments.zh: 要打延長嗎？

segments.en: Subway or rideshare?
segments.zh: 地鐵還是叫車？

segments.en:
First NBA game for me.
→ Nice! Wait till the fourth—energy doubles when it's close.
segments.zh:
我第一次看 NBA。
→ 太好了！ 等到第四節—比分緊時氣氛會加倍。

segments.en:
That dunk shook the floor.
→ Insane. He's been doing that since college—same explosiveness.
segments.zh:
那記灌籃地板都在震。
→ 太瘋。 他大學就這樣—爆發力沒變。

segments.en:
Why's the star on the bench?
→ Rest night. Back-to-back games—they load-manage him sometimes.
segments.zh:
明星怎麼坐板凳？
→ 輪休。 背靠背—他們有時會控他的上場時間。

segments.en:
Crowd's louder than TV.
→ Way louder. TV mics can't capture when the whole place chants defense.
segments.zh:
現場比電視吵多了。
→ 吵多了。 電視收不到全場齊喊防守那種音量。

segments.en:
We should leave early.
→ Maybe. If we bolt now we miss crunch time—your call.
segments.zh:
我們該早點走。
→ 也許。 現在走會錯過決勝期—你決定。

segments.en:
Got floor seats once?
→ Once. You hear sneakers squeak—you smell sweat. Wild.
segments.zh:
有過場邊席嗎？
→ 有過一次。 聽得到球鞋摩擦—聞得到汗味，超狂。

segments.en:
They're choking again.
→ Classic. Our bench has to hit open threes or it's over.
segments.zh:
他們又在崩盤。
→ 經典戲碼。 板凳得投進空位三分不然就完了。

segments.en:
Love your jersey.
→ Thanks! City edition—limited run, got lucky online.
segments.zh:
喜歡你的球衣。
→ 謝謝！ 城市版—限量，網上運氣好搶到。

segments.en:
Is the food worth it?
→ Eh. Eat before you come; arena prices are rough.
segments.zh:
吃的值得嗎？
→ 還好。 先在外面吃；球館價很兇。

segments.en:
Who wins tonight?
→ Toss-up. Whoever hits free throws in the last two minutes.
segments.zh:
今晚誰贏？
→ 五五波。 看最後兩分鐘誰罰球準。

segments.en:
That block was clean.
→ Totally. Replay showed ball first—refs got it right.
segments.zh:
那帽是乾淨的。
→ 完全。 重播先碰到球—裁判判對。

segments.en:
Rematch when they're in town?
→ Count me in. I'll watch the schedule drop and text you.
segments.zh:
他們下次來城再約？
→ 算我。 賽程出來我傳訊給你。

articles.summaryZh: 一級方程式賽事日：排位、進站、策略與看臺現場感。

segments.en: Free practice tells us who has raw pace.
segments.zh: 自由練習看得出誰的純速度強。

segments.en: Qualifying splits the grid for Sunday.
segments.zh: 排位決定週日發車順位。

segments.en: Track evolution makes lap times drop each session.
segments.zh: 賽道進化讓每場次圈速愈來愈快。

segments.en: Wind gusts can ruin a fast corner entry.
segments.zh: 陣風會毀掉快彎入彎。

segments.en: Teams hide engine modes until it counts.
segments.zh: 車隊會藏動力模式到關鍵時刻。

segments.en: I set alarms for every session start.
segments.zh: 每場次開跑我都設鬧鐘。

segments.en: Race morning I check weather radar nonstop.
segments.zh: 正賽早上我不停看天氣雷達。

segments.en: Drivers walk the grid with engineers.
segments.zh: 車手跟工程師一起走發車格。

segments.en: Tyre blankets come off minutes before the formation lap.
segments.zh: 暖胎毯在暖胎圈前幾分鐘才拆。

segments.en: National anthems blur when you're too excited.
segments.zh: 太興奮時國歌都聽不清楚。

segments.en: Lights out and my heart rate spikes.
segments.zh: 五燈全滅瞬間心跳飆高。

segments.en: Turn one is chaos every single time.
segments.zh: 第一彎每次都一團亂。

segments.en: Undercut can jump you ahead on fresh rubber.
segments.zh: Undercut 換新胎可能反超前面。

segments.en: Safety car bunches the field like a reset.
segments.zh: 安全車讓車群像重置一樣擠在一起。

segments.en: They stretch stint one to cover a rival stop.
segments.zh: 他們拉長第一段 stint 以應對對手進站。

segments.en: Softs grain fast on this abrasive surface.
segments.zh: 這磨耗路面軟胎很快顆粒化。

segments.en: Pit crew target two seconds flat.
segments.zh: 換胎組目標兩秒內搞定。

segments.en: Strategy radio is half math, half drama.
segments.zh: 策略無線電一半數學一半戲劇。

segments.en: You feel the cars before you fully hear them.
segments.zh: 還沒聽清就先感覺到車來了。

segments.en: DRS zones mean overtakes down the main straight.
segments.zh: DRS 區主直道容易超車。

segments.en: Our grandstand faces the best braking zone.
segments.zh: 我們看臺對著最佳煞車點。

segments.en: Earplugs help but your chest still rattles.
segments.zh: 耳塞有用但胸口還是會震。

segments.en: Fan flags wave when the home hero pits.
segments.zh: 家將進站時球迷旗會揮。

segments.en: Live timing on the app beats the big screen sometimes.
segments.zh: 有時手機即時計時比大螢幕快。

segments.en: Podium champagne sprays the photographers.
segments.zh: 頒獎臺香檳會噴向攝影師。

segments.en: We debate penalty calls in the parking lot.
segments.zh: 我們在停車場爭論罰則。

segments.en: Highlights never capture lateral G in your neck.
segments.zh: 精華帶不出你脖子承受的橫向 G。

segments.en: Next race is two weeks—I'll rewatch onboard cams.
segments.zh: 下一場兩週後—我會重看 onboard。

segments.en: Merch lines move slow but hoodies sell out.
segments.zh: 周邊隊慢但連帽衫常售罄。

segments.en: Already counting days till the calendar drops.
segments.zh: 我已開始倒數賽程公佈。

segments.en: Who's on pole?
segments.zh: 誰拿杆位？

segments.en: Rain's coming.
segments.zh: 要下雨了。

segments.en: That overtake was clean.
segments.zh: 那次超車很乾淨。

segments.en: Team radio is wild.
segments.zh: 車隊無線電太狂。

segments.en: Pit stop was slow.
segments.zh: 進站好慢。

segments.en: Safety car again?
segments.zh: 又安全車？

segments.en: My ears are ringing.
segments.zh: 我耳朵還在鳴。

segments.en: Which turn is best?
segments.zh: 哪個彎最好看？

segments.en: He's getting blue flags.
segments.zh: 他在被示藍旗。

segments.en: DRS helped that pass.
segments.zh: DRS 幫了那次超車。

segments.en: Chequered flag!
segments.zh: 方格旗！

segments.en: Flight home is tomorrow.
segments.zh: 明早才搭機回家。

segments.en:
First live F1 race—wow.
→ Hooked? Most people are—nothing on TV matches the sound.
segments.zh:
第一次現場 F1—哇。
→ 上癮了？ 多半會—電視比不了現場聲浪。

segments.en:
Why did they penalize him?
→ Track limits. He ran wide at turn four too many times—automated sensors.
segments.zh:
為什麼罰他？
→ 賽道界限。 他在四號彎出界太多次—自動感測。

segments.en:
Your driver looks calm.
→ Ice in veins. Radio stays quiet unless tyres drop off.
segments.zh:
你支持的車手好冷靜。
→ 血管裡是冰。 除非輪胎衰退，無線電都很安靜。

segments.en:
Can't follow the strategy.
→ Same. Watch undercuts when gaps are under three seconds.
segments.zh:
策略跟不上。
→ 我也。 差距三秒內就看誰先 undercut。

segments.en:
Hot in this grandstand.
→ Brutal. Shade starts after lap thirty—hang in there.
segments.zh:
這看臺好熱。
→ 很硬。 三十圈後才有陰影—撐一下。

segments.en:
Best weekend ever.
→ Agreed. We should do a street race next—Miami or Vegas.
segments.zh:
最棒的週末。
→ 同意。 下次該看街道賽—邁阿密或拉斯維加斯。

segments.en:
Is qualifying worth the ticket?
→ Yes. Saturday drama sets the grid—often tighter than the race.
segments.zh:
排位賽值得買票嗎？
→ 值得。 週六定順位—常常比正賽還緊張。

segments.en:
That crash looked scary.
→ Scary. Halos do their job—driver walked away.
segments.zh:
那撞車看起來好嚇人。
→ 嚇人。 Halo 有用—車手自己走下來了。

segments.en:
Who's your team?
→ Red side. Been loyal since childhood—bad years included.
segments.zh:
你支持哪隊？
→ 紅色那邊。 從小就是—低潮年也沒跑。

segments.en:
Merch is pricey.
→ Yeah. I grab caps at outlet malls off-season instead.
segments.zh:
周邊好貴。
→ 是啊。 我淡季去 outlet 買帽子。

segments.en:
Race was boring till the end.
→ Typical. Tyre deg flipped the order in the last ten laps.
segments.zh:
正賽到最後才好看。
→ 常這樣。 最後十圈輪胎衰退翻轉排名。

segments.en:
Same trip next year?
→ Let's plan it. Hotels sell out fast when the calendar posts.
segments.zh:
明年同一趟？
→ 來規劃。 賽程一齣飯店秒沒。

items.pattern: Track evolution makes lap times drop [SWAP].

items.baseZh: 賽道進化讓每場次圈速愈來愈快。

items.pattern: Teams hide [SWAP] until it counts.

items.pattern: Race morning I check weather [SWAP].

items.baseZh: 正賽早上我不停看天氣雷達。

items.pattern: Tyre blankets come off minutes before the [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Tyre blankets come off minutes before the formation lap.
items.baseZh: 暖胎毯在暖胎圈前幾分鐘才拆。

items.pattern: Lights out and [SWAP] spikes.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Lights out and my heart rate spikes.
items.baseZh: 五燈全滅瞬間心跳飆高。

items.pattern: Undercut can jump you ahead on [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Undercut can jump you ahead on fresh rubber.
items.baseZh: Undercut 換新胎可能反超前面。

items.pattern: They stretch stint one to cover [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: They stretch stint one to cover a rival stop.
items.baseZh: 他們拉長第一段 stint 以應對對手進站。

items.pattern: Pit crew target two [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Pit crew target two seconds flat.
items.baseZh: 換胎組目標兩秒內搞定。

items.pattern: You feel [SWAP] you fully hear them.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: You feel the cars before you fully hear them.
items.baseZh: 還沒聽清就先感覺到車來了。

items.pattern: Our grandstand faces the best [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Our grandstand faces the best braking zone.
items.baseZh: 我們看臺對著最佳煞車點。

items.pattern: Fan flags wave when [SWAP] pits.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Fan flags wave when the home hero pits.
items.baseZh: 家將進站時球迷旗會揮。

items.pattern: Podium champagne sprays [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Podium champagne sprays the photographers.
items.baseZh: 頒獎臺香檳會噴向攝影師。

items.pattern: Highlights never capture [SWAP] in your neck.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Highlights never capture lateral G in your neck.
items.baseZh: 精華帶不出你脖子承受的橫向 G。

items.pattern: Merch lines move slow but hoodies [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Merch lines move slow but hoodies sell out.
items.baseZh: 周邊隊慢但連帽衫常售罄。

articles.summaryZh: 在家開夥：備料、鍋灶、調味試吃與收拾收尾。

segments.en: Let's keep tonight simple—one pan, one salad.
segments.zh: 今晚簡單點—一鍋一沙拉。

segments.en: I checked what we already have in the fridge.
segments.zh: 我先看冰箱裡有什麼。

segments.en: The recipe says thirty minutes; add ten for us.
segments.zh: 食譜寫三十分鐘；我們加十分鐘。

segments.en: We need garlic, lemon, and decent olive oil.
segments.zh: 要蒜、檸檬和好一點的橄欖油。

segments.en: If the store is out of basil, mint works fine.
segments.zh: 羅勒沒有的話薄荷也行。

segments.en: I'll handle protein; you chop the veggies.
segments.zh: 蛋白質我來；你切菜。

segments.en: Sharp knife makes prep way less annoying.
segments.zh: 刀利備料就不那麼煩。

segments.en: I line a bowl for scraps so cleanup is fast.
segments.zh: 我放一碗裝廚餘，收尾快。

segments.en: Salt the pasta water till it tastes like the sea.
segments.zh: 煮麵水要鹹到像海水。

segments.en: Pat the chicken dry before it hits the pan.
segments.zh: 雞肉下鍋前先拍乾。

segments.en: Mise en place saves you from burning garlic.
segments.zh: 材料先備好才不會把蒜煎焦。

segments.en: Taste as you go—that's the whole secret.
segments.zh: 邊做邊嚐—秘訣就在這。

segments.en: Heat the pan before the oil goes in.
segments.zh: 先熱鍋再下油。

segments.en: Don't crowd the skillet or nothing browns.
segments.zh: 鍋別塞太滿，不然不上色。

segments.en: Lower the flame once the butter foams.
segments.zh: 奶油起沫就轉小火。

segments.en: Deglaze with a splash of wine—scrape the bits.
segments.zh: 淋點酒 deglaze，刮鍋底焦香。

segments.en: The sauce should coat the spoon, not drip off.
segments.zh: 醬要能掛勺，不是滴下去。

segments.en: Rest the steak five minutes before you slice.
segments.zh: 牛排切前先靜置五分鐘。

segments.en: Plates warm in the oven so food stays hot.
segments.zh: 盤子烤箱保溫，菜才不涼。

segments.en: A squeeze of lemon wakes everything up.
segments.zh: 擠檸檬整盤都亮起來。

segments.en: Tell me honestly if it needs more salt.
segments.zh: 老實說還要不要加鹽。

segments.en: Kids get mild sauce on the side.
segments.zh: 小孩醬料分開放淡的。

segments.en: We snap a photo then phones go away.
segments.zh: 拍張照後手機收起來。

segments.en: Leftovers tomorrow mean lunch is solved.
segments.zh: 明天便當有著落了。

segments.en: Soak the pot now while sauce is still soft.
segments.zh: 醬還軟就先泡鍋。

segments.en: Wipe counters before grease sets.
segments.zh: 油還沒凝就先擦檯面。

segments.en: Compost scraps if the bin isn't full.
segments.zh: 堆肥桶沒滿就 compost 廚餘。

segments.en: Run the dishwasher on eco—we're not in a rush.
segments.zh: 洗碗機開 eco，我們不趕。

segments.en: Label the container with today's date.
segments.zh: 保鮮盒標今天日期。

segments.en: Kitchen clean, playlist off—good night.
segments.zh: 廚房收乾淨、音樂關—晚安。

segments.en: Smells amazing in here.
segments.zh: 這裡好香。

segments.en: Need a hand peeling?
segments.zh: 要幫忙削皮嗎？

segments.en: How spicy is this?
segments.zh: 這有多辣？

segments.en: Timer's beeping.
segments.zh: 計時器響了。

segments.en: We're out of foil.
segments.zh: 錫箔紙沒了。

segments.en: Can kids eat this?
segments.zh: 小孩能吃嗎？

segments.en: Wine or water?
segments.zh: 葡萄酒還是水？

segments.en: Burned the garlic again.
segments.zh: 又把蒜煎焦了。

segments.en: Plate's ready.
segments.zh: 盤子好了。

segments.en: More rice, please.
segments.zh: 請再給點飯。

segments.en: Who's doing dishes?
segments.zh: 誰洗碗？

segments.en: Save me some for lunch.
segments.zh: 便當留我一份。

segments.en:
You cook like a pro.
→ Flattery! I just watch the same three YouTube chefs on repeat.
segments.zh:
你煮得像專業的。
→ 過獎！ 我只是重看同一三個 YouTube 廚師。

segments.en:
This is too salty for me.
→ Oops. Add a little pasta water to mellow it out.
segments.zh:
對我來說太鹹。
→ 糟了。 加點煮麵水會柔和一點。

segments.en:
What's the secret ingredient?
→ Butter. And finishing acid—lemon or vinegar at the end.
segments.zh:
秘密材料是什麼？
→ 奶油。 還有收尾的酸—檸檬或醋最後加。

segments.en:
I'm starving.
→ Almost. Ten more minutes—appetizers are on the counter.
segments.zh:
我餓扁了。
→ 快了。 再十分鐘—前菜在檯面上。

segments.en:
Can we freeze leftovers?
→ Sure. Soup yes; salad no—eat that tonight.
segments.zh:
剩菜能冷凍嗎？
→ 可以。 湯可以；沙拉不行—今晚吃掉。

segments.en:
Your knife skills scare me.
→ Practice. I still bandage fingers—go slow if you're new.
segments.zh:
你刀工嚇到我。
→ 練的。 我還是會包創可貼—新手就慢切。

segments.en:
Restaurant was booked anyway.
→ Lucky us. Home beats waiting forty minutes for a table.
segments.zh:
餐廳反正訂不到位。
→ 我們賺到。 在家比等位四十分鐘強。

segments.en:
More garlic next time?
→ Deal. I'll roast a whole head—sweet and mellow.
segments.zh:
下次多蒜？
→ 好。 我烤整顆蒜—又甜又溫和。

segments.en:
I'm on cleanup duty.
→ Hero. Stack plates by the sink—I already soaked the pan.
segments.zh:
我負責收尾。
→ 英雄。 盤子堆水槽邊—鍋我已泡了。

segments.en:
Recipe from your mom?
→ Partly. She taught the soup; I stole the spice mix online.
segments.zh:
食譜是媽媽的？
→ 有一點。 湯是她教的；香料組是我網上學的。

segments.en:
We should do this weekly.
→ I'm in. Pick a theme—Taco Tuesday, pasta Thursday.
segments.zh:
該每週這樣煮。
→ 我贊成。 訂主題—週二塔可、週四義麵。

segments.en:
Best meal this month.
→ Thanks! Wait till you try my slightly burnt dessert.
segments.zh:
本月最好一餐。
→ 謝啦！ 等我略焦的甜點上桌再說。

articles.summaryZh: 仲介帶看：開門迎客、空間亮點、疑慮回應與後續跟進。

segments.en: I unlock early and run every light in the house.
segments.zh: 我提早開門，把全屋燈都打開。

segments.en: Soft music hides the fridge hum in the kitchen.
segments.zh: 輕音樂蓋過廚房冰箱嗡嗡聲。

segments.en: Fresh flowers on the table make photos pop.
segments.zh: 桌上有鮮花，照片會更亮眼。

segments.en: I print extra disclosure packets for serious buyers.
segments.zh: 認真買家我多印披露文件。

segments.en: Weather apps decide if we highlight the patio.
segments.zh: 看天氣決定要不要主打露臺。

segments.en: My phone stays on silent unless escrow calls.
segments.zh: 手機靜音，除非 Escrow 來電。

segments.en: Shoes off or booties—seller prefers booties.
segments.zh: 脫鞋或鞋套—屋主要求鞋套。

segments.en: We start at the brightest room, not the foyer.
segments.zh: 從最亮的房間開始，不是玄關。

segments.en: Natural light sells better than any staging trick.
segments.zh: 自然光比任何 staging 伎倆都好賣。

segments.en: I point out storage people always miss.
segments.zh: 我會指常被忽略的收納。

segments.en: Kids peek at the backyard while parents count outlets.
segments.zh: 小孩看後院，父母數插座。

segments.en: Second showing means they're comparing two homes.
segments.zh: 二看代表他們在兩戶間比較。

segments.en: Comps on this block moved fast last month.
segments.zh: 這區上月成交很快。

segments.en: List price reflects the new roof, not the old carpet.
segments.zh: 開價反映新屋頂，不含舊地毯。

segments.en: Rates shifted, so buyers watch monthly payments.
segments.zh: 利率變了，買家盯月供。

segments.en: A clean offer beats a messy one with drama.
segments.zh: 乾淨出價勝過條件一堆的。

segments.en: Inspection items are normal—don't panic at the report.
segments.zh: 檢查報告有項目很正常—別慌。

segments.en: I text updates before my clients read gossip online.
segments.zh: 客戶還沒看八卦網前我就先更新。

segments.en: That hairline crack is cosmetic, not structural.
segments.zh: 那細裂是表面，不是結構。

segments.en: HOA fees cover landscaping and pool service.
segments.zh: HOA 費含造景與泳池維護。

segments.en: School ratings change—verify on the district site.
segments.zh: 學區評分會變—上學區官網查。

segments.en: Noise at rush hour—listen with windows open.
segments.zh: 尖峰噪音—開窗聽一次。

segments.en: Sellers may credit paint if you ask politely.
segments.zh: 禮貌問，賣方可能補油漆。

segments.en: I never trash-talk the neighbor's listing.
segments.zh: 我從不踩隔壁那戶的案。

segments.en: I email a summary while the visit is fresh.
segments.zh: 趁記憶新鮮我寄帶看摘要。

segments.en: Open house Sunday if you want one more walk-through.
segments.zh: 週日 open house 可再看一次。

segments.en: Lender pre-approval speeds up your offer window.
segments.zh: 貸款預核准能縮短出價窗口。

segments.en: Keys go to the lockbox—I double-check the code.
segments.zh: 鑰匙回 lockbox—我會再對密碼。

segments.en: If you pass, I'll note why for the seller.
segments.zh: 若不考慮，我會記原因給賣方。

segments.en: Good agents follow up without nagging.
segments.zh: 好仲介會跟進但不糾纏。

segments.en: How long on market?
segments.zh: 上市多久了？

segments.en: Basement feels damp.
segments.zh: 地下室有點潮。

segments.en: Can we see the garage?
segments.zh: 能看車庫嗎？

segments.en: Love the kitchen layout.
segments.zh: 喜歡廚房動線。

segments.en: Any offers yet?
segments.zh: 已有出價嗎？

segments.en: Neighbor dogs loud?
segments.zh: 鄰居狗很吵嗎？

segments.en: HOA allows rentals?
segments.zh: HOA 允許出租嗎？

segments.en: We need a home office.
segments.zh: 我們要居家辦公室。

segments.en: Taxes seem high.
segments.zh: 稅好像很高。

segments.en: Closing timeline?
segments.zh: 過戶時程？

segments.en: Smells like fresh paint.
segments.zh: 有油漆味。

segments.en: We'll think it over.
segments.zh: 我們再想想。

segments.en:
It's smaller than the photos.
→ Fair point. Wide lenses lie—measure the rooms you care about.
segments.zh:
比照片小。
→ 有道理。 廣角會騙人—量你在意的房間。

segments.en:
We love the backyard.
→ Same here. Sun hits the deck till four—great for weekends.
segments.zh:
超愛後院。
→ 我也。 Deck 曬到四點—週末很讚。

segments.en:
Is the area safe?
→ Check stats. I send city crime maps—walk it at night yourself too.
segments.zh:
這區安全嗎？
→ 看數據。 我寄城市犯罪圖—你也自己晚上走走看。

segments.en:
Can we bring our agent?
→ Of course. Schedule together—co-op showings save everyone time.
segments.zh:
能帶我們仲介嗎？
→ 當然。 一起排—合作帶看省時間。

segments.en:
Price feels steep.
→ Let's talk. Recent comps and condition notes justify the ask.
segments.zh:
價位偏高。
→ 聊聊。 近期成交和屋況說明支撐開價。

segments.en:
Master bath needs work.
→ True. Budget twenty grand or ask for a credit in offer.
segments.zh:
主浴要整。
→ 是。 預算兩萬或出價時要折讓。

segments.en:
Commute to downtown?
→ Thirty-five minutes. Off-peak twenty—rush hour is the killer.
segments.zh:
到 downtown 通勤？
→ 約三十五分。 離峰二十—尖峰才要命。

segments.en:
We'll submit tonight.
→ Great! Send proof of funds and I'll confirm receipt with listing.
segments.zh:
今晚就出價。
→ 太好了！ 寄資金證明，我會跟 listing 確認收到。

segments.en:
Why are they selling?
→ Relocation. Job transfer out of state—timeline is flexible for right offer.
segments.zh:
為什麼要賣？
→ Relocation。 工作外州調動—好出價時程可談。

segments.en:
AC sounds old.
→ Serviced yearly. Receipts in the disclosure—still budget for eventual swap.
segments.zh:
冷氣聽起來很舊。
→ 年年保養。 披露有收據—仍要預留日後更換。

segments.en:
Not for us, thanks.
→ No worries. Tell me what missed—I can filter your next search.
segments.zh:
不適合我們，謝謝。
→ 沒關係。 說缺什麼—下次搜尋我幫你篩。

segments.en:
Open house worth it?
→ If you're close. Less pressure, but weekday showings get more time per room.
segments.zh:
open house 值得去嗎？
→ 若你住近。 壓力小，但平日帶看每間房時間多。

lesson.introZh: 四部分：五段心得口說、十二句參訪回應、十二組「附和＋完整補充」。先讀 Part 1 片語，再逐句跟讀；Part 4 再練 15 句抽換模板。

part4.introZh: Part 4｜內容精粹：從本篇抽出 15 句可抽換骨架。句型固定，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞，練替換反應與口說流暢度。

items.pattern: I unlock early and run every light in [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: I unlock early and run every light in the house.
items.baseZh: 我提早開門，把全屋燈都打開。

items.pattern: Fresh flowers on [SWAP] photos pop.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Fresh flowers on the table make photos pop.
items.baseZh: 桌上有鮮花，照片會更亮眼。

items.pattern: Weather apps decide if we highlight [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Weather apps decide if we highlight the patio.
items.baseZh: 看天氣決定要不要主打露臺。

items.pattern: Shoes off or [SWAP]—seller prefers booties.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Shoes off or booties—seller prefers booties.
items.baseZh: 脫鞋或鞋套—屋主要求鞋套。

items.pattern: Natural light sells better than any [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Natural light sells better than any staging trick.
items.baseZh: 自然光比任何 staging 伎倆都好賣。

items.pattern: Kids peek at [SWAP] parents count outlets.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Kids peek at the backyard while parents count outlets.
items.baseZh: 小孩看後院，父母數插座。

items.pattern: Comps on [SWAP] fast last month.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Comps on this block moved fast last month.
items.baseZh: 這區上月成交很快。

items.pattern: Rates shifted, so buyers watch [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Rates shifted, so buyers watch monthly payments.
items.baseZh: 利率變了，買家盯月供。

items.pattern: Inspection items are normal—don't panic at [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Inspection items are normal—don't panic at the report.
items.baseZh: 檢查報告有項目很正常—別慌。

items.pattern: That hairline crack is cosmetic, [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: That hairline crack is cosmetic, not structural.
items.baseZh: 那細裂是表面，不是結構。

items.pattern: School ratings change—verify on [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: School ratings change—verify on the district site.
items.baseZh: 學區評分會變—上學區官網查。

items.pattern: Sellers may credit paint if you [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Sellers may credit paint if you ask politely.
items.baseZh: 禮貌問，賣方可能補油漆。

items.pattern: I email a summary while [SWAP] fresh.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: I email a summary while the visit is fresh.
items.baseZh: 趁記憶新鮮我寄帶看摘要。

items.pattern: Lender [SWAP] speeds up your offer window.
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Lender pre-approval speeds up your offer window.
items.baseZh: 貸款預核准能縮短出價窗口。

items.pattern: If you pass, I'll note why for [SWAP].
items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: If you pass, I'll note why for the seller.
items.baseZh: 若不考慮，我會記原因給賣方。

articles.summaryZh: CFA 備考日常：讀書計畫、題庫、模考與考後調整。

segments.en: I block two hours before work for ethics readings.
segments.zh: 上班前我留兩小時讀 Ethics。

segments.en: The curriculum stack looks scary till you split it.
segments.zh: 課本堆很嚇人，切開就不會。

segments.en: I track hours in a spreadsheet—no guessing.
segments.zh: 時數記在試算表—不瞎估。

segments.en: Weekends are for long formulas, not social plans.
segments.zh: 週末留給長公式，不是聚會。

segments.en: Burnout hits if I skip one full rest day.
segments.zh: 不休完整一天就會 burnout。

segments.en: Small wins: finish one LOS before lunch.
segments.zh: 小勝利：午餐前完成一個 LOS。

segments.en: Question bank beats rereading the same PDF.
segments.zh: 題庫比重讀 PDF 有用。

segments.en: I review wrong answers the same night.
segments.zh: 錯題當晚就複習。

segments.en: Flagged items get a second pass on Sundays.
segments.zh: 標記題週日第二遍。

segments.en: Calculator muscle memory saves exam minutes.
segments.zh: 計算機肌肉記憶省考試分鐘。

segments.en: Ethics vignettes punish sloppy shortcuts.
segments.zh: Ethics 情境題會懲罰亂猜。

segments.en: Study groups help on fixed income, not ego.
segments.zh: 讀書會對固定收益有用，不是比面子。

segments.en: Mock exams hurt—but they show weak spots.
segments.zh: 模考很痛—但露出弱點。

segments.en: I simulate bathroom breaks and scratch paper limits.
segments.zh: 我模擬上廁所和草稿紙限制。

segments.en: Pacing: ninety seconds per item on average.
segments.zh: 節奏：平均每題九十秒。

segments.en: Guessing strategy matters when time runs out.
segments.zh: 時間不夠時猜題策略很重要。

segments.en: Review mock rationales, not just scores.
segments.zh: 模考看解析，不只分數。

segments.en: Sleep the night before beats one more chapter.
segments.zh: 考前睡飽勝過多讀一章。

segments.en: My manager knows August is exam month.
segments.zh: 主管知道八月是考試月。

segments.en: I eat meal prep so study time doesn't slip.
segments.zh: 我備餐，免得讀書時間被吃掉。

segments.en: Friends joke I'm married to Schweser notes.
segments.zh: 朋友笑我跟 Schweser 訂婚了。

segments.en: Gym breaks clear my head for quant.
segments.zh: 健身讓 Quant 腦袋清醒。

segments.en: I quit doom-scrolling during review season.
segments.zh: 衝刺季我戒掉 doom-scroll。

segments.en: Pass or fail, I debrief what to change.
segments.zh: 過或掛都檢討要改什麼。

segments.en: Level two builds on level one—no skipping basics.
segments.zh: 二級靠一級—基礎不能跳。

segments.en: Charter hours matter for career moves later.
segments.zh: Charter 時數日後轉職有用。

segments.en: I network at local CFA society events.
segments.zh: 我參加本地 CFA 學會活動人脈。

segments.en: Fail once; adjust plan, not self-worth.
segments.zh: 掛一次；改計畫，不改自我價值。

segments.en: Employer reimbursement helps if you pass.
segments.zh: 過了公司補助就有幫助。

segments.en: The grind ends; the skills stay.
segments.zh: 苦會結束；能力會留下。

segments.en: Which level are you on?
segments.zh: 你考第幾級？

segments.en: Ethics again?
segments.zh: 又是 Ethics？

segments.en: Mock score dropped.
segments.zh: 模考分數掉了。

segments.en: Coffee's on me.
segments.zh: 咖啡我請。

segments.en: Need your quant notes.
segments.zh: 借你的 Quant 筆記。

segments.en: Exam window opens when?
segments.zh: 考期什麼時候？

segments.en: Too tired to read.
segments.zh: 累到讀不動。

segments.en: Schweser or curriculum?
segments.zh: Schweser 還是官方？

segments.en: Prometric was a zoo.
segments.zh: 考場 Prometric 超亂。

segments.en: Passed by one point!
segments.zh: 差一分過！

segments.en: Retake in six months?
segments.zh: 半年後重考？

segments.en: Celebrate after results.
segments.zh: 成績出來再慶祝。

segments.en:
Is CFA worth the pain?
→ Depends. If you want buy-side credibility, yes—if not, maybe skip.
segments.zh:
CFA 值得這麼痛嗎？
→ 看情況。 想要 buy-side 信用背書就值得—不然可能不必。

segments.en:
I failed level one.
→ Rough. Half of us fail once—fix your mock routine, not your IQ.
segments.zh:
我一級掛了。
→ 難受。 一半人掛過—改模考流程，不是智商。

segments.en:
How many hours did you log?
→ Around three hundred. Quality beats raw hours—timed sets matter most.
segments.zh:
你記多少小時？
→ 約三百。 質比時數重要—計時題組最關鍵。

segments.en:
Work pays for it?
→ Partially. They cover fees if I pass on first try—pressure's real.
segments.zh:
公司付錢嗎？
→ 一部分。 一次過才報名費—壓力是真的。

segments.en:
Study group tonight?
→ I'm in. Bring fixed income flashcards—we drill for an hour.
segments.zh:
今晚讀書會？
→ 我來。 帶固定收益卡—我們刷一小時。

segments.en:
Brain fried on derivatives.
→ Same. Switch to ethics vignettes—different muscle, still points.
segments.zh:
衍生性商品讀到腦炸。
→ 一樣。 換 Ethics 情境—不同腦區還是得分。

segments.en:
Any calculator tips?
→ Cash flows. Master CF and NPV keys—you'll thank yourself in quant.
segments.zh:
計算機有技巧嗎？
→ 現金流。 CF、NPV 鍵要熟—Quant 會感謝你。

segments.en:
Results day tomorrow.
→ Good luck! Whatever happens, you already leveled up your discipline.
segments.zh:
明天放榜。
→ 祝好運！ 不管結果，你的紀律已經升級。

segments.en:
Should I defer?
→ Honest check. If mocks are under sixty, defer—ego deferrals hurt more.
segments.zh:
該延期嗎？
→ 誠實檢查。 模考六十分下就延—硬撐更傷。

segments.en:
You make it look easy.
→ It's not. I just hide panic behind color-coded tabs.
segments.zh:
你看起來好輕鬆。
→ 才不是。 我只是用彩色標籤藏 panic。

segments.en:
Career boost after charter?
→ Some. Doors open on résumé screens—still need people skills.
segments.zh:
Charter 後職涯有差？
→ 有一點。 履歷過初篩有幫—軟技能還是要。

segments.en:
Drinks when we're done?
→ Absolutely. No curriculum talk for forty-eight hours—deal?
segments.zh:
考完喝一杯？
→ 一定。 四十八小時不準聊課本—說好？

articles.summaryZh: 業餘空拍：法規、起飛準備、拍攝技巧與分享作品。

segments.en: I check NOTAMs and local no-fly zones on the app.
segments.zh: 我在 app 查 NOTAM 和禁飛區。

segments.en: Batteries at ninety percent or I don't launch.
segments.zh: 電池不到九成我不起飛。

segments.en: Propellers get a quick twist test every time.
segments.zh: 每次起飛前快速轉一下槳葉。

segments.en: SD card empty—lost footage hurts more than crashes.
segments.zh: 記憶卡清空—丟素材比墜機痛。

segments.en: I calibrate the compass away from metal benches.
segments.zh: 我在遠離金屬長椅處校正羅盤。

segments.en: Return-to-home height clears the tallest trees.
segments.zh: 返航高度要高過最高樹。

segments.en: Golden hour beats filters every time.
segments.zh: 黃金時刻永遠勝過濾鏡。

segments.en: I fly slow for cinematic moves, not racing.
segments.zh: 我慢飛拍電影感，不競速。

segments.en: ND filters keep shutter natural in bright sun.
segments.zh: ND 鏡讓大太陽下快門自然。

segments.en: People on the ground deserve privacy—frame wide.
segments.zh: 地面的人要隱私—構圖拉遠。

segments.en: Wind gusts mean land early, no hero shots.
segments.zh: 陣風就早收，別逞強。

segments.en: I log flight time for insurance and Part 107.
segments.zh: 我記飛行時數給保險和 Part 107。

segments.en: Line of sight isn't optional—it's the rule.
segments.zh: 視距內飛行不是選項—是規定。

segments.en: National parks are usually off limits.
segments.zh: 國家公園多半禁飛。

segments.en: I ask neighbors before buzzing rooftops.
segments.zh: 低空過屋頂前我會問鄰居。

segments.en: Night flights need waivers and extra lights.
segments.zh: 夜間飛要豁免和額外燈。

segments.en: Noise complaints spread fast on Nextdoor.
segments.zh: 噪音抱怨在 Nextdoor 傳很快。

segments.en: Commercial gigs mean contracts and liability.
segments.zh: 商案要合約和責任險。

segments.en: I color grade lightly—sky banding shows fast.
segments.zh: 調色我放輕—天空色帶很快露餡。

segments.en: Music licensing matters if you post for clients.
segments.zh: 給客戶發片音樂授權很重要。

segments.en: Hyperlapse needs planning, not just speed sliders.
segments.zh: 縮時要規劃，不只拉速度。

segments.en: Backup drives live in two places, always.
segments.zh: 備份硬碟永遠放兩處。

segments.en: I credit spotters who watch for hikers.
segments.zh: 我感謝幫看徒步者的觀察員。

segments.en: Comments about illegal flying—I reply with facts.
segments.zh: 說非法飛行—我用事實回。

segments.en: New firmware drops—read release notes first.
segments.zh: 新韌體出來—先看 release notes。

segments.en: Mini drones fit travel; big ones need cases.
segments.zh: 小機適合旅行；大機要箱子。

segments.en: Local meetups swap tips safer than YouTube alone.
segments.zh: 本地聚會比只看 YouTube 安全。

segments.en: Crash story plus lesson helps beginners.
segments.zh: 墜機故事加教訓幫新手。

segments.en: I save for sensors, not just shiny shells.
segments.zh: 我存錢買感測器，不只外殼。

segments.en: Clear skies tomorrow—charge everything tonight.
segments.zh: 明天晴—今晚全充電。

segments.en: Is that legal here?
segments.zh: 這裡能飛嗎？

segments.en: Wind picked up.
segments.zh: 風變大了。

segments.en: Cool shot!
segments.zh: 拍好帥！

segments.en: Bird almost hit it.
segments.zh: 鳥差點撞到。

segments.en: How high can you go?
segments.zh: 能飛多高？

segments.en: Battery low warning?
segments.zh: 低電警告了嗎？

segments.en: Register with FAA?
segments.zh: 有 FAA 登記嗎？

segments.en: Too loud for this park.
segments.zh: 這公園太吵了。

segments.en: Can you film our event?
segments.zh: 能拍我們活動嗎？

segments.en: Lost signal!
segments.zh: 失聯了！

segments.en: Landing zone clear?
segments.zh: 降落區清空了嗎？

segments.en: Send me the clip.
segments.zh: 傳我片段。

segments.en:
That drone looks expensive.
→ Mid-range. I'd rather spend on extra batteries than the fanciest body.
segments.zh:
那空拍機好貴。
→ 中階。 我寧願多買電池，不追最貴機身。

segments.en:
You're freaking people out.
→ Sorry. I'll climb higher and stay over the water only.
segments.zh:
你嚇到大家了。
→ 抱歉。 我拉高，只在水面上空飛。

segments.en:
How'd you learn?
→ Sim first. Simulator hours, then open field with a spotter.
segments.zh:
怎麼學的？
→ 先模擬器。 模擬器時數，再開闊場地加觀察員。

segments.en:
Ever crash?
→ Twice. Once a tree, once ego—both taught preflight checks.
segments.zh:
摔過嗎？
→ 兩次。 一次樹、一次逞強—都教會起飛前檢查。

segments.en:
Can I try the controls?
→ Not today. Insurance covers me solo—happy to show footage though.
segments.zh:
我能試控嗎？
→ 今天不行。 保險只保我單飛—但可以給你看素材。

segments.en:
Perfect sunset.
→ Right? I waited three evenings for this light and no wind.
segments.zh:
日落完美。
→ 對吧？ 我等了三個傍晚才等到這光線和無風。

segments.en:
Police drove by.
→ Stay calm. I have registration and flight log ready on my phone.
segments.zh:
警察路過。
→ 別慌。 手機備好登記和飛行紀錄。

segments.en:
Sell prints from those?
→ Maybe. Property releases needed for some rooftops—lawyer friend helps.
segments.zh:
那些能賣印刷品嗎？
→ 也許。 有些屋頂要物權釋出—律師朋友幫忙。

segments.en:
Mini or full size?
→ Both. Mini for hikes, full size for paid real estate jobs.
segments.zh:
迷你還是全尺寸？
→ 都有。 爬山用 mini，付費房產案用全尺寸。

segments.en:
Rain's coming.
→ Pack up. Water and motors don't mix—dry the props at home.
segments.zh:
要下雨了。
→ 收吧。 水電機不合—回家擦乾槳。

segments.en:
Follow me on social?
→ Sure. Handle's on the card—I post B-roll, not people's faces.
segments.zh:
社群追一下？
→ 好。 名片有帳號—我發空鏡，不拍路人臉。

segments.en:
Fly again this weekend?
→ Forecast says yes. Sunrise at the pier—spotter slot open if you want it.
segments.zh:
週末再飛？
→ 預報可以。 碼頭日出—要當觀察員可以報名。

articles.summaryZh: 聚會聊旅行：準備、途中趣事、文化差異與下次想去哪。

segments.en: I over-research neighborhoods before I book.
segments.zh: 訂房前我會把街區查過頭。

segments.en: Packing cubes saved my marriage, honestly.
segments.zh: 老實說收納袋救了我婚姻。

segments.en: I download offline maps for every transit leg.
segments.zh: 每段交通我都下離線地圖。

segments.en: Travel insurance feels boring till you need it.
segments.zh: 旅遊險無聊，用到才知重要。

segments.en: I learn three phrases—hello, thanks, bathroom.
segments.zh: 我學三句—你好、謝謝、廁所在哪。

segments.en: Expect plans to change; that's half the fun.
segments.zh: 計畫會變—一半樂趣在這。

segments.en: Security always flags my tiny shampoo.
segments.zh: 安檢總攔我的小洗髮精。

segments.en: I chase lounge showers on long layovers.
segments.zh: 長轉機我會找貴賓室淋浴。

segments.en: Gate changes send everyone sprinting.
segments.zh: 登機門一改大家狂奔。

segments.en: I board early only if overhead space matters.
segments.zh: 除非要頭頂艙位我才早登機。

segments.en: Jet lag hits harder eastbound for me.
segments.zh: 往東飛我時差更慘。

segments.en: Kind strangers fix Wi-Fi when apps fail.
segments.zh: app 掛了陌生好心人會教 Wi-Fi。

segments.en: Street food lines mean trust, not tourist traps.
segments.zh: 排隊路邊攤代表信任，不是陷阱。

segments.en: I walk till my feet quit, then grab a tram.
segments.zh: 走到腳罷工再搭電車。

segments.en: Museums need time limits or I never leave.
segments.zh: 博物館要限時不然我出不來。

segments.en: Tipping rules confuse me every single country.
segments.zh: 每國小費規則都把我搞混。

segments.en: Sunrise spots beat influencer lists.
segments.zh: 日出點勝過網紅清單。

segments.en: I journal one line a day—memory anchor.
segments.zh: 我每天一行日記—當記憶錨。

segments.en: We split once—solo café hour, zero guilt.
segments.zh: 我們分開一次—獨自咖啡零罪惡。

segments.en: Lost luggage united us with matching shirts.
segments.zh: 行李丟了反而讓我們穿同款 T。

segments.en: Wrong train stop led to the best bakery.
segments.zh: 下錯站反而找到最好麵包店。

segments.en: Photos later; presence first at dinner.
segments.zh: 先在場吃飯；照片晚點拍。

segments.en: Budget travelers and splurge days can coexist.
segments.zh: 省旅費和奢侈日可以並存。

segments.en: We still laugh about the goat on the bus.
segments.zh: 公車上的山羊我們還在笑。

segments.en: Laundry smell means I'm actually home.
segments.zh: 洗衣味代表我真的回家了。

segments.en: I upload photos before stories fade.
segments.zh: 故事模糊前我先上傳照片。

segments.en: Friends want tips, not every single slide.
segments.zh: 朋友要攻略，不是每張幻燈片。

segments.en: Passport stamps fuel the next wish list.
segments.zh: 護照章養大下一張願望清單。

segments.en: I keep one souvenir that fits in a pocket.
segments.zh: 我留一件口袋放得下的紀念品。

segments.en: Already plotting shoulder season somewhere cool.
segments.zh: 已在盤算某個涼爽淡季。

segments.en: Where'd you go?
segments.zh: 去哪玩了？

segments.en: How was the food?
segments.zh: 吃的怎樣？

segments.en: Safe for solo women?
segments.zh: 女生獨旅安全嗎？

segments.en: Total cost?
segments.zh: 總共多少？

segments.en: Best photo spot?
segments.zh: 最佳拍照點？

segments.en: Language barrier?
segments.zh: 語言障礙？

segments.en: Would you repeat?
segments.zh: 會再去嗎？

segments.en: Flight horror story?
segments.zh: 航班災難故事？

segments.en: Recommend the hotel?
segments.zh: 飯店推嗎？

segments.en: How many days enough?
segments.zh: 幾天夠？

segments.en: Jet lag bad?
segments.zh: 時差很慘嗎？

segments.en: Next trip where?
segments.zh: 下一趟去哪？

segments.en:
I'm scared to fly.
→ Normal. Short hops and aisle seats helped me—therapy helps more.
segments.zh:
我怕搭飛機。
→ 正常。 短程加走道位幫我—諮商更有用。

segments.en:
That trip looked expensive.
→ Mixed. We splurged on two nights, hostel the rest.
segments.zh:
那趟看起來好貴。
→ 混搭。 兩晚奢侈，其餘 hostel。

segments.en:
Send me the itinerary.
→ On it. Google doc link—steal what fits, skip what doesn't.
segments.zh:
傳我行程。
→ 好。 Google 文件連結—適合的拿去，不要的跳過。

segments.en:
Crowds were awful.
→ Ugh. Go dawn or weekday—same sights, half the noise.
segments.zh:
人潮超可怕。
→ 唉。 清晨或平日—同景點少一半吵。

segments.en:
You travel so much.
→ Not really. One big trip a year, long weekends around it.
segments.zh:
你常旅行。
→ 還好。 一年一大趟，外加幾個長週末。

segments.en:
Food poisoning?
→ Once. Bad ice—now I watch bottled water seals.
segments.zh:
吃壞肚子了？
→ 一次。 冰有問題—現在我看瓶裝水封條。

segments.en:
Kids would love that.
→ Totally. Pack snacks and plan one slow day mid-trip.
segments.zh:
小孩會愛死。
→ 絕對。 帶點心，行程中留一天慢活。

segments.en:
Visa was a pain.
→ Same. Start paperwork ninety days out—photos always wrong first try.
segments.zh:
簽證超麻煩。
→ 一樣。 提前九十天辦—照片第一次準錯。

segments.en:
Best meal where?
→ Alley noodle shop. No English menu—point, smile, tip in cash.
segments.zh:
最好一餐在哪？
→ 巷內麵店。 沒英文菜單—指、笑、現金小費。

segments.en:
Travel buddy or solo?
→ Both. Solo for focus; friends for stories I'll retell forever.
segments.zh:
結伴還獨旅？
→ 都有。 獨旅求專注；朋友給講不完的故事。

segments.en:
Regret anything?
→ Overpacking. Half the clothes never left the cube—laundry abroad works.
segments.zh:
後悔什麼嗎？
→ 帶太多。 一半衣服沒出袋—當地洗衣就行。

segments.en:
Let's go together next time.
→ Deal! Pick a month—we split research and compare flights Tuesday nights.
segments.zh:
下次一起去。
→ 說好！ 定月份—研究分工，週二晚比機票。

articles.summaryZh: 親戚聚會：寒暄、飯桌話題、代溝與溫馨收場。

segments.en: I hug the aunt who always smells like cinnamon.
segments.zh: 我擁抱總是肉桂味的阿姨。

segments.en: Shoes off—Grandma's rule since forever.
segments.zh: 脫鞋—外婆一輩子的規矩。

segments.en: I bring pie so I'm not empty-handed.
segments.zh: 我帶派，不空手來。

segments.en: Kids zoom past legs toward the dessert table.
segments.zh: 小孩穿過大人腿衝向甜點桌。

segments.en: Small talk starts with traffic and weather.
segments.zh: 寒暄從交通和天氣開始。

segments.en: I ask about health before politics, always.
segments.zh: 我永遠先問健康再聊政治。

segments.en: Someone says grace; others reach for rolls.
segments.zh: 有人禱告，其他人伸手拿麵包。

segments.en: Pass the mashed potatoes counterclockwise.
segments.zh: 馬鈴薯泥逆時針傳。

segments.en: Uncle tells the same fishing story—we cheer anyway.
segments.zh: 舅舅重講釣魚故事—我們還是歡呼。

segments.en: I save room for pie; Mom notices and smiles.
segments.zh: 我留肚子給派—媽媽看見就笑。

segments.en: Diet talk waits till coffee, not main course.
segments.zh: 減肥話題等咖啡，不在主菜。

segments.en: Leftovers containers appear like magic.
segments.zh: 剩菜盒像魔法一樣出現。

segments.en: Cousin asks when I'm getting married—for the fifth year.
segments.zh: 表姊第五年問我何時結婚。

segments.en: I deflect with a joke about my cat.
segments.zh: 我用貓的玩笑帶過。

segments.en: Grandpa doesn't get my remote job; he nods kindly.
segments.zh: 外公不懂遠端工作—他還是友善點頭。

segments.en: Teens hide in phones; I invite them to dish duty.
segments.zh: 青少年躲手機—我拉他們洗碗。

segments.en: Old photos on the fridge start story wars.
segments.zh: 冰箱老照片引發故事大戰。

segments.en: We agree to disagree before dessert gets cold.
segments.zh: 甜點涼前我們同意各持己見。

segments.en: Kids table chaos is louder than the TV.
segments.zh: 小孩桌比電視還吵。

segments.en: Grandma sneaks candy when parents aren't looking.
segments.zh: 外婆趁父母沒看偷給糖。

segments.en: I teach the little one a card trick.
segments.zh: 我教小孩魔術牌技。

segments.en: Wheelchair spot stays clear near the window.
segments.zh: 輪椅位靠窗保持空曠。

segments.en: Hearing aids buzz when someone microwaves.
segments.zh: 有人用微波時助聽器會嗡。

segments.en: Patience is the real side dish tonight.
segments.zh: 耐心才是今晚真正的配菜。

segments.en: Coats pile up; hugs take twenty minutes.
segments.zh: 外套堆成山；擁抱要二十分鐘。

segments.en: I text Mom when I'm home safe.
segments.zh: 到家我傳訊給媽報平安。

segments.en: Next holiday maybe at our place—smaller crowd.
segments.zh: 下次節日可能我家—人少點。

segments.en: Family group chat explodes with blurry photos.
segments.zh: 家庭群組爆模糊照片。

segments.en: I'm tired and full and weirdly grateful.
segments.zh: 又累又飽，莫名感激。

segments.en: Same time next year—unless someone moves.
segments.zh: 明年同時—除非有人搬家。

segments.en: You look taller!
segments.zh: 你變高了！

segments.en: More gravy?
segments.zh: 還要肉汁嗎？

segments.en: Who made this?
segments.zh: 誰做的？

segments.en: Quiet down, kids.
segments.zh: 小孩安靜。

segments.en: Family photo time.
segments.zh: 全家福時間。

segments.en: Politics off the table.
segments.zh: 桌上不談政治。

segments.en: Drive safe.
segments.zh: 開車小心。

segments.en: Stay the night?
segments.zh: 留宿嗎？

segments.en: Your turn to host.
segments.zh: 輪到你辦了。

segments.en: Missed you.
segments.zh: 想你。

segments.en: Recipe, please.
segments.zh: 求食譜。

segments.en: Call more often.
segments.zh: 多打電話。

segments.en:
When are you having kids?
→ TBD. We're good for now—pass the green beans?
segments.zh:
什麼時候要小孩？
→ 未定。 目前這樣很好—青豆遞一下？

segments.en:
This turkey is dry.
→ Shh. Gravy fixes everything—Aunt Sue tried a new oven.
segments.zh:
火雞好柴。
→ 噓。 肉汁拯救一切—蘇阿姨換了新烤箱。

segments.en:
You work too much.
→ Maybe. Trying to protect weekends for visits like this.
segments.zh:
你工作太多。
→ 也許。 我在守週末，好參加這種聚會。

segments.en:
Remember when you were tiny?
→ Yep. Same couch, same photo wall—just taller hairlines.
segments.zh:
記得你超小隻？
→ 記得。 同沙發同照片牆—只是髮際線高了。

segments.en:
Can I take leftovers?
→ Take two. Mom packed extra—she guessed you'd ask.
segments.zh:
剩菜能帶走嗎？
→ 拿兩份。 媽多包了—她猜你會問。

segments.en:
Wi-Fi password?
→ On the fridge. Sticky note under the grandkid drawing—don't spill gravy on it.
segments.zh:
Wi-Fi 密碼？
→ 在冰箱。 外孫圖畫下的便利貼—別滴肉汁。

segments.en:
Your partner is lovely.
→ Thanks! They were nervous—family means a lot to them too.
segments.zh:
你對象人很好。
→ 謝謝！ 他們緊張—家人對他們也很重要。

segments.en:
Let's not wait a year.
→ Agreed. Summer BBQ at the park—I'll send a doodle poll.
segments.zh:
別等一年才聚。
→ 同意。 夏天公園烤肉—我發 doodle 投票。

segments.en:
I'm going vegan.
→ Cool. Salad bar's loaded—Grandma hid bacon bits, I'll warn you.
segments.zh:
我要吃素了。
→ 好。 沙拉臺很滿—外婆藏了培根碎，我會提醒。

segments.en:
Old house creaks.
→ Character. Every floorboard is a story—sleep in the back room, quieter.
segments.zh:
老房子吱呀響。
→ 有味道。 每塊地板都是一個故事—睡後間比較靜。

segments.en:
Thanks for hosting.
→ Anytime. Dishes done, feet up—you brought joy, not just pie.
segments.zh:
謝謝招待。
→ 隨時。 碗洗了腳翹了—你帶來歡樂，不只派。

segments.en:
Group photo again?
→ One more. Everyone squeeze—timer's on, no blinking.
segments.zh:
再拍一張？
→ 最後一張。 大家擠—計時了，別眨眼。

items.baseEn: I hug the aunt who always smells like cinnamon.
items.baseZh: 我擁抱總是肉桂味的阿姨。

items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。

articles.summaryZh: 求職期：履歷、面試、薪資談判與心態調整。

segments.en: I tailor each resume to the job description.
segments.zh: 我依職缺描述調整每份履歷。

segments.en: Bullet points show impact, not just duties.
segments.zh: 條列寫影響力，不只職責。

segments.en: LinkedIn open-to-work is on, but discreet.
segments.zh: LinkedIn 開放機會，但低調。

segments.en: Referrals beat cold applications every time.
segments.zh: 內推永遠勝過冷投。

segments.en: I track apps in a sheet—no ghosting surprises.
segments.zh: 投遞記在表—不被已讀不回嚇到。

segments.en: Cover letters are short—three paragraphs max.
segments.zh: 求職信要短—最多三段。

segments.en: Recruiter screens feel casual—still prep stories.
segments.zh: 人資初篩看似閒聊—仍要備故事。

segments.en: I test my mic and lighting before Zoom.
segments.zh: Zoom 前我測麥克風和光。

segments.en: Salary range early saves everyone time.
segments.zh: 早談薪資區間省大家時間。

segments.en: I ask about team size and manager style.
segments.zh: 我問團隊大小和主管風格。

segments.en: Follow-up email within twenty-four hours.
segments.zh: 二十四小時內寄感謝信。

segments.en: No offer yet—still a practice rep.
segments.zh: 還沒 offer—也是一次練習。

segments.en: I arrive ten minutes early, not thirty.
segments.zh: 我早到十分鐘，不是三十分。

segments.en: STAR stories cover conflict and wins.
segments.zh: STAR 故事涵蓋衝突與成果。

segments.en: I bring printed resumes—Wi-Fi fails happen.
segments.zh: 我帶紙本履歷—Wi-Fi 會掛。

segments.en: Questions for them show I'm serious.
segments.zh: 反問對方表示我是認真的。

segments.en: Whiteboard prompts—think aloud, not silent.
segments.zh: 白板題—出聲思考，別沉默。

segments.en: Handshake or fist bump—match their vibe.
segments.zh: 握手或碰拳—配合對方氛圍。

segments.en: I never accept on the spot—I ask for writing.
segments.zh: 我當場不答應—要書面。

segments.en: Base, bonus, equity, PTO—I line them up.
segments.zh: 本薪、獎金、股權、特休—我列清楚。

segments.en: Competing offers help if they're real.
segments.zh: 若有真 offer 可當籌碼。

segments.en: Start date flex buys relocation time.
segments.zh: 到職日可談就爭取搬家時間。

segments.en: Benefits matter when family needs coverage.
segments.zh: 要顧家庭時福利很重要。

segments.en: No is data—adjust pitch, not self-worth.
segments.zh: 拒絕是資訊—改 pitch，不改自我價值。

segments.en: Job search is a job—routine keeps me sane.
segments.zh: 求職像上班—作息讓我不崩。

segments.en: Coffee chats refill confidence between apps.
segments.zh: 咖啡閒聊在投遞空檔補信心。

segments.en: I celebrate small wins—phone screen, panel invite.
segments.zh: 小勝利也慶祝—電話面、小組面。

segments.en: Skills refresh on free courses beats doom-scrolling.
segments.zh: 免費課進修勝過 doom-scroll。

segments.en: Friends proofread; strangers on forums don't.
segments.zh: 朋友幫改稿；論壇陌生人別信。

segments.en: The right fit will feel mutual, not forced.
segments.zh: 對的 fit 會是雙向，不是硬塞。

segments.en: Any updates?
segments.zh: 有消息嗎？

segments.en: Ghosted again.
segments.zh: 又被已讀不回。

segments.en: Interview tomorrow.
segments.zh: 明天面試。

segments.en: What should I wear?
segments.zh: 該穿什麼？

segments.en: Ask for more money?
segments.zh: 要加價嗎？

segments.en: Refer me?
segments.zh: 能內推嗎？

segments.en: Recruiter called.
segments.zh: 獵頭來電。

segments.en: Panel was tough.
segments.zh: 小組面試好硬。

segments.en: Counter offer?
segments.zh: 要 counter 嗎？

segments.en: Take a break?
segments.zh: 該休息嗎？

segments.en: LinkedIn headline help?
segments.zh: 幫改 LinkedIn 標題？

segments.en: Celebrate when it lands.
segments.zh: 成了再慶祝。

segments.en:
How long have you been looking?
→ Three months. Two final rounds—pipeline's slow, not zero.
segments.zh:
找多久了？
→ 三個月。 兩家 final—流程慢，不是零。

segments.en:
You must be desperate.
→ Not really. I'm picky about manager fit—I can wait for right.
segments.zh:
你一定很急吧。
→ 還好。 我挑主管 fit—值得等對的。

segments.en:
Want me to intro you?
→ Please! I'll send a tight blurb and resume tonight.
segments.zh:
要幫你引薦嗎？
→ 拜託！ 今晚我寄精簡自介和履歷。

segments.en:
That company is toxic.
→ Good to know. I'll dig on Glassdoor and ask in the interview.
segments.zh:
那公司很 toxic。
→ 謝謝情報。 我會查 Glassdoor，面試也會問。

segments.en:
Salary they offered?
→ Lowball. I'm countering with market data and extra PTO ask.
segments.zh:
開多少薪？
→ 偏低。 我用市場數據 counter，也爭取特休。

segments.en:
Rejection email stings.
→ It does. I save one line for learning, then archive and move.
segments.zh:
拒信很刺。
→ 真的。 留一句學到什麼，然後封存往前。

segments.en:
Switch industries?
→ Maybe. Transferable skills pitch needs one killer project story.
segments.zh:
要轉行業嗎？
→ 也許。 可轉移技能要靠一個 killer 專案故事。

segments.en:
Nervous about tomorrow.
→ Normal. Sleep, water, three STAR stories on a sticky note.
segments.zh:
明天好緊張。
→ 正常。 睡飽、喝水、便利貼寫三個 STAR。

segments.en:
They want in-person.
→ Travel? Ask if they'll cover flight—many will for finals.
segments.zh:
要現場面。
→ 要出差？ 問是否報機票—很多 final 會報。

segments.en:
Got the job!
→ Yes! Start in three weeks—I'll help you negotiate if you want.
segments.zh:
拿到工作了！
→ 太好了！ 三週後報到—要談條件我可以幫。

segments.en:
Resume roast session?
→ Saturday. Bring red pen and coffee—brutal but kind feedback.
segments.zh:
履歷批評大會？
→ 週六。 帶紅筆和咖啡—狠但善意。

segments.en:
Don't give up.
→ Thanks. One yes clears a hundred nos—I'm still swinging.
segments.zh:
別放棄。
→ 謝了。 一個 yes 蓋過百個 no—我還在揮棒。
