articles.summaryZh: 聚會講怪事：鋪陳、高潮、反轉與聽眾互動。

segments.en: Okay, this actually happened—swear on my coffee.
segments.zh: 好，這真的發生—我對咖啡發誓。

segments.en: It was a Tuesday, which already feels wrong.
segments.zh: 那是週二，光聽就很不對勁。

segments.en: I was half asleep on the late bus home.
segments.zh: 我在末班公車上半睡半醒。

segments.en: Nobody talks on that route—everyone stares at phones.
segments.zh: 那條線沒人聊天—全盯手機。

segments.en: Then the driver slammed the brakes—hard.
segments.zh: 然後司機猛踩煞車。

segments.en: Something white flashed across the windshield.
segments.zh: 有白色東西閃過擋風玻璃。

segments.en: Turns out it was a grocery bag, not a ghost.
segments.zh: 結果是塑料袋，不是鬼。

segments.en: But the bag had a receipt with my name on it.
segments.zh: 但袋裡收據竟是我的名字。

segments.en: From a store I'd never been to—in another state.
segments.zh: 來自我沒去過、在別州的店。

segments.en: The date on it was tomorrow's date.
segments.zh: 上面日期是明天的日期。

segments.en: The passenger next to me hadn't blinked once.
segments.zh: 我旁邊乘客一次都沒眨眼。

segments.en: He said, quiet, 'You dropped this last week.'
segments.zh: 他小聲說：「你上週掉的。」

segments.en: I checked my pockets—same receipt, same tomorrow date.
segments.zh: 我摸口袋—同款收據、同款明天日期。

segments.en: Bus GPS showed we were nowhere on the map.
segments.zh: 公車 GPS 顯示我們在地圖沒有的地方。

segments.en: Radio static spelled my childhood nickname.
segments.zh: 收音機雜訊拼出我小時候綽號。

segments.en: I'm not into horror—I do taxes for fun.
segments.zh: 我不愛恐怖—我還覺得報稅有趣。

segments.en: Driver shrugged: 'Happens on the midnight loop.'
segments.zh: 司機聳肩：「午夜環線常這樣。」

segments.en: We rolled past my stop without opening doors.
segments.zh: 過了我站卻沒開門。

segments.en: I woke up—head on my own shoulder, drool optional.
segments.zh: 我醒來—頭靠在自己肩上，口水可有可無。

segments.en: Phone alarm: podcast episode about urban legends.
segments.zh: 鬧鐘是都市傳說播客。

segments.en: The receipt was a prop from my roommate's prank.
segments.zh: 收據是室友惡作劇道具。

segments.en: They filmed my face—I'm never living it down.
segments.zh: 他們拍我表情—這輩子洗不掉。

segments.en: Bus was normal; bag was plain trash.
segments.zh: 公車很正常；袋子就是垃圾。

segments.en: Still weird how real the dream felt.
segments.zh: 夢的真實感還是很毛。

segments.en: I tell it at parties for free drinks.
segments.zh: 我在派對講換免費酒。

segments.en: Listeners always ask if I still take that bus.
segments.zh: 聽眾總問我還搭那班嗎。

segments.en: I switched to biking—partly legs, partly vibes.
segments.zh: 我改騎車—一半運動一半氛圍。

segments.en: Roommate owes me dignity and one month rent.
segments.zh: 室友欠我尊嚴加一個月房租。

segments.en: Truth is stranger, but pranks pay rent.
segments.zh: 真相更怪，但惡作劇能交租。

segments.en: Your turn—top that with something weirder.
segments.zh: 輪到你—講更怪的壓過我。

segments.en: No way.
segments.zh: 少來。

segments.en: Keep going.
segments.zh: 繼續講。

segments.en: You're lying.
segments.zh: 你瞎掰。

segments.en: What happened next?
segments.zh: 然後呢？

segments.en: That's creepy.
segments.zh: 好毛。

segments.en: I got goosebumps.
segments.zh: 我雞皮疙瘩。

segments.en: Punchline?
segments.zh: 包袱呢？

segments.en: Drink sip for that.
segments.zh: 這杯要喝一口。

segments.en: Same bus route?
segments.zh: 同一路線？

segments.en: Film the prank?
segments.zh: 有拍嗎？

segments.en: I have one weirder.
segments.zh: 我有更怪的。

segments.en: Don't tell Mom.
segments.zh: 別跟媽說。

segments.en:
I don't believe a word.
→ Fair. Roommate's video is on my phone—password after one beer.
segments.zh:
我一句都不信。
→ 合理。 室友影片在我手機—一杯酒後給密碼。

segments.en:
Was anyone hurt?
→ Nope. Only my pride and maybe the bus driver's patience.
segments.zh:
有人受傷嗎？
→ 沒有。 只有我的自尊，也許還有司機耐心。

segments.en:
Urban legend copycat?
→ Maybe. Podcast plus prank—perfect storm of dumb.
segments.zh:
抄都市傳說？
→ 也許。 播客加惡作劇— dumb 完美風暴。

segments.en:
You looked scared though.
→ I was! Dream logic hits different at two a.m. on a bus.
segments.zh:
但你看起來真嚇到。
→ 我是！ 凌晨兩點在公車上，夢邏輯特別真。

segments.en:
Tell it shorter next time.
→ Noted. Short version: bag, receipt, roommate jerk, bike now.
segments.zh:
下次講短點。
→ 收到。 短版：袋、收據、室友混蛋、現在騎車。

segments.en:
I'd have run off the bus.
→ Same. Doors wouldn't open in the dream—that's the worst part.
segments.zh:
我會跳車。
→ 一樣。 夢裡門不開—那才是最糟。

segments.en:
Any moral?
→ Sleep more. And lock your door when roommates buy fake receipts.
segments.zh:
有寓意嗎？
→ 多睡。 室友買假收據時記得鎖門。

segments.en:
Post the video!
→ Never. HR follows me—nice try.
segments.zh:
影片 PO 出來！
→ 不要。 HR 追蹤我—想美。

segments.en:
Midnight loop real?
→ Driver bit. He was in on the joke—bus friend of my roommate.
segments.zh:
午夜環線真的？
→ 司機那句。 他串通—是我室友的公車朋友。

segments.en:
Best story tonight.
→ Thanks! Wait till you hear about the pigeon and the DMV.
segments.zh:
今晚最佳故事。
→ 謝啦！ 等你聽鴿子和 DMV 那集。

segments.en:
Kids still awake?
→ Oops. Switching to the silly ending—prop receipt, big laugh.
segments.zh:
小孩還醒著？
→ 糟。 改講搞笑結局—假收據、大笑。

segments.en:
One more round?
→ Sure. I'll trade you subway rat saga for your haunted elevator.
segments.zh:
再一輪？
→ 好。 地鐵鼠 saga 換你 haunted 電梯。

articles.summaryZh: 愛書人的日常：選書、閱讀習慣、書評閒聊與床邊書堆。

segments.en: I go in for one book and leave with a tote full.
segments.zh: 本來買一本，提袋滿載而出。

segments.en: Staff picks beat algorithm lists for me.
segments.zh: 店員推薦勝過演算法清單。

segments.en: I read the first page standing in the aisle.
segments.zh: 我站在走道讀第一頁。

segments.en: Used bookstores smell like old paper and luck.
segments.zh: 二手書店像舊紙和運氣的味道。

segments.en: Book club picks rotate who chooses the title.
segments.zh: 讀書會輪流選書。

segments.en: Library holds mean patience and good surprises.
segments.zh: 圖書館預約靠耐心，常有驚喜。

segments.en: Twenty pages before phone—that's my rule.
segments.zh: 先看二十頁才能碰手機—我的規矩。

segments.en: Tea, blanket, lamp—triangle of focus.
segments.zh: 茶、毯、檯燈—專注三角。

segments.en: I dog-ear sparingly; sticky notes for quotes.
segments.zh: 少折角；名言用便條。

segments.en: Audiobooks on walks count; I won't gatekeep.
segments.zh: 走路聽書也算；我不 gatekeep。

segments.en: Kindle at night; hardcover on Sundays.
segments.zh: 晚上 Kindle；週日精裝。

segments.en: If a chapter drags, I skim with permission.
segments.zh: 章節拖就允許自己略讀。

segments.en: Mystery for commute, literary fiction for soul.
segments.zh: 通勤推理，文學小說養魂。

segments.en: Nonfiction dates fast—I check the year.
segments.zh: 非虛構易過時—我看出版年。

segments.en: DNF guilt fades when life is busy.
segments.zh: 生活忙時，棄書罪惡感會淡。

segments.en: Re-reads reveal lines I wasn't ready for.
segments.zh: 重讀會看見當年沒準備好的句子。

segments.en: Translated work needs trust in the translator.
segments.zh: 譯本要相信譯者。

segments.en: I mix bestsellers with small-press gems.
segments.zh: 暢銷和小社精品我混著讀。

segments.en: Spoiler alerts before chapter ten discussions.
segments.zh: 第十章前先喊劇透。

segments.en: Hot takes welcome; mean takes stay home.
segments.zh: 辣評歡迎；惡意留在家。

segments.en: I lend books I can bear to lose.
segments.zh: 我只借還得起丟的書。

segments.en: Goodreads updates when I remember, not daily.
segments.zh: Goodreads 想才更新，不每日。

segments.en: Author events mean long lines and shaky signatures.
segments.zh: 簽書會排隊長、簽名抖。

segments.en: Disagreeing on endings keeps friendships honest.
segments.zh: 結局合不來也讓友情誠實。

segments.en: Nightstand stack wobbles—three books, one journal.
segments.zh: 床頭書堆搖晃—三本書一本日誌。

segments.en: One chapter turns into 'just thirty more minutes.'
segments.zh: 讀一章變「再三十分鐘」。

segments.en: I fall asleep mid-page; bookmark saves the spot.
segments.zh: 讀到睡著；書籤救進度。

segments.en: Morning light makes last night's plot clearer.
segments.zh: 晨光讓昨晚情節更清楚。

segments.en: Return library books before fines breed shame.
segments.zh: 罰金長出羞恥前先還書。

segments.en: Next up already whispers from the shelf.
segments.zh: 下一本已在書架低語。

segments.en: What are you reading?
segments.zh: 你在讀什麼？

segments.en: Any good?
segments.zh: 好看嗎？

segments.en: Too slow for me.
segments.zh: 對我來說太慢。

segments.en: No spoilers!
segments.zh: 別劇透！

segments.en: Audiobook counts?
segments.zh: 聽書算嗎？

segments.en: Recommend something.
segments.zh: 推一本。

segments.en: DNF at page fifty.
segments.zh: 五十頁棄了。

segments.en: Book club this week?
segments.zh: 這週讀書會？

segments.en: Signed copy!
segments.zh: 簽名版！

segments.en: E-reader or paper?
segments.zh: 電子還紙本？

segments.en: Library fine again.
segments.zh: 又圖書館罰金。

segments.en: Swap books?
segments.zh: 換書看？

segments.en:
I don't have time to read.
→ Ten minutes. Audio in the car or before sleep—pages add up.
segments.zh:
我沒時間讀書。
→ 十分鐘。 開車或睡前聽—頁數會累積。

segments.en:
That ending ruined it.
→ Oof. Middle still slaps—want my notes on chapter twelve?
segments.zh:
結局毀了全書。
→ 唉。 中段仍精彩—要看我第十二章筆記嗎？

segments.en:
Movie or book first?
→ Book. Always book—film is dessert, not meal.
segments.zh:
先看電影還是書？
→ 書。 永遠先書—電影是甜點不是正餐。

segments.en:
Your taste is weird.
→ Thanks! I like quiet sci-fi and angry memoirs—balance.
segments.zh:
你品味好怪。
→ 謝啦！ 我愛慢 sci-fi 和憤怒回憶錄—平衡。

segments.en:
Borrow your copy?
→ Sure. Return by month end—coffee stain is character.
segments.zh:
借你的 copy？
→ 好。 月底前還—咖啡漬是 character。

segments.en:
Is the hype real?
→ Mostly. Skip the middle essay—start chapter three.
segments.zh:
hype 是真的嗎？
→ 多半。 跳過中間論述—從第三章開始。

segments.en:
Reading slump here.
→ Same. Pick a slim paperback—momentum beats guilt.
segments.zh:
我閱讀低潮。
→ 一樣。 選薄 paperback—動能勝過罪惡感。

segments.en:
Kids only want screens.
→ Trick. Graphic novels at bedtime—door opens to prose.
segments.zh:
小孩只要螢幕。
→ 招數。 睡前圖文書—門會開向散文。

segments.en:
Translate this title?
→ Loosely. English edition title differs—check both covers online.
segments.zh:
這書名怎麼翻？
→ 意譯。 英版書名不同—上網比兩種封面。

segments.en:
Bookstore closing hurts.
→ Yeah. I buy one full-price there each month—small vote.
segments.zh:
書店關門好難過。
→ 是啊。 我每月在那買一本原價—小投票。

segments.en:
Highlight every line?
→ Guilty. Only buy copies I own—library gets sticky notes.
segments.zh:
每行都畫線？
→  guilty。 只畫自己買的—圖書館用便條。

segments.en:
Read together sometime?
→ Yes. Same book, weekly voice memo chapter recap—low pressure.
segments.zh:
改天一起讀？
→ 好。 同書、每週語音 recap 一章—低壓力。

items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。
items.baseEn: Return library books before fines breed shame.
items.baseZh: 罰金長出羞恥前先還書。

articles.summaryZh: 聊電影與影集：院線、串流、劇透規則與推薦清單。

segments.en: Friday night means trailers and overpriced popcorn.
segments.zh: 週五晚就是預告片和貴爆米花。

segments.en: We argue IMAX versus comfy recliner seats.
segments.zh: 我們爭 IMAX 還是躺椅廳。

segments.en: Streaming queue grows faster than we watch.
segments.zh: 待看清單長得比看得快。

segments.en: I check runtime before committing—two hours max.
segments.zh: 開看前先看片長—最多兩小時。

segments.en: Subtitles on; neighbors don't need explosions at full blast.
segments.zh: 開字幕；鄰居不必聽滿音量爆炸。

segments.en: Midnight release once a year—worth the yawns.
segments.zh: 一年一次午夜場—值得打哈欠。

segments.en: Phone glow during the scene—instant side-eye.
segments.zh: 關鍵戲手機亮—立刻白眼。

segments.en: Credit stingers mean stay seated, trust me.
segments.zh: 片尾彩蛋要留座—信我。

segments.en: Dolby sound makes dialogue muddy sometimes.
segments.zh: 杜比音效有時對白糊成一片。

segments.en: We sneak in candy; soda stays bought.
segments.zh: 糖果偷帶；汽水還是買。

segments.en: Empty Tuesday shows feel like private screenings.
segments.zh: 週二空場像私人放映。

segments.en: Walk out rare—sunk cost and curiosity.
segments.zh: 很少中途離場—沉沒成本和好奇心。

segments.en: One more episode lies—we know the truth.
segments.zh: 「再看一集」是謊—我們都懂。

segments.en: Season drops mean a lost weekend, happily.
segments.zh: 整季上架等於愉快消失的週末。

segments.en: Recap episodes save friends who jumped in late.
segments.zh: 前情提要救晚加入的朋友。

segments.en: Fan theories beat work emails on group chats.
segments.zh: 同好理論在群組勝過工作信。

segments.en: Finale parties need spoiler shields at the door.
segments.zh: finale 派對門口要防劇透。

segments.en: Cancel culture for shows—one bad season, maybe pause.
segments.zh: 爛季先暫停，不一定棄劇。

segments.en: Rotten scores guide me, not rule me.
segments.zh: 爛番茄參考，不綁架我。

segments.en: Comfort rewatches beat chasing every hype.
segments.zh: comfort 重看勝過追每個 hype。

segments.en: Acting can save a weak script—sometimes.
segments.zh: 好演技偶爾能救爛劇本。

segments.en: CGI age shows; practical effects still hit.
segments.zh: CGI 會過時；實景特效仍過癮。

segments.en: Foreign films need patience and good subs.
segments.zh: 外語片要耐心和好字幕。

segments.en: Hot takes at dinner—pass the salt and opinions.
segments.zh: 晚餐辣評—傳鹽也傳意見。

segments.en: I pitch three titles based on your mood, not mine.
segments.zh: 我依你心情推三部，不是依我。

segments.en: Podcast deep dives spoil less than YouTube clips.
segments.zh: 播客深聊比 YouTube 短片少劇透。

segments.en: Letterboxd logs shame me into watching classics.
segments.zh: Letterboxd 記錄逼我看經典。

segments.en: Cosplay optional; quoting lines is mandatory.
segments.zh: Cosplay 隨意；背臺詞 mandatory。

segments.en: Sequels rarely top the original—exceptions exist.
segments.zh: 續集很少贏前作—有例外。

segments.en: See you at the next premiere—or on the couch.
segments.zh: 下個首映見—或在沙發見。

segments.en: Seen the new one?
segments.zh: 新的看了嗎？

segments.en: No spoilers!
segments.zh: 別劇透！

segments.en: Theater or wait?
segments.zh: 院線還是等？

segments.en: That plot hole though.
segments.zh: 那漏洞啊。

segments.en: Cried at the end.
segments.zh: 結尾哭了。

segments.en: Skip the sequel.
segments.zh: 續集跳過。

segments.en: Who's the villain?
segments.zh: 反派是誰？

segments.en: Too long.
segments.zh: 太長了。

segments.en: Soundtrack slaps.
segments.zh: 原聲帶超讚。

segments.en: Binge tonight?
segments.zh: 今晚 binge？

segments.en: What's on Netflix?
segments.zh: Netflix 有什麼？

segments.en: Post-credits scene?
segments.zh: 有彩蛋嗎？

segments.en:
Is it worth the hype?
→ Mostly. Go for visuals; story's fine if you lower expectations.
segments.zh:
值得那 hype 嗎？
→ 多半。 衝視覺；期待降一點故事就 ok。

segments.en:
I fell asleep.
→ Fair. Pace is slow—try the director's earlier short film first.
segments.zh:
我看到睡著。
→ 合理。 節奏慢—先看導演早期短片。

segments.en:
Book was better.
→ Classic. Movie changed the ending—read chapter nineteen for truth.
segments.zh:
書比較好。
→ 經典臺詞。 電影改結局—第十九章才是真相。

segments.en:
Recommend like me?
→ Got it. Cozy mystery, no gore, under ninety minutes—sending three links.
segments.zh:
依我口味推？
→ 懂。 溫馨推理、無血腥、九十分鐘內—傳三連結。

segments.en:
Kids okay for this?
→ PG-13 edge. One jump scare; language mild—your call on bedtime.
segments.zh:
小孩能看嗎？
→ PG-13 邊緣。 一次 jump scare；語言 mild— bedtime 你決定。

segments.en:
Actor carried the film.
→ Agreed. Script wobbles but their monologue scene is Oscar bait.
segments.zh:
演員撐起全片。
→ 同意。 劇本晃但獨白場是 Oscar bait。

segments.en:
Unsub that service?
→ Maybe rotate. One month each—catch flagship shows then cancel.
segments.zh:
該退訂那平臺？
→ 輪流吧。 每月換—追旗艦劇就退。

segments.en:
Fan service overload.
→ Yep. Studio played safe—indie sequel might take risks.
segments.zh:
fan service 過量。
→ 對。 片商保守— indie 續集可能敢賭。

segments.en:
Date night pick?
→ Rom-com. Light, funny, no sad dog deaths—trust the list.
segments.zh:
約會片？
→ 浪漫喜劇。 輕鬆好笑、沒狗死—信清單。

segments.en:
Rewatch club?
→ Monthly. Same film, new snacks, argue new details every time.
segments.zh:
重看俱樂部？
→ 每月。 同片、新零食、每次爭新細節。

segments.en:
Subtitles or dub?
→ Subs. Performance lives in the voice—dubs flatten jokes.
segments.zh:
字幕還是配音？
→ 字幕。 演技在聲音—配音 flatten 笑點。

segments.en:
Next movie night when?
→ Saturday. You pick stream; I'll bring popcorn and veto horror.
segments.zh:
下次電影夜何時？
→ 週六。 你選片；我帶爆米花並 veto 恐怖片。

articles.summaryZh: 小店長視角：開店、出杯、客情與庫存。

segments.en: I'm in at five thirty to dial in the espresso.
segments.zh: 五半進店調 espresso。

segments.en: Steam wand gets purged before the first customer.
segments.zh: 第一位客人前先 purge 蒸汽棒。

segments.en: Pastries arrive still warm from the bakery.
segments.zh: 烘焙坊送來的 pastry 還溫。

segments.en: I count the till and log yesterday's tips.
segments.zh: 我點收銀並記昨天小費。

segments.en: Playlist low—morning folks want calm, not bass.
segments.zh: 歌單小聲—早上要 calm 不要重低音。

segments.en: Chalkboard special: oat latte, orange peel.
segments.zh: 黑板特飲：燕麥拿鐵加橙皮。

segments.en: Line out the door by eight fifteen.
segments.zh: 八點十五門外就排隊。

segments.en: I call drinks loud; names blur together.
segments.zh: 我大聲叫飲料；名字糊在一起。

segments.en: Two baristas, one on register, one on milk.
segments.zh: 兩 barista—一收銀一打奶。

segments.en: Rush mistakes happen—remake with a smile.
segments.zh: 高峰會錯—笑著重做。

segments.en: Mobile orders ping like a video game.
segments.zh: 手機訂單 ping 像電玩。

segments.en: Regulars get their cup before they reach the counter.
segments.zh: 老客還沒到櫃臺杯就好了。

segments.en: Laptop campers buy refills—I appreciate that.
segments.zh: 筆電久座會續杯—我感激。

segments.en: Kids' hot chocolate gets extra whip, no charge.
segments.zh: 小孩熱可可多鮮奶油不收費。

segments.en: We dim lights after lunch for softer vibe.
segments.zh: 午餐後調暗燈，氛圍柔一點。

segments.en: Local art rotates monthly on the brick wall.
segments.zh: 磚牆本地藝術每月換。

segments.en: Complaints about Wi-Fi—I reboot, then apologize.
segments.zh: Wi-Fi 抱怨—重啟再道歉。

segments.en: Tip jar splits fair with the closing crew.
segments.zh: 小費罐公平分給打烊班。

segments.en: Milk delivery twice a week—never run out oat.
segments.zh: 鮮奶週送兩次—燕麥不能斷。

segments.en: Bean prices jumped; I tweaked the menu, not quality.
segments.zh: 豆價漲；我改菜單不改質。

segments.en: Waste log tracks tossed pastries honestly.
segments.zh: 報廢記錄老實記丟掉的 pastry。

segments.en: Health inspection stars stay on the fridge door.
segments.zh: 衛生檢查星級貼冰箱門。

segments.en: Small batch roaster next town—relationship matters.
segments.zh: 下個鎮小批烘焙—關係很重要。

segments.en: Slow hour prep: syrups, labels, deep clean gaskets.
segments.zh: 離峰備料：糖漿、標籤、深洗墊圈。

segments.en: Last call for hot drinks at eight forty-five.
segments.zh: 八點四十五最後熱飲。

segments.en: Grinders get brushed; floors mopped sticky.
segments.zh: 磨豆機刷淨；地拖到不黏。

segments.en: Tomorrow's opener gets a sticky note summary.
segments.zh: 明天早班有便利貼摘要。

segments.en: I lock up and smell like espresso—that's perfume.
segments.zh: 關店我一身 espresso 味—那就是香水。

segments.en: Weekend rush means hiring one more part-time.
segments.zh: 週末高峰要再僱兼職。

segments.en: Community board fills with flyers and gratitude.
segments.zh: 佈告欄貼滿傳單和感謝。

segments.en: Room for milk?
segments.zh: 還有空間加奶嗎？

segments.en: Extra shot, please.
segments.zh: 請加一份 shot。

segments.en: Oat or almond?
segments.zh: 燕麥還杏仁？

segments.en: Wi-Fi password?
segments.zh: Wi-Fi 密碼？

segments.en: Pastries fresh?
segments.zh: 糕點新鮮嗎？

segments.en: Closing soon?
segments.zh: 快打烊了嗎？

segments.en: Line's long today.
segments.zh: 今天隊好長。

segments.en: New seasonal drink?
segments.zh: 新 seasonal？

segments.en: Can I work here?
segments.zh: 能在這辦公嗎？

segments.en: Love this playlist.
segments.zh: 歌單贊。

segments.en: Tip the baristas.
segments.zh: 記得給小費。

segments.en: See you tomorrow.
segments.zh: 明天見。

segments.en:
This latte art is insane.
→ Thanks! Practice cups after close—swans for regulars only.
segments.zh:
拉花太狂了。
→ 謝謝！ 打烊後練習杯—天鵝只給老客。

segments.en:
Too loud in here.
→ Sorry. Morning rush peaks at nine—quieter after ten.
segments.zh:
這裡太吵。
→ 抱歉。 早高峰九點—十點後會靜。

segments.en:
Wrong drink.
→ My bad. Remaking now—keep the miss; pastry on me.
segments.zh:
飲料錯了。
→ 我的錯。 馬上重做—錯的留下；pastry 我請。

segments.en:
Do you roast in-house?
→ Not yet. Partner roaster two miles east—tour if you ask.
segments.zh:
店內烘焙嗎？
→ 還沒有。 東邊兩英里合作烘焙—要問可參觀。

segments.en:
Hiring?
→ Maybe. Drop resume mornings slow—barista trial shift standard.
segments.zh:
招人嗎？
→ 也許。 離峰早上投履歷—試班是常態。

segments.en:
Best pastry here?
→ Almond croissant. Sells out by ten—set a reminder on your phone.
segments.zh:
必點糕點？
→ 杏仁可頌。 十點前售罄—手機設提醒。

segments.en:
Can you make it less sweet?
→ Sure. Half syrup default—say 'barely sweet' next time.
segments.zh:
能少甜嗎？
→ 可以。 默認半糖—下次說 barely sweet。

segments.en:
Love the neighborhood vibe.
→ Same. We host open mic Thursdays—poems and soft heckling.
segments.zh:
愛這區氛圍。
→ 我也是。 週四 open mic—詩加溫柔起鬨。

segments.en:
Prices went up?
→ Beans did. Fifty cents—still refills on drip for sit-in.
segments.zh:
漲價了？
→ 豆漲了。 漲五毛—內用 drip 仍續杯。

segments.en:
Out of decaf again.
→ Tonight. Afternoon pour-over with half-caf workaround till then.
segments.zh:
低因又沒了嗎？
→ 今晚補。 下午手衝半因頂替。

segments.en:
Can we reserve tables?
→ Walk-in. Groups six plus—email us, we'll shuffle chairs.
segments.zh:
能訂位嗎？
→ 現場。 六人以上—寫信來，我們挪椅子。

segments.en:
See you at the holiday blend launch.
→ Count on it. Tasting flight Saturday—first twenty get a mug.
segments.zh:
節日 blend 發佈見？
→ 一定。 週六試飲 flight—前二十名送馬克杯。

items.baseEn: Milk delivery twice a week—never run out oat.
items.baseZh: 鮮奶週送兩次—燕麥不能斷。

items.noteZh: 固定骨架，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞。

items.baseZh: 下個鎮小批烘焙—關係很重要。

items.baseZh: 明天早班有便利貼摘要。

articles.summaryZh: 健身房與居家訓練：暖身、組數、恢復與習慣維持。

segments.en: Gym bag packed the night before—no excuses.
segments.zh: 前一晚打包健身袋—沒藉口。

segments.en: I eat a banana, not a burger, pre-workout.
segments.zh: 運動前吃香蕉，不是漢堡。

segments.en: Water bottle full; phone on do-not-disturb.
segments.zh: 水瓶滿；手機勿擾。

segments.en: Plan says legs—I'm not skipping again.
segments.zh: 課表是腿日—這次不跳。

segments.en: New shoes broke in; blisters taught me.
segments.zh: 新鞋已磨合；水泡教過我。

segments.en: Five-minute walk warms joints before weights.
segments.zh: 舉鐵前先走五分鐘暖關節。

segments.en: Warm-up sets aren't ego—protect your back.
segments.zh: 熱身組不是炫—保護腰。

segments.en: I track reps in an app, not memory.
segments.zh: 組數記 app，不靠記憶。

segments.en: Rest ninety seconds—phone timer, not scrolling.
segments.zh: 休九十秒—用計時器不滑手機。

segments.en: Form beats weight when the bar wobbles.
segments.zh: 槓晃就降重量顧動作。

segments.en: Ask for a spot on bench—pride costs ribs.
segments.zh: 臥推要保護—面子換肋骨不划算。

segments.en: Finish with ten minutes cardio, not zero.
segments.zh: 收尾十分鐘有氧，不要零。

segments.en: Progressive overload—small jumps, steady wins.
segments.zh: 漸進超負荷—小加、穩贏。

segments.en: Deload week every sixth—joints say thanks.
segments.zh: 每六週減載—關節會謝。

segments.en: Plateaus mean sleep or protein, not new gimmicks.
segments.zh: 卡關看睡眠或蛋白，不是新花招。

segments.en: Group class Fridays for accountability fun.
segments.zh: 週五團課當社交責任。

segments.en: Home bands travel—hotel workouts happen.
segments.zh: 彈力帶旅行—飯店也能練。

segments.en: Photos monthly, not daily—trends matter.
segments.zh: 每月拍照不每日—看趨勢。

segments.en: Stretch ten minutes—boring, effective.
segments.zh: 拉伸十分鐘—無聊但有效。

segments.en: Protein within an hour when I remember.
segments.zh: 記得的話一小時內補蛋白。

segments.en: Sleep seven hours or DOMS owns me.
segments.zh: 睡七小時不然 DOMS 主宰我。

segments.en: Foam roller hurts so good on quads.
segments.zh: 泡沫軸滾大腿又痛又爽。

segments.en: Rest days are training days for recovery.
segments.zh: 休息日也是恢復的訓練日。

segments.en: Hydration check: pee pale, not neon.
segments.zh: hydration 看尿色淡，別熒光。

segments.en: Consistency beats perfect months.
segments.zh: 規律勝過完美的一個月。

segments.en: Compare you to you from last year.
segments.zh: 和去年的自己比。

segments.en: Injury means modify, not quit forever.
segments.zh: 受傷就改動作，不是永退。

segments.en: Gym friends cheer PRs and bad days.
segments.zh: gym 朋友為 PR 也為爛日加油。

segments.en: I schedule workouts like meetings—non-negotiable.
segments.zh: 把訓練排像會議—不可退。

segments.en: Stronger body, calmer head—that's the deal.
segments.zh: 身體更強、腦更 calm—這是交易。

segments.en: Leg day?
segments.zh: 腿日？

segments.en: Need a spot?
segments.zh: 要保護嗎？

segments.en: Machine free?
segments.zh: 器械空嗎？

segments.en: Good set!
segments.zh: 這組漂亮！

segments.en: Wiped out.
segments.zh: 累癱了。

segments.en: Protein shake?
segments.zh: 蛋白飲？

segments.en: New PR!
segments.zh: 新 PR！

segments.en: Skipping cardio.
segments.zh: 有氧跳過。

segments.en: Gym crowded.
segments.zh: 人超多。

segments.en: Form check?
segments.zh: 幫看動作？

segments.en: Rest day guilt.
segments.zh: 休息日罪惡感。

segments.en: Same time tomorrow?
segments.zh: 明天同時？

segments.en:
I never stick with it.
→ Start tiny. Two days a week locked—add third only when boring.
segments.zh:
我從來堅持不下去。
→ 從極小開始。 先鎖兩天—無聊再加第三。

segments.en:
Sore every day.
→ Maybe too much. Alternate hard and easy—sleep is the secret set.
segments.zh:
每天 sore。
→ 可能過量。 強弱交替—睡眠是秘密組。

segments.en:
Weights intimidate me.
→ Normal. Beginner area plus one coach question—most folks help.
segments.zh:
重量區嚇人。
→ 正常。 新手區加問教練—多半人會幫。

segments.en:
Diet ruined my week.
→ Reset. One meal isn't a season—next meal protein and veg.
segments.zh:
飲食毀了一週。
→ 重置。 一餐不是一季—下一餐蛋白加菜。

segments.en:
Home or gym?
→ Both. Gym for heavy; bands at home on busy days.
segments.zh:
家練還是館？
→ 都行。 大重量去館；忙日用在家彈力帶。

segments.en:
You look different.
→ Thanks! Mostly posture and sleep—scale barely moved.
segments.zh:
你看起來不一樣。
→ 謝啦！ 多半是姿勢和睡眠—體重幾乎沒變。

segments.en:
Running or lifting?
→ Both. Lift base, run for heart—don't skip either long.
segments.zh:
跑還是舉？
→ 都做。 舉為基礎、跑顧心—長期別偏廢。

segments.en:
Injury scare.
→ Rest. PT eval beats Dr. Google—book one visit.
segments.zh:
嚇到受傷。
→ 休息。 物理治療評估勝 Google—約一次。

segments.en:
Class was brutal.
→ Worth it? If you can talk tomorrow, schedule another—adaptation.
segments.zh:
團課超狠。
→ 值得嗎？ 明天還能說話就再約—適應。

segments.en:
Supplements needed?
→ Basics first. Food, sleep, water—creatine maybe after habits stick.
segments.zh:
要補劑嗎？
→ 先基礎。 吃睡喝—習慣穩了再考慮 creatine。

segments.en:
Workout buddy?
→ Yes. Tues-thurs six a.m.—we shame each other kindly.
segments.zh:
一起練？
→ 好。 週二四早六—善意互相催。

segments.en:
Motivation low.
→ Show up. Ten-minute rule—if still tired, leave guilt-free.
segments.zh:
動力低。
→ 人到了就行。 十分鐘規則—還累就 guilt-free 離開。

articles.summaryZh: 聊新裝置：開箱、規格、日常體驗與值不值得買。

segments.en: Box smells like fresh plastic and promises.
segments.zh: 盒子是塑料味加承諾。

segments.en: I film unboxing once, then live with it a week.
segments.zh: 開箱拍一次，然後真實用一週。

segments.en: Peel the screen film slow—ASMR optional.
segments.zh: 撕膜慢慢來—ASMR 隨意。

segments.en: Charger in box or not—first complaint logged.
segments.zh: 盒內有沒有充電器—先記一筆。

segments.en: Setup wizard asks too many permissions.
segments.zh: 設置嚮導要太多權限。

segments.en: First boot feels fast till updates queue.
segments.zh: 首次開機快，直到更新排隊。

segments.en: Battery day-one lies; week-two tells truth.
segments.zh: 首日續航會騙；第二週才真。

segments.en: Camera great in daylight, mushy at bar night.
segments.zh: 白天相機強，酒吧夜糊。

segments.en: Keyboard travel matters if you write for work.
segments.zh: 要寫工作就看鍵程。

segments.en: Fans spin like jet engines under load.
segments.zh: 負載時風扇像噴氣機。

segments.en: Biometrics fail with wet hands—passcode wins.
segments.zh: 溼手生物識別失敗—密碼贏。

segments.en: Ecosystem lock-in sneaks up after month three.
segments.zh: 第三個月生態綁架才浮現。

segments.en: Benchmarks flex; real apps tell my story.
segments.zh: 跑分炫耀；真實 app 說我的故事。

segments.en: RAM sweet spot moved—sixteen feels minimum now.
segments.zh: RAM 甜點變了—16G 像底線。

segments.en: I compare last year's model for honest value.
segments.zh: 我和去年型號比才誠實。

segments.en: Repairability score influences my buy now.
segments.zh: 可維修分現在影響我買不買。

segments.en: USB-C finally—cable drawer still chaos.
segments.zh: 終於 USB-C—線抽屜還是亂。

segments.en: AI features demo well, confuse daily tasks.
segments.zh: AI 功能 demo 亮，日常反而懵。

segments.en: I disclose free review units every time.
segments.zh: 評測樣機我每次都聲明。

segments.en: Comments want cheaper—market sets the floor.
segments.zh: 留言要更便宜—市場有底價。

segments.en: Long-term series beats hot take day one.
segments.zh: 長期系列勝首日辣評。

segments.en: B-roll of coffee cups—creator cliché, still works.
segments.zh: 咖啡 B-roll—老梗但有效。

segments.en: Thumbnails honest; no fake shocked face.
segments.zh: 縮圖誠實—不裝震驚臉。

segments.en: Affiliate links labeled—trust is the product.
segments.zh: 聯盟鏈結標註—信任才是產品。

segments.en: Upgrade if your pain is daily, not imaginary.
segments.zh: 每日痛點才升級，不是幻想。

segments.en: Wait for sale season unless work depends on it.
segments.zh: 除非工作靠它，否則等特價季。

segments.en: Refurb with warranty beats panic retail.
segments.zh: 保固翻新勝衝動原價。

segments.en: Trade-in value drops after keynote—timing hurts.
segments.zh: 發佈會後折抵跌—時機很痛。

segments.en: Keep old phone as backup—peace of mind cheap.
segments.zh: 舊機當備援—安心便宜。

segments.en: Next year rumor cycle starts before I finish this.
segments.zh: 還沒評完明年謠言循環已開始。

segments.en: Worth upgrading?
segments.zh: 值得升級嗎？

segments.en: iOS or Android?
segments.zh: iOS 還是 Android？

segments.en: Battery dying.
segments.zh: 電池快死了。

segments.en: Overhyped.
segments.zh: 吹過頭。

segments.en: Send the link.
segments.zh: 傳鏈接。

segments.en: Laggy after update.
segments.zh: 更新後卡。

segments.en: Camera enough?
segments.zh: 相機夠嗎？

segments.en: Student discount?
segments.zh: 學生價？

segments.en: Lost my charger.
segments.zh: 充電器丟了。

segments.en: Foldable fragile?
segments.zh: 摺疊脆嗎？

segments.en: Privacy worries.
segments.zh: 隱私擔心。

segments.en: Wait for M4?
segments.zh: 等 M4？

segments.en:
You get paid to hype this?
→ Disclosed. Loaner returned in thirty days—I bought my daily driver myself.
segments.zh:
廠商付錢讓你吹？
→ 有標註。 樣機三十天歸還—日常機我自己買。

segments.en:
My phone is fine.
→ Then wait. If battery and storage breathe, upgrades are vanity.
segments.zh:
我手機還好。
→ 那就等。 電池和容量還夠用，升級多是虛榮。

segments.en:
Which laptop for college?
→ Light, long battery. Fourteen-inch, sixteen gigs RAM, don’t cheap out on storage.
segments.zh:
大學用哪臺筆電？
→ 輕、續航長。 14 吋、16G RAM、存儲別省。

segments.en:
Gaming rig overkill?
→ Maybe. Match GPU to monitor refresh—4090 on 1080p is comedy.
segments.zh:
電競機過度？
→ 也許。 GPU 配螢幕刷新—4090 配 1080p 是笑話。

segments.en:
Smartwatch actually useful?
→ For health. Sleep and heart trends—not every notification needs wrist.
segments.zh:
智能表真有用？
→ 健康方面。 睡眠和心率趨勢—不是每個通知都要上腕。

segments.en:
Hate the new port.
→ Adapters. One dongle in bag till everything catches up in two years.
segments.zh:
討厭新接口。
→ 轉接頭。 包裡一個 dongle，等兩年生態跟上。

segments.en:
Subscribe or buy?
→ Buy if core. Rent creative suites; own tools you need offline.
segments.zh:
訂閱還是買斷？
→ 核心就買斷。 創意套件租；離線必備就買。

segments.en:
AI on device gimmick?
→ Early. Summarize mail helps; photo erase still weird edges.
segments.zh:
端側 AI 噱頭？
→ 還早。 摘要郵件有用；消除照片邊緣還怪。

segments.en:
Repair shop quoted high.
→ Ouch. Compare authorized versus indie—screen swaps vary a lot.
segments.zh:
維修報價好高。
→ 痛。 原廠和獨立店比—換屏價差大。

segments.en:
Kids tablet pick?
→ Rugged case. Parental controls and cheap model— they'll drop it weekly.
segments.zh:
小孩平板選啥？
→ 防摔殼。 家長鎖加便宜款—他們每週會摔。

segments.en:
Your setup tour?
→ Soon. Cable management first—video after Velcro sins are hidden.
segments.zh:
桌設 tour？
→  soon。 先理線—魔術貼藏好再拍。

segments.en:
Black Friday wait?
→ Usually. Track price history—some 'sales' are flat lies.
segments.zh:
等黑五？
→ 通常。 看歷史價—有些「特價」是 flat lie。

articles.summaryZh: 日常永續：減廢、交通、能源與社區行動。

segments.en: I keep tote bags in the car trunk—always.
segments.zh: 我後車廂永遠放環保袋。

segments.en: Bulk bins cut packaging if I plan meals.
segments.zh: 散裝桶能減包裝—要先規劃餐。

segments.en: Recycling rules change—city app stays updated.
segments.zh: 回收規則會變—市府 app 保持更新。

segments.en: Compost bucket lives under the sink, lid tight.
segments.zh: 堆肥桶在水槽下，蓋要緊。

segments.en: I rinse jars; contamination ruins a whole batch.
segments.zh: 我洗罐；汙染會毀整批。

segments.en: Refill shop for soap—one bottle for years.
segments.zh: 皂液補充站—一瓶用多年。

segments.en: Bike commute twice a week when weather allows.
segments.zh: 天氣允許每週騎車通勤兩次。

segments.en: Transit pass beats gas plus parking stress.
segments.zh: 月票勝過油錢加停車壓力。

segments.en: Carpool signup at work splits costs and emissions.
segments.zh: 公司共乘登記分成本也減排放。

segments.en: Electric bus rollout makes routes quieter.
segments.zh: 電動公車讓路線更安靜。

segments.en: Walk errands under a mile—free steps.
segments.zh: 一英里內跑腿用走—免費步數。

segments.en: Flight guilt—I offset sometimes, fly less more.
segments.zh: 飛行罪惡感—偶爾碳抵，更常少飛。

segments.en: LED swap paid back in one winter.
segments.zh: 換 LED 一個冬天就回本。

segments.en: Thermostat schedule drops heat when we're out.
segments.zh: 恆溫排程出門就降溫。

segments.en: Dryer is last resort—line dry when sunny.
segments.zh: 烘衣機最後手段—晴天晾繩。

segments.en: Smart plugs kill phantom load on the TV.
segments.zh: 智慧插座切電視待機電。

segments.en: We asked landlord for better attic insulation.
segments.zh: 我們請房東加強閣樓隔熱。

segments.en: Solar quote next year if rebates hold.
segments.zh: 補貼若在，明年估太陽能。

segments.en: Meatless Mondays stuck—tacos make it easy.
segments.zh: 週一無肉日固定—塔可好執行。

segments.en: Local farmers market reduces food miles.
segments.zh: 農夫市集縮短食物里程。

segments.en: I repair shoes before buying new pairs.
segments.zh: 我修鞋再買新鞋。

segments.en: Buy nothing groups on social save stuff and cash.
segments.zh: 社群 Buy Nothing 省物也省錢。

segments.en: Quality over fast fashion—cost per wear drops.
segments.zh: 質勝快時尚—每次穿著成本降。

segments.en: Gift experiences, not wrapped clutter.
segments.zh: 送體驗，不送包裝雜物。

segments.en: Neighborhood cleanup quarterly—gloves and gossip.
segments.zh: 社區季清理—手套加八卦。

segments.en: I email council on bike lanes—not weekly, but clear.
segments.zh: 我寫信市議會談單車道—不週週，但清楚。

segments.en: Kids plant trees at school—hope sticks.
segments.zh: 小孩在校種樹—希望紮根。

segments.en: Work green team pushed compost in the cafeteria.
segments.zh: 公司綠色小組推員工餐廳堆肥。

segments.en: Perfect isn't the goal—visible habits spread.
segments.zh: 完美不是目標—看得見的習慣會傳播。

segments.en: Small steps add up—track one change a month.
segments.zh: 小步累積—每月追蹤一項改變。

segments.en: Which bin for this?
segments.zh: 這放哪桶？

segments.en: Bring your cup?
segments.zh: 自帶杯了嗎？

segments.en: Bike or drive?
segments.zh: 騎車還是開車？

segments.en: Too much packaging.
segments.zh: 包裝太多。

segments.en: Thermostat wars.
segments.zh: 恆溫器大戰。

segments.en: Farmers market Saturday?
segments.zh: 週六市集？

segments.en: Solar worth it?
segments.zh: 太陽能值得？

segments.en: Flight shame real.
segments.zh: 飛航 guilt 真。

segments.en: Repair cafe nearby.
segments.zh: 附近有 repair cafe。

segments.en: Meatless okay?
segments.zh: 無肉行嗎？

segments.en: Greenwashing again.
segments.zh: 又是漂綠。

segments.en: One habit this month?
segments.zh: 本月改一項？

segments.en:
Eco stuff feels expensive.
→ Sometimes. Start free—transit, thermostats, food waste down.
segments.zh:
環保東西感覺貴。
→ 有時。 從免費開始—交通、恆溫、減廚餘。

segments.en:
Does recycling even work?
→ If clean. Rinse and sort—dirty recycling becomes trash fast.
segments.zh:
回收真的有用嗎？
→ 要乾淨。 洗淨分類—髒回收很快變垃圾。

segments.en:
I can't give up my car.
→ Fair. Combine trips, tire pressure, one carpool day—partial wins.
segments.zh:
我離不開車。
→ 合理。 合併行程、胎壓、共乘一天—部分勝利。

segments.en:
Kids won't eat leftovers.
→ Rename. Call it 'kitchen surprise'—same food, new story.
segments.zh:
小孩不吃剩菜。
→ 改名。 叫「廚房驚喜」—同樣食物新故事。

segments.en:
Landlord won't upgrade.
→ Document. Show energy bill savings—some approve LED or seals.
segments.zh:
房東不肯升級。
→ 記錄。 用帳單省多少說服—有些準 LED 或封條。

segments.en:
You're judging my straw.
→ Not you. Systems matter more—I'm ranting at policy, not lunch.
segments.zh:
你在評判我的吸管。
→ 不是評你。 系統更重要—我在罵政策，不是午餐。

segments.en:
What offset site?
→ Research. Pick verified projects—transparency beats guilt clicks.
segments.zh:
哪個碳抵網站？
→ 要查。 選 verified 項目—透明勝 guilt 點擊。

segments.en:
Bulk shopping takes time.
→ Batch. Monthly pantry refill—weekly milk only.
segments.zh:
散買很花時間。
→ 分批。 每月 pantry 補貨—鮮奶才每週。

segments.en:
Company claims net zero.
→ Skeptical. Ask scope three and timelines—slides love vague.
segments.zh:
公司說淨零。
→ 懷疑。 問範圍三和時間表—簡報愛模糊。

segments.en:
Garden on the balcony?
→ Herbs yes. Tomatoes need sun—start basil, skip guilt if it dies.
segments.zh:
陽臺能種嗎？
→ 香草可以。 番茄要日照—先羅勒，死了別 guilt。

segments.en:
Join the cleanup?
→ I'm in. Saturday nine—coffee after, gloves provided.
segments.zh:
一起來清理？
→ 我加入。 週六九點—後有咖啡，手套提供。

segments.en:
Feels hopeless sometimes.
→ Same. Community beats perfection—one street tree still shade.
segments.zh:
有時覺得 hopeless。
→ 一樣。 社區勝完美—一棵行道樹也有蔭。

lesson.introZh: 四部分：五段心得口說、十二句參訪回應、十二組「附和＋完整補充」。先讀 Part 1 片語，再逐句跟讀；Part 4 再練 15 句抽換模板。

part4.introZh: Part 4｜內容精粹：從本篇抽出 15 句可抽換骨架。句型固定，只換 [SWAP] 關鍵詞，練替換反應與口說流暢度。
